short_description.id: Kurma adalah avatar kedua Wisnu, dewa pemelihara Hindu, dalam wujud kura-kura. Ia paling dikenal dari legenda pengadukan Samudra Susu, ketika ia menopang Gunung Mandara di punggungnya.
short_description.en: Kurma is the tortoise form and second avatar of Vishnu, the Hindu preserver deity. He is best known from the legend of the churning of the Ocean of Milk, when he bore Mount Mandara on his back.

long_description.id: Kurma (dari kata Sanskerta untuk kura-kura) adalah avatar kedua Wisnu, dewa pemelihara Hindu, dan tercantum sebagai avatar kedua dalam Dashavatara, sepuluh inkarnasi utama Wisnu. Ia dikenal juga sebagai Akupara, kura-kura dunia yang menopang bumi. Dalam penuturan Hindu, ia muncul pada Satya Yuga sebagai kura-kura raksasa untuk menyelamatkan bumi dari kehancuran. Wisnu memiliki sepuluh avatar utama, dan Kurma disebut sebagai kura-kura bersama Matsya (ikan) dan Varaha (babi hutan).
long_description.en: Kurma (from the Sanskrit word for tortoise) is the second avatar of Vishnu, the Hindu preserver deity, and is listed as the second of the Dashavatara, the ten principal incarnations of Vishnu. He is also identified with Akupara, the World-Turtle who supports the Earth. The Hindu account has him arrive in the Satya Yuga as an immense turtle to rescue the earth from ruin. Hinduism also counts ten principal avatars, with Kurma named as the tortoise alongside Matsya the fish and Varaha the boar.

long_description.id: Asal-usul Kurma dilacak ke sastra Weda. Shatapatha Brahmana adalah teks tertua yang menyebutnya, dan di sana Prajapati mengambil wujud Kurma untuk menciptakan semua makhluk. Kurma disamakan dengan resi Kashyapa, yang namanya juga berarti kura-kura. Meski tidak ditemukan dalam Rigveda, Kashyapa muncul dalam himne-himnenya, dan Vajasaneyi Samhita menyebut kura-kura sebagai penguasa perairan.
long_description.en: Kurma's roots are traced to Vedic literature. The Shatapatha Brahmana is the earliest extant text to name him, and there Prajapati assumes the form of Kurma to create all creatures. Kurma is equated with the sage Kashyapa, whose name also means tortoise. Although Kurma is absent from the Rigveda, Kashyapa appears in its hymns, and the Vajasaneyi Samhita calls the tortoise lord of the waters.

long_description.id: Dalam sastra pasca-Weda seperti Purana, Kurma erat terkait dengan legenda pengadukan Samudra Susu (Samudra Manthana). Dalam kisah itu para dewa dan asura mengaduk samudra dengan Gunung Mandara sebagai tongkat dan ular Vasuki sebagai tali, tetapi gunung itu mulai tenggelam. Wisnu mengambil wujud Kurma dan menopangnya di punggungnya. Setelah nektar tercipta dan para iblis mencoba merebutnya, Wisnu menjelma sebagai perempuan Maya (Mohini) sehingga para dewa memperoleh keabadian. Menurut Bhagavata Purana, Wisnu juga dikatakan memberi semua dewa lain karunia keabadian. Sebuah sumber menyebut Kurma tercantum dalam Kurma Purana, sedangkan sumber lain menyatakan kisah rincinya tidak ada di sana.
long_description.en: Later literature such as the Puranas ties Kurma tightly to the Samudra Manthana, the story of stirring the Ocean of Milk. In it the gods and asuras churn the ocean with Mount Mandara as the rod and the serpent Vasuki as the rope, but the mountain begins to sink. Vishnu takes the form of Kurma and bears it on his back. After the nectar is made and the demons try to seize it, Vishnu appears as the woman Maya (Mohini) so that the gods gain immortality. The Bhagavata Purana further credits Vishnu with granting every other god immortality. One source places the tale in the Kurma Purana, while another says the detailed version is absent there.

long_description.id: Dalam ikonografi Hindu, Kurma digambarkan sebagai kura-kura atau sebagai manusia berkepala atau bertubuh kura-kura; dalam satu uraian bagian atasnya pria berlengan empat bermahkota seperti Wisnu. Relief Angkor Wat menampilkan Wisnu dan Kurma di tengah pengadukan samudra. Kurma tidak banyak dipuja dalam Hindu modern, tetapi masih memiliki kuil, termasuk Sri Kurmam di Andhra Pradesh.
long_description.en: In Hindu iconography Kurma is shown as a tortoise or as a human with a tortoise head or body; in one description the upper half is a four-armed man crowned like Vishnu. The Angkor Wat relief shows Vishnu and Kurma at the centre of the churning of the ocean. Kurma is not widely worshipped in modern Hinduism, yet still has temples, including Sri Kurmam in Andhra Pradesh.

long_description.id: Tradisi pemujaan dan yoga juga mengenal kura-kura: Taittiriya Samhita menyarankan ritual mengubur kura-kura hidup di dasar altar api kurban, Kurmasana adalah sikap yoga, dan Panikacchapika adalah posisi jari dalam ritual untuk melambangkan Kurma. Aiyangar menduga pengadukan samudra melambangkan pengadukan pikiran lewat meditasi, dan Nanditha Krishna menduga dewa kura-kura suku diserap dengan mengidentifikasikannya sebagai Kurma. Selain Sri Kurmam dan Kurmai, ada kuil di Gavirangapura dan Swarupnarayan.
long_description.en: Ritual and yoga traditions also know the tortoise: the Taittiriya Samhita proposes a rite in which a living tortoise is interred beneath the sacrificial fire altar, Kurmasana is a yoga posture, and Panikacchapika is a finger position in worship meant to symbolise Kurma. Aiyangar surmises that the churning symbolises stirring the mind through meditation, and Nanditha Krishna suggests a tribal tortoise god was absorbed by identifying him with Kurma. Besides Sri Kurmam and Kurmai there are temples at Gavirangapura and Swarupnarayan.

cultural_context.id: Meskipun tidak banyak dipuja dalam Hindu modern, Kurma tetap diakui sebagai tokoh penting dalam kosmologi Hindu, dan karena Kurma-lah Wisnu bertemu Lakshmi.
cultural_context.en: Although not widely worshipped in modern Hinduism, Kurma is still recognised as an important figure in Hindu cosmology, and it was because of Kurma that Vishnu met Lakshmi.

statement.en: The tortoise incarnation of Vishnu is also called Kacchapa, Kamaṭha, Akupara and Ambucara-Atmana in post-Vedic literature such as the Bhagavata Purana, all meaning "tortoise" or "form of a tortoise".

statement.id: Nanditha Krishna menduga bahwa dewa kura-kura suku dapat diserap ke dalam lingkungan Hindu dengan mengidentifikasikannya sebagai Kurma.
statement.en: Nanditha Krishna suggests that a tribal tortoise god could have been assimilated into the Hindu fold by identifying him with Kurma.

claims.quote: Vishnu has ten avatars or worldly appearances, which are people, animals or a mix of both.

statement.id: Wisnu memiliki sepuluh avatar atau penampakan duniawi, yang berupa manusia, hewan, atau campuran keduanya.
statement.en: Vishnu has ten avatars or worldly appearances, which are people, animals or a mix of both.

claims.quote: Matsya (the fish) Kurma (the tortoise) Varaha (the boar)

statement.id: Dalam daftar avatar, Kurma disebut sebagai kura-kura, bersama Matsya (ikan) dan Varaha (babi hutan).
statement.en: In the list of avatars, Kurma is named as the tortoise, alongside Matsya (the fish) and Varaha (the boar).

claims.quote: In the Bhagavata Purana, an epic poem that collects together many Vaishnavite stories, Vishnu is also credited with giving all the other gods the gift of immortality.

statement.id: Dalam Bhagavata Purana, puisi epik yang menghimpun banyak kisah Waisnawa, Wisnu juga dikatakan memberi semua dewa lain karunia keabadian.
statement.en: In the Bhagavata Purana, an epic poem collecting many Vaishnavite stories, Vishnu is also credited with giving all the other gods the gift of immortality.

claims.quote: To mix the ocean they decided to use the holy Mt. Mandara with the giant serpent Vasuki (or Ananta) as a turning rope; one end to be pulled by Demons and the other by the gods.

statement.id: Untuk mengaduk samudra mereka memakai Gunung Mandara yang suci dengan ular raksasa Vasuki (atau Ananta) sebagai tali; satu ujung ditarik para iblis dan ujung lain oleh para dewa.
statement.en: To mix the ocean they used the holy Mt. Mandara with the giant serpent Vasuki (or Ananta) as a rope, one end pulled by the demons and the other by the gods.

claims.quote: However, neither group could handle such a weight and they called for Vishnu to hold it. This he did in the form of Kurma, the giant tortoise, supporting the mountain on his shell.

statement.id: Namun tak satu pun pihak sanggup menanggung beban itu sehingga mereka memanggil Wisnu untuk menahannya; ia melakukannya dalam wujud Kurma, kura-kura raksasa, menopang gunung di cangkangnya.
statement.en: Neither group could handle such a weight, so they called for Vishnu to hold it; he did so in the form of Kurma, the giant tortoise, supporting the mountain on his shell.

claims.quote: The nectar was duly created from the foaming sea but the Demons, true to character, tried to make off with it. Fortunately, Vishnu interceded in the form of the beautiful Maya (the personification of Illusion) and, suitably distracted, the Demons relinquished the nectar which Vishnu graciously gave to the gods, allowing them the possibility of immortality.

statement.id: Nektar tercipta dari laut berbusa, tetapi para iblis mencoba membawanya kabur; Wisnu turun tangan dalam wujud Maya yang cantik dan, karena para iblis terkecoh, nektar itu diberikan kepada para dewa sehingga mereka berpeluang abadi.
statement.en: The nectar was created from the foaming sea but the demons tried to make off with it; Vishnu intervened as the beautiful Maya and, with the demons distracted, gave the nectar to the gods, allowing them the possibility of immortality.

claims.quote: In the Hindu religion, Kurma (Sanskrit: meaning "Tortoise") is the second avatar of Vishnu, the preserver god in the Hindu Trimurti (trinity), who appeared in the Satya Yuga as a giant turtle to save the earth from destruction.

statement.id: Dalam agama Hindu, Kurma (Sanskerta: berarti "kura-kura") adalah avatar kedua Wisnu, dewa pemelihara dalam Trimurti Hindu, yang muncul pada Satya Yuga sebagai kura-kura raksasa untuk menyelamatkan bumi dari kehancuran.
statement.en: In Hinduism Kurma (Sanskrit: "Tortoise") is the second avatar of Vishnu, the preserver god in the Hindu Trimurti, who appeared in the Satya Yuga as a giant turtle to save the earth from destruction.

claims.quote: His enormous back was said to have provided a foundation for the mythical Mount Mandara, which was used by the gods (and demons) as a churning rod to stir the primordial milk-ocean thereby obtaining the purported nectar of immortality.

statement.id: Punggungnya yang besar dikatakan menjadi landasan bagi Gunung Mandara yang mitis, yang dipakai para dewa (dan iblis) sebagai tongkat pengaduk samudra susu purba untuk memperoleh nektar keabadian.
statement.en: His enormous back was said to provide a foundation for the mythical Mount Mandara, used by the gods (and demons) as a churning rod to stir the primordial milk-ocean and obtain the nectar of immortality.

claims.quote: It is said that Durvasa, an ancient sage, gave a garland of flowers to Indra. Indra placed this garland upon his elephant Airavata, who promptly threw it on the ground and trampled it. Having witnessed this desecration of his gift, the short-tempered Durvasa cursed Indra and all the other devas (benevolent gods) so that they would lose their strength.

statement.id: Konon resi kuno Durvasa memberi Indra kalung bunga; Indra menaruhnya pada gajahnya Airavata, yang melemparkan dan menginjaknya; Durvasa yang pemarah mengutuk Indra dan para dewa agar kehilangan kekuatan.
statement.en: It is said that the ancient sage Durvasa gave Indra a garland of flowers; Indra placed it upon his elephant Airavata, who threw it down and trampled it; the short-tempered Durvasa cursed Indra and the devas so that they would lose their strength.

claims.quote: As the churning continued, Mt. Mandara began to gradually sink into the mud at the bottom of the milk-ocean. In order to provide support for the mountain so it would not sink any further, Vishnu took the form of Kurma, the tortoise, and supported the mountain upon his broad back.

statement.id: Seiring pengadukan, Gunung Mandara perlahan tenggelam ke lumpur dasar samudra susu; agar tidak tenggelam lebih dalam, Wisnu mengambil wujud Kurma, sang kura-kura, dan menopang gunung di punggungnya yang lebar.
statement.en: As the churning continued Mt. Mandara began to sink into the mud at the bottom of the milk-ocean; so it would sink no further, Vishnu took the form of Kurma, the tortoise, and supported the mountain upon his broad back.

claims.quote: The asuras promptly commandeered the elixir, however, thanks to another trick on the part of Vishnu in which he appeared as the female Mohini in order to dumbfound the asuras by way of seduction, the devas attained the elixir of immortality for themselves.

statement.id: Para asura segera merebut ramuan itu, tetapi berkat tipuan Wisnu yang menjelma sebagai Mohini, para dewa memperoleh ramuan keabadian untuk diri mereka.
statement.en: The asuras promptly commandeered the elixir, but thanks to another trick by Vishnu appearing as Mohini, the devas obtained the elixir of immortality for themselves.

claims.quote: In Hindu iconography, Kurma is depicted as a tortoise, or else as a human being with a tortoise head or a tortoise body. His colour is black, although sometimes he is depicted as golden in colour.

statement.id: Dalam ikonografi Hindu, Kurma digambarkan sebagai kura-kura, atau sebagai manusia berkepala atau bertubuh kura-kura; warnanya hitam, meski kadang digambarkan keemasan.
statement.en: In Hindu iconography Kurma is depicted as a tortoise, or as a human being with a tortoise head or body; his colour is black, although sometimes he is shown as golden.

claims.quote: Kurma is commonly pictured with his consorts Sri and Bhumi, or else with Sri and the Pusti tree.

statement.id: Kurma lazim digambarkan bersama pasangannya Sri dan Bhumi, atau bersama Sri dan pohon Pusti.
statement.en: Kurma is commonly pictured with his consorts Sri and Bhumi, or else with Sri and the Pusti tree.

claims.quote: Although Kurma is not widely worshiped in modern Hinduism, he is still acknowledged as an important figure in Hindu cosmology.

statement.id: Meskipun Kurma tidak banyak dipuja dalam Hindu modern, ia tetap diakui sebagai tokoh penting dalam kosmologi Hindu.
statement.en: Although Kurma is not widely worshiped in modern Hinduism, he is still acknowledged as an important figure in Hindu cosmology.

claims.quote: it is because of Kurma that Vishnu met his wife, the beloved Lakshmi

statement.id: Karena Kurma-lah Wisnu bertemu istrinya, Lakshmi yang dicintai.
statement.en: It is because of Kurma that Vishnu met his wife, the beloved Lakshmi.

claims.quote: The story of the Kurma Avatar, found in the Kurma Purana, reflects the usurping of the early Hindu Vedic deities (such as Indra and Varuna) with the popular gods of Classical Hinduism such as the Hindu Trimurti.

statement.id: Kisah Avatar Kurma, yang disebut terdapat dalam Kurma Purana, mencerminkan tergesernya dewa-dewa Weda awal (seperti Indra dan Varuna) oleh dewa-dewa populer Hindu Klasik seperti Trimurti.
statement.en: The story of the Kurma Avatar, said to be found in the Kurma Purana, reflects the usurping of the early Vedic deities (such as Indra and Varuna) by the popular gods of Classical Hinduism such as the Trimurti.

claims.quote: The detailed tale of the Samudra Manthana is absent from the Purana and alludes to Kurma as the one who supported Mount Mandara.

statement.id: Kisah rinci Samudra Manthana tidak terdapat dalam Purana ini, yang hanya menyinggung Kurma sebagai penopang Gunung Mandara.
statement.en: The detailed tale of the Samudra Manthana is absent from this Purana, which alludes to Kurma only as the one who supported Mount Mandara.

claims.quote: The upper half resembles Vishnu and wears the traditional ornaments and the kirita-mukuta (tall conical crown) as worn by Vishnu.

statement.id: Dalam bentuk antropomorfik, bagian atasnya menyerupai Wisnu dan mengenakan perhiasan tradisional serta kirita-mukuta, mahkota kerucut tinggi seperti yang dikenakan Wisnu.
statement.en: In the anthropomorphic form the upper half resembles Vishnu and wears the traditional ornaments and the kirita-mukuta (tall conical crown) as worn by Vishnu.

claims.quote: In the anthropomorphic form, the upper half is that of the four-armed man and the lower half is a fish.

statement.id: Dalam bentuk antropomorfik, bagian atas berupa pria berlengan empat dan bagian bawah berupa ikan.
statement.en: In the anthropomorphic form, the upper half is that of the four-armed man and the lower half is a fish.

summary.id: Dalam Mahabharata (edisi kritis), Kurma tidak dikaitkan dengan Wisnu; sisipan belakangan mengaitkannya sebagai perwujudan Wisnu.
summary.en: In the Mahabharata (critical edition) Kurma is not related to Vishnu; later insertions link him as a manifestation of Vishnu.

summary.id: Dalam Purana dan penuturan Hindu, Kurma adalah avatar kedua Wisnu.
summary.en: In the Puranas and Hindu accounts, Kurma is the second avatar of Vishnu.

summary.id: Dalam Shatapatha Brahmana, Prajapati yang mengambil wujud Kurma.
summary.en: In the Shatapatha Brahmana it is Prajapati who assumes the form of Kurma.

topic.en: Whether the detailed Samudra Manthana tale is in the Kurma Purana

summary.id: Satu sumber menyebut kisah Avatar Kurma terdapat dalam Kurma Purana.
summary.en: One source says the story of the Kurma Avatar is found in the Kurma Purana.

summary.en: Another source states the detailed Samudra Manthana tale is absent from that Purana.

summary.en: As a tortoise, or a human with a tortoise head or body.

short_description.id: Selene adalah dewi bulan Yunani yang dikisahkan mengendarai kereta malam dan mencintai Endymion.
short_description.en: Selene is the Greek moon goddess who drives a night chariot and loves Endymion.

long_description.id: Selene adalah personifikasi bulan, anak Hyperion dan Theia serta saudari Helios dan Eos. Ia dikisahkan melintasi langit malam dengan kereta yang ditarik kuda atau lembu; sumber lain menyebut kuda putih, sapi, atau begal. Padanannya dalam tradisi Romawi ialah Luna, yang memiliki kuil di bukit Aventine. Ia juga disebut Mene dan Phoebe, dan dikaitkan dengan Artemis dan Hecate; pada masa kemudian ia diidentikkan dengan Artemis. Dewi bulan Yunani lainnya mencakup Pasiphae, Leukippides, Eileithyia, Hekate, Artemis, Bendis, dan Hera, yang kadang menggantikan Selene dalam mitos Endymion.
long_description.en: Selene personifies the moon and is daughter of Hyperion and Theia and sister of Helios and Eos. She is said to cross the night sky in a chariot pulled by horses or oxen; other sources name white horses, cows, or mules. Her Roman counterpart is Luna, who had a temple on the Aventine. She is also called Mene and Phoebe and is associated with Artemis and Hecate; in later times she was identified with Artemis. The moon was also linked with other goddesses, among them Pasiphae, the Leukippides, Eileithyia, Hekate, Artemis, Bendis, and Hera, who at times stood in for Selene in the Endymion tale.

long_description.id: Selene digambarkan sebagai perempuan cantik yang menunggang kuda menyamping atau mengendarai kereta. Dalam seni Yunani ia biasanya bermahkota bulan sabit dan tanpa sayap, tetapi sumber lain menggambarkannya bersayap panjang dengan mahkota emas, dan Homeric Hymn menyebutnya dewi bersayap yang ramah. Bulan sabitnya dapat berupa mahkota atau lipatan jubah bercahaya. Seni juga membedakannya dari Artemis dengan wajah yang lebih penuh dan jubah panjang, dan di Elis ada patungnya dengan dua tanduk. Aeschylus menyebutnya mata malam, dan sebuah karya menunjukkan kereta Helios naik di timur sementara Selene dan kuda-kudanya tenggelam di barat.
long_description.en: Selene is depicted as a beautiful woman riding sidesaddle or driving a chariot. In Greek art she usually has a crescent crown and no wings, but other sources show her with long wings and a golden crown, and the Homeric Hymn calls her a kindly winged goddess. Her crescent can be a crown or the fold of a shining cloak. Art also distinguishes her from Artemis by a fuller face and long robe, and a two-horned statue of her stood at Elis. Aeschylus calls her the eye of night, and one work shows Helios' chariot rising in the east while Selene and her horses sink in the west.

long_description.id: Cerita cintanya dengan Endymion merupakan kisah yang paling dikenal: Selene melihat gembala itu tidur di bukit dekat Gunung Latmos dan turun menjumpainya saat bulan baru. Beberapa sumber menyebut Selene meminta Zeus menjadikan Endymion tertidur abadi agar tidak menua, sedangkan sumber lain menyatakan Endymion memilihnya sendiri, atau bahwa itu hukuman Zeus bagi Selene karena absen dari langit. Selene menidurkan Endymion agar dapat menciumnya, dan mereka disebut memiliki lima puluh putri. Kisah itu juga dipahat dalam relief di bagian depan sebuah sarkofagus, tempat Selene turun dari keretanya untuk menjumpai Endymion yang berbaring. Dengan Zeus, Selene memiliki Pandia, Ersa, dan Nemea.
long_description.en: Her love for Endymion is her best-known tale: Selene spotted the shepherd sleeping on a hill near Mount Latmos and flew down to him at the new moon. In some accounts Selene pleaded with Zeus to let Endymion sleep forever so that he would stay ageless, while others say Endymion chose it himself, or that Zeus imposed it on Selene as a penalty for leaving the skies empty. She sent Endymion to sleep in order to kiss him, and the two are said to have fifty daughters. The story is also carved in relief on the front of a sarcophagus, where Selene alights from her chariot to visit the reclining Endymion. With Zeus, Selene had Pandia, Ersa, and Nemea.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah lain, Selene naik ke punggung Pan yang menyamar tanpa menyadari jati dirinya, dan menghukum Ampelos yang menyombongkan diri dengan mengirim pikat lalat. Atas perintah Hera dan Zeus ia pernah berhenti menarik bulan selama Pemberontakan Para Raksasa, dan menurut Nonnus ia bergulat dengan Typhon. Ia juga disebut pencipta Singa Nemea, dan ia bergerak lambat agar malam diperpanjang ketika Zeus mengunjungi Alcmene.
long_description.en: In other tales Selene climbed onto the back of a disguised Pan without realising who he was, and punished the boastful Ampelos by sending a gadfly. At the orders of Hera and Zeus she once stopped pulling the moon during the Giants' Revolt, and according to Nonnus she struggled with Typhon. She is also credited with creating the Nemean Lion, and she moved slowly to drag out the night when Zeus visited Alcmene.

long_description.id: Bulan menentukan jadwal festival keagamaan dan melambangkan siklus kelahiran dan kematian, dan pada Periode Klasik penyihir dipercaya dapat menurunkan bulan sehingga Selene dikaitkan dengan sihir. Pemujaannya mencakup kue berbentuk bulan, dan Pindar menyatakan perempuan yang jatuh cinta berdoa kepada bulan. Unsur kimia selenium dinamai dari namanya.
long_description.en: The moon set the schedule of religious festivals and symbolised the cycles of birth and death, and in the Classical Period witches were believed able to bring the moon down, linking Selene to witchcraft. Her worship included moon-shaped cakes, and Pindar stated that women in love prayed to the moon. The chemical element selenium is named after her.

cultural_context.id: Fase-fase bulan menentukan jadwal festival keagamaan sepanjang tahun dan melambangkan siklus kelahiran dan kematian, dan orang Yunani kuno mengukur waktu dalam bulan lunar.
cultural_context.en: The moon's phases set the schedule of religious festivals through the year and symbolised the cycles of birth and death, and the ancient Greeks measured time in lunar months.

who.en: Selene is the personification and goddess of the moon in Greek mythology.

famous_for.en: Selene is best known for her love affair with Endymion.

summary.id: Zeus membuat manusia lelah agar tidak sadar Helios tidak terbit dan Selene bergerak sangat lambat sehingga malam diperpanjang.
summary.en: Zeus made humans tired so that they would not notice Helios did not rise and Selene moved extra slowly, dragging out the night.

summary.en: In one tradition Selene bore the lion and dropped it near Nemea; other sources say she created it from sea foam at Hera's wish.

sources.title: Marble sarcophagus with the myth of Selene and Endymion

claims.quote: Selene (also known as Mene) is the personification and goddess of the moon in Greek mythology.

statement.id: Selene adalah dewi sekaligus personifikasi bulan dalam mitologi Yunani.
statement.en: Selene is the Greek goddess and personification of the moon.

claims.quote: Every night, she travels across the sky in her chariot, pulling the moon behind her.

statement.id: Setiap malam Selene dikisahkan melintasi langit dengan keretanya.
statement.en: Each night Selene is said to cross the sky in her chariot.

claims.quote: Selene is the daughter of the Titans Hyperion and Theia and the sister of Helios (Sun) and Eos (Dawn).

statement.id: Selene adalah putri Hyperion dan Theia serta saudari Helios dan Eos.
statement.en: Selene is the daughter of Hyperion and Theia and sister of Helios and Eos.

claims.quote: The Roman counterpart of Selene is Luna.

statement.id: Luna adalah padanan Selene dalam tradisi Romawi.
statement.en: Luna is Selene's Roman counterpart.

claims.quote: Selene's moon chariot was pulled across the night sky by a pair of white-silvery horses or sometimes by a pair of oxen.

statement.id: Kereta bulan Selene ditarik sepasang kuda putih keperakan atau kadang sepasang lembu.
statement.en: Selene's moon chariot is drawn by silver-white horses or sometimes oxen.

claims.quote: In Greek art, Selene was usually depicted with a crescent moon crown and without wings.

statement.id: Dalam seni Yunani, Selene kerap dimahkotai bulan sabit dan tanpa sayap.
statement.en: Greek art often depicts Selene with a crescent crown and no wings.

claims.quote: The best-known story involving Selene is her love affair with the beautiful youth Endymion.

statement.id: Kisah paling terkenal Selene berkaitan dengan cintanya kepada Endymion.
statement.en: Selene's best-known story concerns her love for Endymion.

claims.quote: Selene bore Endymion 50 daughters.

statement.id: Dalam satu kisah, Selene dan Endymion memiliki lima puluh putri.
statement.en: In one account Selene and Endymion have fifty daughters.

claims.quote: According to some sources, Selene begged Zeus to grant Endymion perpetual sleep, so he would not age or die

statement.id: Sebagian sumber menyatakan Selene meminta Zeus membuat Endymion tidur abadi agar tidak menua atau mati.
statement.en: Some sources say Selene asked Zeus to grant Endymion ageless perpetual sleep.

claims.quote: Other sources state that Endymion chose it for himself

statement.id: Sumber lain menyebut Endymion sendiri memilih tidur abadi.
statement.en: Other sources say Endymion chose the perpetual sleep himself.

claims.quote: SELENE was the Titan goddess of the moon.

statement.id: Theoi menyebut Selene dewi Titan bulan.
statement.en: Theoi calls Selene the Titan moon goddess.

claims.quote: Her lunar sphere or crescent was either a crown set upon her head or the fold of a raised, shining cloak.

statement.id: Bulan sabit dapat menjadi mahkota Selene atau bagian jubah bercahaya yang terangkat.
statement.en: Selene's crescent can appear as a crown or the fold of a raised shining cloak.

claims.quote: In the center, Selene, the moon goddess, alights from her chariot to visit her beloved, the shepherd Endymion, who reclines at the right.

statement.id: Sarkofagus Romawi menampilkan Selene turun dari kereta untuk menemui Endymion yang berbaring.
statement.en: A Roman sarcophagus shows Selene leaving her chariot to visit the reclining Endymion.

claims.quote: The story of Endymion is shown in strongly undercut relief on the front of the sarcophagus.

statement.id: Kisah Endymion dipahat pada bagian depan sarkofagus.
statement.en: The Endymion story is carved on the front of the sarcophagus.

claims.quote: She was depicted as a woman riding sidesaddle on a horse or driving a chariot drawn by a pair of winged steeds.

statement.id: Selene digambarkan sebagai perempuan yang menunggang kuda menyamping atau mengendarai kereta yang ditarik sepasang kuda bersayap.
statement.en: Selene was depicted as a woman riding sidesaddle on a horse or driving a chariot drawn by a pair of winged steeds.

claims.quote: Selene's great love was the shepherd prince Endymion. The beautiful boy was granted eternal youth and immortality by Zeus and placed in a state of eternal slumber in a cave near the peak of Lydian Mount Latmos (Latmus). His heavenly bride consorted with him there in the night.

statement.id: Endymion diberi kemudaan abadi dan keabadian oleh Zeus serta ditempatkan dalam tidur abadi di sebuah gua dekat puncak Gunung Latmos di Lydia; mempelai surgawinya menemuinya di sana pada malam hari.
statement.en: Endymion was granted eternal youth and immortality by Zeus and placed in eternal slumber in a cave near the peak of Lydian Mount Latmos; his heavenly bride consorted with him there at night.

claims.quote: Other Greek moon goddesses included Pasiphae, the Leukippides (Leucippes), Eileithyia, Hekate (Hecate), Artemis, Bendis, and Hera (who sometimes doubled for Selene in the Endymion myth).

statement.id: Dewi bulan Yunani lainnya mencakup Pasiphae, Leukippides, Eileithyia, Hekate, Artemis, Bendis, dan Hera (yang kadang menggantikan Selene dalam mitos Endymion).
statement.en: Other Greek moon goddesses included Pasiphae, the Leukippides, Eileithyia, Hekate, Artemis, Bendis, and Hera (who sometimes doubled for Selene in the Endymion myth).

claims.quote: [1.2] HYPERION & EURYPHAESSA (Homeric Hymn 31 to Helios)

statement.id: Menurut Homeric Hymn 31 to Helios, orang tua Selene adalah Hyperion dan Euryphaessa.
statement.en: In Homeric Hymn 31 to Helios, Selene's parents are Hyperion and Euryphaessa.

claims.quote: [2.1] PALLAS (Homeric Hymn 4 to Hermes 100

statement.id: Dalam Homeric Hymn 4 to Hermes 100, Pallas dicantumkan sebagai orang tua Selene.
statement.en: In Homeric Hymn 4 to Hermes 100, Pallas is listed as Selene's parent.

claims.quote: She is also called Phoebe, as the sister of Phoebus, the god of the sun.

statement.id: Selene juga disebut Phoebe, sebagai saudari Phoebus, dewa matahari.
statement.en: She is also called Phoebe, as the sister of Phoebus, the god of the sun.

claims.quote: By Endymion, whom she loved, and whom she sent to sleep in order to kiss him, she became the mother of fifty daughters

statement.id: Dari Endymion, yang ia cintai dan ia tidurkan agar dapat menciumnya, Selene menjadi ibu lima puluh putri.
statement.en: By Endymion, whom she loved and sent to sleep in order to kiss him, Selene became the mother of fifty daughters.

claims.quote: by Zeus she became the mother of Pandeia, Ersa, and Nemea

statement.id: Dari Zeus, Selene menjadi ibu Pandeia, Ersa, dan Nemea.
statement.en: By Zeus, Selene became the mother of Pandeia, Ersa, and Nemea.

claims.quote: Selene is described as a very beautiful goddess, with long wings and a golden diadem

statement.id: Selene digambarkan sebagai dewi yang sangat cantik, bersayap panjang, dan bermahkota emas.
statement.en: Selene is described as a very beautiful goddess with long wings and a golden diadem.

claims.quote: Aeschylus (Sept. 390) calls her the eye of night.

statement.id: Aeschylus menyebutnya mata malam.
statement.en: Aeschylus calls her the eye of night.

claims.quote: She rode, like her brother Helios, across the heavens in a chariot drawn by two white horses, cows, or mules

statement.id: Seperti saudaranya Helios, ia melintasi langit dengan kereta yang ditarik dua ekor kuda putih, sapi, atau begal.
statement.en: Like her brother Helios, she rode across the heavens in a chariot drawn by two white horses, cows, or mules.

claims.quote: In later times Selene was identified with Artemis, and the worship of the two became amalgamated

statement.id: Pada masa kemudian Selene diidentikkan dengan Artemis, dan pemujaan keduanya melebur.
statement.en: In later times Selene was identified with Artemis, and the worship of the two became amalgamated.

claims.quote: In works of art, however, the two divinities are usually distinguished; the face of Selene being more full and round, her figure less tall, and always clothed in a long robe

statement.id: Dalam karya seni keduanya biasanya dibedakan: wajah Selene lebih penuh dan bulat, tubuhnya kurang tinggi, dan selalu berjubah panjang.
statement.en: In works of art the two divinities are usually distinguished: Selene's face is fuller and rounder, her figure less tall, and she is always clothed in a long robe.

claims.quote: at Elis there was a statue of her with two horns

statement.id: Di Elis ada patung Selene dengan dua tanduk.
statement.en: At Elis there was a statue of Selene with two horns.

claims.quote: At Rome Luna had a temple on the Aventine.

statement.id: Di Roma, Luna memiliki kuil di bukit Aventine.
statement.en: At Rome Luna had a temple on the Aventine.

claims.quote: Selene, meaning "the moon", was depicted as a beautiful woman with long wings and a gold crown.

statement.id: Selene, yang berarti "bulan", digambarkan sebagai perempuan cantik bersayap panjang dan bermahkota emas.
statement.en: Selene, meaning "the moon", was depicted as a beautiful woman with long wings and a gold crown.

claims.quote: She is commonly associated with the fellow Greek goddesses Artemis and Hecate.

statement.id: Selene biasanya dikaitkan dengan sesama dewi Yunani, Artemis dan Hecate.
statement.en: Selene is commonly associated with the fellow Greek goddesses Artemis and Hecate.

claims.quote: Selene has two daughters with Zeus; Pandia (who the Athenians honoured every full moon) and Ersa (Herse), the personification of the dew.

statement.id: Selene memiliki dua putri dengan Zeus: Pandia, yang dihormati orang Athena setiap bulan purnama, dan Ersa (Herse), personifikasi embun.
statement.en: Selene has two daughters with Zeus: Pandia, whom the Athenians honoured every full moon, and Ersa (Herse), the personification of the dew.

claims.quote: In the Homeric Hymn to Selene, Selene is described as a kindly and beautiful winged goddess who is crowned with gold and drives her chariot across the night sky as a sign to humans.

statement.id: Dalam Homeric Hymn to Selene, ia digambarkan sebagai dewi bersayap yang ramah dan cantik, bermahkota emas, yang mengendarai keretanya melintasi langit malam sebagai tanda bagi manusia.
statement.en: In the Homeric Hymn to Selene she is described as a kindly and beautiful winged goddess crowned with gold who drives her chariot across the night sky as a sign to humans.

claims.quote: The moon's phases created the schedule of religious festivals celebrated throughout the year and symbolised the cycles of birth and death, with the ancient Greeks measuring out time in lunar months.

statement.id: Fase-fase bulan menentukan jadwal festival keagamaan sepanjang tahun dan melambangkan siklus kelahiran dan kematian, dan orang Yunani kuno mengukur waktu dalam bulan lunar.
statement.en: The moon's phases set the schedule of religious festivals through the year and symbolised the cycles of birth and death, and the ancient Greeks measured time in lunar months.

claims.quote: Another popular belief during the Classical Period was that witches could bring the moon down from the sky, linking Selene to witchcraft

statement.id: Pada Periode Klasik ada kepercayaan populer bahwa penyihir dapat menurunkan bulan dari langit, yang mengaitkan Selene dengan sihir.
statement.en: During the Classical Period it was a popular belief that witches could bring the moon down from the sky, linking Selene to witchcraft.

claims.quote: The only time Selene stopped pulling the moon across the night sky was at the orders of Hera and Zeus during the Giants' Revolt (Gigantomachy) against the Olympians.

statement.id: Satu-satunya saat Selene berhenti menarik bulan melintasi langit malam adalah atas perintah Hera dan Zeus pada Pemberontakan Para Raksasa (Gigantomakhia) melawan para dewa Olimpus.
statement.en: The only time Selene stopped pulling the moon across the night sky was at the orders of Hera and Zeus during the Giants' Revolt (Gigantomachy) against the Olympians.

claims.quote: According to the Greek epic poet Nonnus (5th century CE) in his Dionysiaca, the monstrous serpent Typhon attacked Selene during his revolt against the heavens. He launched bulls at her, but she remained undaunted even after he charged at her. Selene struggled with Typhon, locking horns with him and scarring the orb of her bull's horn.

statement.id: Menurut Nonnus, ular raksasa Typhon menyerang Selene dalam pemberontakannya terhadap langit; Selene tetap tak gentar, bergulat dengan Typhon, mengadu tanduk, dan melukai bola tanduk banteng miliknya.
statement.en: According to Nonnus, the monstrous serpent Typhon attacked Selene during his revolt against the heavens; Selene remained undaunted, struggled with Typhon, locking horns with him and scarring the orb of her bull's horn.

claims.quote: Selene spotted the shepherd Endymion sleeping on a hill near Mount Latmos. Overcome by his beauty, she waited for the new moon when her chariot would not be seen and flew down to lie with him as he slept.

statement.id: Selene melihat gembala Endymion tidur di bukit dekat Gunung Latmos; terpikat oleh keindahannya, ia menunggu bulan baru agar keretanya tak terlihat lalu turun untuk berbaring bersamanya saat ia tidur.
statement.en: Selene spotted the shepherd Endymion sleeping on a hill near Mount Latmos; overcome by his beauty, she waited for the new moon, when her chariot would not be seen, and flew down to lie with him as he slept.

claims.quote: while some say that it was Selene's punishment from Zeus for being absent from the skies.

statement.id: Sebagian lain mengatakan tidur itu adalah hukuman Zeus bagi Selene karena absen dari langit.
statement.en: Others say that it was Selene's punishment from Zeus for being absent from the skies.

claims.quote: The mischievous god Pan disguised himself by covering his short, coarse black goat hair with soft, clean white fleece. Not realising his true identity, Selene climbed onto his back and permitted him to do whatever he wanted to her.

statement.id: Tanpa menyadari jati dirinya, Selene naik ke punggung Pan dan membiarkannya berbuat sesukanya.
statement.en: Not realising his true identity, Selene climbed onto Pan's back and permitted him to do whatever he wanted to her.

claims.quote: One day, he foolishly stated that he was better at riding a wild bull than Selene was at riding her horned moon. Selene chose his punishment carefully. She sent down a gadfly that stung the wild bull Ampelos was riding.

statement.id: Ampelos dengan bodoh mengatakan ia lebih pandai menunggang banteng liar daripada Selene menunggang bulan bertanduknya; Selene mengirim pikat lalat yang menyengat banteng yang ditunggangi Ampelos.
statement.en: Ampelos foolishly claimed to be better at riding a wild bull than Selene at riding her horned moon; Selene sent a gadfly that stung the wild bull Ampelos was riding.

claims.quote: Zeus had fallen in love with the human Alcmene. To be able to visit her, he needed a long night to ensure that he went unseen. He instructed Hypnos (Sleep) to make all humans so tired that they would not notice that Helios (Sun) did not rise and that Selene moved extra slowly across the night sky, dragging out the night.

statement.id: Zeus menyuruh Hypnos membuat semua manusia begitu lelah hingga tak sadar Helios tidak terbit dan Selene bergerak sangat lambat di langit malam sehingga malam diperpanjang.
statement.en: Zeus instructed Hypnos to make all humans so tired they would not notice that Helios did not rise and that Selene moved extra slowly across the night sky, dragging out the night.

claims.quote: Selene is also credited with creating the ferocious Nemean Lion, whom Heracles faced in his first labour.

statement.id: Selene juga disebut sebagai pencipta Singa Nemea yang ganas, yang dihadapi Heracles pada tugas pertamanya.
statement.en: Selene is also credited with creating the ferocious Nemean Lion, whom Heracles faced in his first labour.

claims.quote: Some traditions state that Selene bore the lion with a shudder and dropped it to earth near Nemea by a two-mouthed cave, where she made the creature prey upon her own people as punishment for an unfulfilled sacrifice.

statement.id: Sebagian tradisi menyebut Selene melahirkan singa itu dengan gemetar dan menjatuhkannya ke bumi dekat Nemea di gua bermulut dua, tempat ia membuatnya memangsa rakyatnya sendiri sebagai hukuman atas kurban yang tak dipenuhi.
statement.en: Some traditions say Selene bore the lion with a shudder and dropped it to earth near Nemea by a two-mouthed cave, where she made it prey upon her own people as punishment for an unfulfilled sacrifice.

claims.quote: Other sources say that in answer to Hera's wishes, Selene created the lion from sea foam which was then bound and carried to the Nemean mountains by Iris

statement.id: Sumber lain mengatakan bahwa atas keinginan Hera, Selene menciptakan singa itu dari buih laut yang lalu diikat dan dibawa ke pegunungan Nemea oleh Iris.
statement.en: Other sources say that in answer to Hera's wishes Selene created the lion from sea foam, which was then bound and carried to the Nemean mountains by Iris.

claims.quote: In his Description of Greece, the Greek geographer Pausanias (c. 115 to c. 180 CE) talks about a stone image of a horned Selene in Elis' agora (open-air marketplace) in southern Greece.

statement.id: Pausanias menyebut patung batu Selene bertanduk di agora Elis di Yunani selatan.
statement.en: Pausanias mentions a stone image of a horned Selene in the agora of Elis in southern Greece.

claims.quote: Moon-shaped cakes were made in honour of Selene.

statement.id: Kue berbentuk bulan dibuat untuk menghormati Selene.
statement.en: Moon-shaped cakes were made in honour of Selene.

claims.quote: Greek poet Pindar (c. 518 to c. 448 BCE) stated that men in love prayed to the sun (Helios), while women in love prayed to the moon (Selene).

statement.id: Penyair Pindar menyatakan bahwa pria yang jatuh cinta berdoa kepada matahari (Helios), sedangkan wanita yang jatuh cinta berdoa kepada bulan (Selene).
statement.en: The poet Pindar stated that men in love prayed to the sun (Helios), while women in love prayed to the moon (Selene).

claims.quote: It shows Helios' chariot rising up on the eastern horizon (the sun rising), while on the other side, Selene and her horses are shown sinking over the west, symbolising their connection with the passing of time.

statement.id: Karya itu menunjukkan kereta Helios naik di ufuk timur sementara di sisi lain Selene dan kuda-kudanya tenggelam di barat, melambangkan kaitan mereka dengan berlalunya waktu.
statement.en: The work shows Helios' chariot rising on the eastern horizon while on the other side Selene and her horses sink in the west, symbolising their connection with the passing of time.

claims.quote: In chemistry, the chemical element selenium was named after Selene in 1818 by the Swedish chemist

statement.id: Unsur kimia selenium dinamai dari Selene pada 1818 oleh seorang ahli kimia Swedia.
statement.en: The chemical element selenium was named after Selene in 1818 by a Swedish chemist.

text.id: Tokoh sastra dari novel yang terbit pada 1897; dikenal sebagai salah satu tokoh fiksi terkenal era Victoria.
text.en: A literary character from a novel first published in 1897; one of the best-known fictional figures of the Victorian era.

short_description.id: Count Dracula adalah vampir bangsawan Transylvania, tokoh antagonis dalam novel Dracula karya Bram Stoker (1897). Ia dianggap vampir purwarupa dalam fiksi sesudahnya.
short_description.en: Count Dracula is a Transylvanian nobleman and vampire, the title antagonist of Bram Stoker's novel Dracula (1897). He is considered the prototypical vampire of later fiction.

long_description.id: Count Dracula adalah tokoh fiksi, bukan makhluk dari cerita rakyat. Ia lahir dari novel Dracula karya Bram Stoker, yang pertama kali terbit di Britania Raya pada 1897. Menurut Encyclopedia.com, novel itu merangkum banyak kisah tentang vampir yang sudah ada sejak zaman kuno dan memberinya wujud nyata lewat tokoh sang Count. Wikipedia menyebutnya sebagai vampir purwarupa dan arketipal dalam karya fiksi sesudahnya.
long_description.en: Count Dracula is a fictional character, not a figure of folk tradition. He comes from Bram Stoker's novel Dracula, first published in Great Britain in 1897. According to Encyclopedia.com, the novel synthesized much of the vampire lore that had existed since ancient times and gave it a palpable form in the character of the Count. Wikipedia calls him the prototypical and archetypal vampire of later works of fiction.

long_description.id: Dalam novel, Jonathan Harker menggambarkan sang Count sebagai lelaki tua yang tinggi, tercukur bersih kecuali kumis putih panjang, dan berpakaian serba hitam. Wajahnya berhidung bengkok tajam dengan gigi putih yang runcing dan menonjol di atas bibir, telinganya pucat dan sangat runcing di bagian atas, dan kesan umumnya adalah kepucatan luar biasa. Harker juga mencatat ada rambut di telapak tangannya dan kukunya panjang serta runcing.
long_description.en: In the novel, Jonathan Harker describes the Count as a tall old man, clean shaven except for a long white moustache and clothed entirely in black. His face is strongly aquiline with sharp white teeth that protrude over the lips, his ears are pale and extremely pointed at the top, and the general effect is one of extraordinary pallor. Harker also notes hairs in the centre of the palm and long nails cut to a sharp point.

long_description.id: Kemampuan dan batas kekuatan sang Count dipaparkan lewat tokoh Van Helsing. Sang Count tidak berbayang dan tidak tampak di cermin, dan Harker tidak pernah melihatnya makan. Ia disebut dapat berubah menjadi serigala, kelelawar, atau kabut, memiliki kekuatan dua puluh orang, memerintah hewan seperti tikus, burung hantu, kelelawar, ngengat, rubah, dan serigala, serta dapat mengubah orang lain menjadi vampir. Ketika serigala melolong, ia menyebutnya "anak-anak malam". Namun ia tidak masuk ke rumah tanpa diundang oleh salah satu penghuninya, kekuatannya berhenti ketika siang tiba, dan salib, mawar liar pada petinya, peluru suci, pancang, atau pemenggalan kepala disebut dapat membatasi atau mengakhirinya.
long_description.en: The Count's powers and limits are laid out through the character of Van Helsing. The Count casts no shadow and has no reflection in a mirror, and Harker never saw him eat. He is said to be able to transform into a wolf, a bat, or mist, to have the strength of twenty men, to command creatures such as the rat, the owl, the bat, the moth, the fox, and the wolf, and to turn others into vampires. When wolves howl, he calls them "the children of the night". Yet he may not enter a house unless someone of the household invites him, his power ceases at the coming of day, and a crucifix, a branch of wild rose on his coffin, a sacred bullet, a stake, or a cut-off head are said to restrain or end him.

long_description.id: Sang Count tinggal di sebuah kastel di Pegunungan Karpatia dekat Borgo Pass. Menurut ringkasan Wikipedia, ia menaiki kapal Rusia Demeter dengan membawa peti-peti yang ia perlukan; Harker pernah menemukannya terbaring di salah satu dari lima puluh peti besar berisi tanah. Kapal itu kandas di Whitby, dan seekor anjing besar melompat dari kapal menuju tebing pemakaman gereja. Para pahlawan kemudian mengikutinya kembali ke Transylvania; di sana pisau Jonathan menebas lehernya dan pisau bowie Morris menembus jantungnya, lalu tubuhnya hancur menjadi debu.
long_description.en: The Count lives in a castle in the Carpathian Mountains near the Borgo Pass. According to Wikipedia's summary, he boards the Russian ship Demeter taking along the boxes he needs; Harker once finds him lying in one of fifty great boxes of earth. The ship runs aground at Whitby, and an immense dog leaps from the ship and heads for the churchyard cliff. The heroes then follow him back to Transylvania, where Jonathan's knife shears through his throat and Morris's bowie knife plunges into his heart, and his body crumbles into dust.

long_description.id: Asal-usul tokoh ini diperdebatkan. Dalam novel, Van Helsing menyebut sang Count pastilah Voivode Dracula yang melawan bangsa Turki, dan sang Count sendiri membanggakan darah Székely. Encyclopedia.com menyebut sebagian besar kritikus sepakat bahwa tokoh ini sebagian didasarkan pada Vlad si Penusuk, sedangkan menurut Wikipedia para ahli yang dipimpin Elizabeth Miller meragukan hubungan itu dan Sir Henry Irving dianggap luas sebagai inspirasi tokohnya. Entri ini hanya membahas tokoh sastranya, bukan tokoh sejarah mana pun.
long_description.en: The origins of the character are debated. In the novel, Van Helsing deduces that the Count was the Voivode Dracula who earned renown in his conflict with the Turk, and the Count himself boasts of Székely blood. Encyclopedia.com says most critics agree the character was based in part on Vlad the Impaler, whereas according to Wikipedia scholars led by Elizabeth Miller question that connection and Sir Henry Irving is widely considered a real-life inspiration. This entry covers only the literary character, not any historical figure.

cultural_context.id: Menurut Encyclopedia.com, para pemburu vampir dalam novel ini menegaskan sikap-sikap zaman Victoria, dan novel itu merangkum banyak kisah vampir yang lebih tua.
cultural_context.en: According to Encyclopedia.com, the vampire hunters in the novel underscore the Victorian attitudes of the time, and the novel synthesized much older vampire lore.

literal_meaning.id: "Dari sang naga" (Wikipedia menjelaskan bahwa Dracul berarti "naga" atau "setan")

who.id: Seorang bangsawan Transylvania yang merupakan vampir berusia berabad-abad dalam novel Bram Stoker.
who.en: A centuries-old vampire and Transylvanian nobleman in Bram Stoker's novel.

origin.id: Tokoh ciptaan Bram Stoker dalam novel Dracula yang terbit pada 1897 di Britania Raya.
origin.en: A character created by Bram Stoker for the novel Dracula, first published in Great Britain in 1897.

role.id: Antagonis yang menahan Jonathan Harker di kastelnya, lalu berusaha pindah ke London dan menciptakan ras vampir.
role.en: The antagonist who keeps Jonathan Harker prisoner in his castle and then tries to relocate to London and create a race of vampires.

famous_for.id: Dianggap vampir purwarupa dan arketipal dalam karya fiksi sesudahnya.
famous_for.en: Considered the prototypical and archetypal vampire in later works of fiction.

did_you_know.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Stoker memilih nama Dracula untuk menggantikan nama Count Wampyr yang semula ia rencanakan bagi tokoh penjahatnya.
did_you_know.en: According to Wikipedia, Stoker chose the name Dracula to replace the name Count Wampyr that he had originally intended for his villain.

description.id: Menurut Van Helsing, sang Count dapat menjadi serigala, kelelawar, atau kabut yang ia ciptakan sendiri, dan dapat datang sebagai debu elemental dalam sinar bulan.
description.en: According to Van Helsing, the Count can become a wolf, a bat, or mist that he creates, and can come on moonlight rays as elemental dust.

description.id: Van Helsing memperingatkan bahwa sang Count memiliki kekuatan dua puluh orang.
description.en: Van Helsing warns that the Count has the strength of twenty men.

description.id: Dalam jangkauannya, ia dapat mengarahkan badai, kabut, dan guntur, memerintah tikus, burung hantu, kelelawar, ngengat, rubah, dan serigala, menjadi kecil, serta kadang-kadang lenyap.
description.en: Within his range he can direct the storm, the fog and the thunder, command the rat, the owl, the bat, the moth, the fox and the wolf, become small, and at times vanish.

description.id: Harker melihat sang Count turun dari kastel menyusuri dinding dengan cara yang ia sebut seperti cicak.

name.en: Does not die by passing of time

description.en: According to Van Helsing, the vampire lives on and cannot die by the mere passing of time, and the Count can even grow younger.

description.id: Menurut Van Helsing, mereka yang mati karena dimangsa Un-Dead menjadi Un-Dead juga dan memangsa sesamanya.
description.en: According to Van Helsing, all who die from the preying of the Un-Dead become Un-Dead themselves and prey on their kind.

description.en: According to Van Helsing, he may not enter anywhere at first unless someone of the household bids him to come; afterwards he can come as he pleases.

description.id: Kekuatannya berhenti ketika siang datang, dan bila ia tidak berada di tempat tujuannya ia hanya dapat berganti wujud pada tengah hari atau tepat saat matahari terbit atau terbenam.
description.en: His power ceases at the coming of the day, and if he is not at the place he is bound for he can only change himself at noon or at exact sunrise or sunset.

description.en: According to Van Helsing, in the presence of sacred things such as the crucifix he is nothing and takes his place far off and silent with respect.

name.en: Ways to hold and end him

description.id: Menurut Van Helsing, cabang mawar liar pada petinya menahannya agar tidak bergerak dari sana, peluru suci yang ditembakkan ke peti membunuhnya, dan pancang atau kepala yang dipenggal memberinya ketenangan.
description.en: According to Van Helsing, a branch of wild rose on his coffin keeps him from moving from it, a sacred bullet fired into the coffin kills him, and a stake or a cut-off head gives him rest.

description.id: Para pemburu mengumpulkan bukti letak peti-peti berisi tanah asalnya agar dapat menguduskannya dengan hosti dan menutup semua tempat istirahatnya.
description.en: The hunters gather evidence of where his coffins of native soil are so that they can consecrate them with a eucharistic wafer and deny him all of his resting places.

role.en: Title antagonist

summary.id: Sang Count menahan Jonathan Harker di kastelnya, lalu menaiki kapal Demeter dengan membawa peti-peti tanahnya. Para pemburu vampir melacak peti-petinya dengan tujuan menguduskannya, dan mengikutinya kembali ke Transylvania, tempat ia dihancurkan.
summary.en: The Count keeps Jonathan Harker prisoner in his castle, then boards the Demeter taking his boxes of earth. The vampire hunters track his boxes in order to consecrate them and follow him back to Transylvania, where he is destroyed.

description.id: Kediaman sang Count di Pegunungan Karpatia dekat Borgo Pass; Harker menemukan bahwa wilayahnya berada di timur, di perbatasan Transylvania, Moldavia, dan Bukovina.
description.en: The Count's home in the Carpathian Mountains near the Borgo Pass; Harker finds that the district lies in the extreme east, on the borders of Transylvania, Moldavia and Bukovina.

description.id: Kota tempat kapal Demeter kandas dan seekor anjing besar melompat ke pantai lalu menuju pemakaman gereja di tebing.
description.en: The town where the Demeter ran aground and an immense dog leapt ashore and headed for the churchyard on the cliff.

description.en: A place amongst the mountains over Lake Hermanstadt where, according to Van Helsing, the Draculas learned the secrets of the Evil One.

description.id: Novel Dracula karya Bram Stoker pertama kali terbit di Britania Raya, memperkenalkan sang Count.
description.en: Bram Stoker's novel Dracula was first published in Great Britain, introducing the Count.

note.id: Wikipedia menyebut adanya hubungan penting antara sang Count dan Renfield, pasien rumah sakit jiwa.

description.en: Wikipedia says Christopher Lee starred as Dracula in numerous Hammer Horror films and fixed the image of the vampire with dual elongated fangs in popular culture.

description.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Count Dracula, yang biasa disebut Drac, adalah tokoh utama waralaba Hotel Transylvania.

traditional.id: Menurut Encyclopedia.com, novel Stoker merangkum banyak kisah vampir yang telah ada sejak zaman kuno ke dalam tokoh sang Count.
traditional.en: According to Encyclopedia.com, Stoker's novel synthesized much of the vampire lore that had existed since ancient times into the character of the Count.

modern.id: Encyclopedia.com menyebut banyak orang yang mengenal sang vampir lewat film atau televisi bahkan tidak tahu siapa Stoker, dan film telah membayangi novelnya.

statement.en: Harker sees a tall old man, clean shaven except for a long white moustache, clad in black from head to foot.

claims.quote: He can transform himself to wolf, as we gather from the ship arrival in Whitby, when he tear open the dog; he can be as bat, as Madam Mina saw him on the window at Whitby ... He can come in mist which he create

statement.en: According to Van Helsing, the Count can transform himself into a wolf, a bat, and a mist that he creates, as he gathers from the ship's arrival in Whitby.

statement.en: Harker again sees the Count go out in lizard fashion, moving downwards in a sidelong way some hundred feet down and a good deal to the left.

claims.quote: The Draculas were, says Arminius, a great and noble race, though now and again were scions who were held by their coevals to have had dealings with the Evil One. They learned his secrets in the Scholomance, amongst the mountains over Lake Hermanstadt

statement.id: Menurut Van Helsing, mengutip Arminius, keluarga Dracula adalah bangsa yang agung dan mulia, dan sebagian keturunannya dianggap berurusan dengan si Jahat serta mempelajari rahasianya di Scholomance di pegunungan di atas Danau Hermanstadt.
statement.en: According to Van Helsing, citing Arminius, the Draculas were a great and noble race, some of whose scions were held to have had dealings with the Evil One and learned his secrets in the Scholomance amongst the mountains over Lake Hermanstadt.

claims.quote: He must, indeed, have been that Voivode Dracula who won his name against the Turk, over the great river on the very frontier of Turkey-land.

statement.id: Van Helsing menyimpulkan bahwa sang Count pastilah Voivode Dracula yang memenangkan namanya melawan bangsa Turki di seberang sungai besar di perbatasan negeri Turki.
statement.en: Van Helsing concludes that the Count must have been that Voivode Dracula who won his name against the Turk, over the great river on the very frontier of Turkey-land.

claims.quote: I find that the district he named is in the extreme east of the country, just on the borders of three states, Transylvania, Moldavia and Bukovina, in the midst of the Carpathian mountains; one of the wildest and least known portions of Europe.

statement.id: Harker mendapati bahwa wilayah yang disebut sang Count berada di ujung timur negeri itu, di perbatasan Transylvania, Moldavia, dan Bukovina, di tengah Pegunungan Karpatia, salah satu bagian Eropa yang paling liar dan paling kurang dikenal.
statement.en: Harker finds that the district the Count named lies in the extreme east of the country, on the borders of Transylvania, Moldavia and Bukovina, in the midst of the Carpathian mountains, one of the wildest and least known portions of Europe.

claims.quote: But, on the instant, came the sweep and flash of Jonathan’s great knife. I shrieked as I saw it shear through the throat; whilst at the same moment Mr. Morris’s bowie knife plunged into the heart. It was like a miracle; but before our very eyes, and almost in the drawing of a breath, the whole body crumbled into dust and passed from our sight.

statement.id: Pisau besar Jonathan menebas leher sang Count dan pisau bowie Mr. Morris menembus jantungnya, lalu seluruh tubuhnya hancur menjadi debu dan lenyap dari pandangan.
statement.en: Jonathan's great knife shears through the Count's throat and Mr. Morris's bowie knife plunges into his heart, and the whole body crumbles into dust and passes from sight.

claims.quote: “We Szekelys have a right to be proud, for in our veins flows the blood of many brave races who fought as the lion fights, for lordship.

statement.id: Sang Count berkata kepada Harker bahwa kaum Székely berhak bangga karena dalam urat mereka mengalir darah banyak bangsa pemberani.
statement.en: The Count tells Harker that the Székelys have a right to be proud because in their veins flows the blood of many brave races.

claims.quote: The nosferatu do not die like the bee when he sting once. He is only stronger; and being stronger, have yet more power to work evil.

statement.id: Van Helsing mengatakan bahwa nosferatu tidak mati seperti lebah yang menyengat sekali, melainkan menjadi lebih kuat dan lebih berkuasa untuk berbuat jahat.
statement.en: Van Helsing says the nosferatu do not die like the bee that stings once but only grow stronger, with yet more power to work evil.

claims.quote: Dracula, by Abraham Stoker—who generally published under the abbreviated first name Bram—was first published in Great Britain in 1897.

statement.id: Dracula karya Abraham Stoker, yang biasanya menerbitkan karya dengan nama depan singkat Bram, pertama kali terbit di Britania Raya pada 1897.
statement.en: Dracula, by Abraham Stoker, who generally published under the abbreviated first name Bram, was first published in Great Britain in 1897.

claims.quote: Although myths and legends about vampires had existed since ancient times, Stoker's novel synthesized much of this lore and gave it a palpable feeling in the character of Count Dracula.

statement.id: Meskipun mitos dan legenda tentang vampir sudah ada sejak zaman kuno, novel Stoker merangkum banyak kisah itu dan memberinya wujud nyata dalam tokoh Count Dracula.
statement.en: Although myths and legends about vampires had existed since ancient times, Stoker's novel synthesized much of this lore and gave it a palpable feeling in the character of Count Dracula.

claims.quote: Dracula has limited motion during the day, consumes only human blood, must pass over water in certain ways, has no reflection, must sleep on soil from his own land, has power over certain animals and weather, and has the power to turn others into vampires.

statement.id: Menurut ringkasan tokoh ini, sang Count bergerak terbatas pada siang hari, hanya meminum darah manusia, harus melintasi air dengan cara tertentu, tidak berpantulan, harus tidur di atas tanah dari negerinya sendiri, berkuasa atas hewan dan cuaca tertentu, serta dapat mengubah orang lain menjadi vampir.
statement.en: According to this character summary, Dracula has limited motion during the day, consumes only human blood, must pass over water in certain ways, has no reflection, must sleep on soil from his own land, has power over certain animals and weather, and can turn others into vampires.

claims.quote: However, most critics agree that Dracula was based in part on a historical figure, Vlad the Impaler, a fifteenth-century Romanian ruler known for his indiscriminate brutality

statement.id: Menurut Encyclopedia.com, sebagian besar kritikus sepakat bahwa Dracula sebagian didasarkan pada tokoh sejarah Vlad si Penusuk, penguasa Rumania abad kelima belas yang dikenal karena kekejamannya.
statement.en: According to Encyclopedia.com, most critics agree that Dracula was based in part on a historical figure, Vlad the Impaler, a fifteenth-century Romanian ruler known for his indiscriminate brutality.

claims.quote: While films, most notably the 1931 film Dracula, starring Bela Lugosi, have overshadowed the book, they have also helped to keep the story alive.

statement.id: Film, terutama film Dracula 1931 yang dibintangi Bela Lugosi, telah membayangi novelnya, tetapi juga membantu menjaga kisahnya tetap hidup.
statement.en: Films, most notably the 1931 film Dracula starring Bela Lugosi, have overshadowed the book, but have also helped to keep the story alive.

claims.quote: is a fictional character and title antagonist of Bram Stoker's gothic horror novel Dracula (1897). He is considered the prototypical and archetypal vampire in subsequent works of fiction.

statement.id: Count Dracula adalah tokoh fiksi dan antagonis utama novel horor gotik Dracula (1897) karya Bram Stoker, dan dianggap vampir purwarupa dan arketipal dalam karya fiksi sesudahnya.
statement.en: Count Dracula is a fictional character and the title antagonist of Bram Stoker's gothic horror novel Dracula (1897), considered the prototypical and archetypal vampire in subsequent works of fiction.

claims.quote: Count Dracula is an undead, centuries-old vampire, and a Transylvanian nobleman who claims to be a Székely descended from Attila the Hun. He inhabits a decaying castle in the Carpathian Mountains near the Borgo Pass.

statement.id: Count Dracula adalah vampir mayat hidup berusia berabad-abad dan bangsawan Transylvania yang mengaku Székely keturunan Attila si Hun, dan ia mendiami sebuah kastel yang lapuk di Pegunungan Karpatia dekat Borgo Pass.
statement.en: Count Dracula is an undead, centuries-old vampire and a Transylvanian nobleman who claims to be a Székely descended from Attila the Hun, and he inhabits a decaying castle in the Carpathian Mountains near the Borgo Pass.

claims.quote: Stoker came across the name Dracula in his reading on Romanian history, and chose this to replace the name (Count Wampyr) that he had originally intended to use for his villain.

statement.id: Stoker menemukan nama Dracula dalam bacaannya tentang sejarah Rumania, dan memilihnya untuk menggantikan nama Count Wampyr yang semula hendak ia pakai bagi tokoh penjahatnya.
statement.en: Stoker came across the name Dracula in his reading on Romanian history and chose it to replace the name Count Wampyr that he had originally intended to use for his villain.

claims.quote: was dubbed Dracul ("dragon" or "devil"), thus his son became Dracula ("of the dragon").
claims.locator: Modern and postmodern analyses of the character

statement.id: Wikipedia menjelaskan bahwa nama Dracul berarti "naga" atau "setan", sehingga putranya menjadi Dracula ("dari sang naga"); penjelasan ini berkaitan dengan nama keluarga tokoh sejarah.
statement.en: Wikipedia explains that the name Dracul meant "dragon" or "devil", so the son became Dracula ("of the dragon"); this explanation concerns the family name of a historical figure.

claims.quote: Shakespearean actor and friend of Stoker's Sir Henry Irving is widely considered to be a real-life inspiration for the character of Dracula.

statement.id: Aktor Shakespeare Sir Henry Irving, sahabat Stoker, dianggap luas sebagai inspirasi dunia nyata bagi tokoh Dracula.
statement.en: The Shakespearean actor and friend of Stoker, Sir Henry Irving, is widely considered a real-life inspiration for the character of Dracula.

claims.quote: Some Dracula scholars, led by Elizabeth Miller, have questioned the depth of this connection as early as 1998. They argue that Stoker in fact knew little of the historic Vlad III
claims.locator: Modern and postmodern analyses of the character

statement.id: Sebagian pakar Dracula, yang dipimpin Elizabeth Miller, sejak 1998 meragukan kedalaman hubungan dengan tokoh sejarah Vlad III dan berpendapat bahwa Stoker sebenarnya tahu sedikit tentang dia.
statement.en: Some Dracula scholars, led by Elizabeth Miller, have questioned the depth of the connection with the historic Vlad III since 1998 and argue that Stoker in fact knew little of him.

claims.quote: discovers that Dracula purchased multiple real estate properties throughout London under the alias 'Count De Ville'.

statement.id: Wikipedia menyebut bahwa Dracula membeli beberapa properti di London dengan nama samaran Count De Ville.
statement.en: Wikipedia states that Dracula purchased multiple real estate properties throughout London under the alias Count De Ville.

claims.quote: Christopher Lee starred as Dracula in numerous Hammer Horror films. Shown here is the 1958 film Dracula. Lee fixed the image of the vampire bearing dual elongated fangs in popular culture.
claims.locator: Character development subsequent to the novel

statement.id: Christopher Lee membintangi banyak film Hammer Horror sebagai Dracula, termasuk film Dracula 1958, dan menetapkan citra vampir bertaring panjang ganda dalam budaya populer.
statement.en: Christopher Lee starred as Dracula in numerous Hammer Horror films, including the 1958 film Dracula, and fixed the image of the vampire bearing dual elongated fangs in popular culture.

claims.quote: In 1922, Max Schreck starred as Count Orlok (an adaptation of Count Dracula) in Nosferatu.
claims.locator: Character development subsequent to the novel

statement.en: In 1922 Max Schreck starred as Count Orlok, an adaptation of Count Dracula, in Nosferatu.

claims.quote: Count Dracula, commonly referred to as "Drac", is the main character of the Hotel Transylvania franchise, voiced by Adam Sandler in the first three movies and by Brian Hull in the fourth movie.
claims.locator: Character development subsequent to the novel

statement.id: Count Dracula, yang biasa disebut Drac, adalah tokoh utama waralaba Hotel Transylvania, disuarakan oleh Adam Sandler dalam tiga film pertama dan Brian Hull dalam film keempat.
statement.en: Count Dracula, commonly referred to as Drac, is the main character of the Hotel Transylvania franchise, voiced by Adam Sandler in the first three movies and by Brian Hull in the fourth.

claims.quote: Count Dracula is an old vampire who keeps Jonathan Harker prisoner in his castle and who ultimately tries to relocate to London and create a race of vampires.

statement.id: Count Dracula adalah vampir tua yang menahan Jonathan Harker di kastelnya dan pada akhirnya berusaha pindah ke London dan menciptakan ras vampir.
statement.en: Count Dracula is an old vampire who keeps Jonathan Harker prisoner in his castle and ultimately tries to relocate to London and create a race of vampires.

claims.quote: the group of hunters slowly gather evidence to show where Dracula's many coffins containing his native soil are located, so that they can consecrate them with a eucharistic wafer and deny Dracula all of his resting places.

statement.id: Kelompok pemburu mengumpulkan bukti letak banyak peti sang Count yang berisi tanah asalnya agar dapat menguduskannya dengan hosti ekaristi dan menutup semua tempat istirahatnya.
statement.en: The group of hunters gathers evidence of where Dracula's many coffins containing his native soil are located so that they can consecrate them with a eucharistic wafer and deny him all of his resting places.

claims.quote: His nemesis Abraham Van Helsing speculates that he and Vlad the Impaler may be one and the same

statement.id: Wikipedia menyebut Abraham Van Helsing sebagai musuh bebuyutan sang Count, yang menduga bahwa sang Count dan Vlad si Penusuk mungkin orang yang sama.
statement.en: Wikipedia calls Abraham Van Helsing the Count's nemesis, who speculates that the Count and Vlad the Impaler may be one and the same.

claims.quote: There is also a notable link between Dracula and Renfield, a patient in an insane asylum overseen by John Seward

statement.en: Wikipedia notes a notable link between Dracula and Renfield, a patient in an insane asylum overseen by John Seward.

claims.quote: In their exposure to Dracula and their attempts to catch him and destroy him, the various vampire hunters underscore the Victorian attitudes that were present at this time.

statement.id: Dalam pertemuan mereka dengan Dracula dan upaya menangkap serta menghancurkannya, para pemburu vampir menegaskan sikap-sikap zaman Victoria yang ada pada masa itu.
statement.en: In their exposure to Dracula and their attempts to catch him and destroy him, the various vampire hunters underscore the Victorian attitudes that were present at that time.

claims.quote: Dracula leaves his castle and boards a Russian ship, the Demeter, taking along with him the boxes, which he needs to regain his strength and rest during daylight.

statement.id: Menurut ringkasan Wikipedia, sang Count meninggalkan kastelnya dan menaiki kapal Rusia Demeter dengan membawa peti-peti yang ia perlukan untuk memulihkan kekuatan dan beristirahat pada siang hari.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia's summary, Dracula leaves his castle and boards a Russian ship, the Demeter, taking along the boxes he needs to regain his strength and rest during daylight.

claims.quote: The heroes follow Dracula back to Transylvania, and in a climactic battle with Dracula's Romani bodyguards, finally destroy him.

statement.id: Menurut ringkasan Wikipedia, para pahlawan mengikuti Dracula kembali ke Transylvania dan, dalam pertempuran puncak melawan pengawal Romani sang Count, akhirnya menghancurkannya.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia's summary, the heroes follow Dracula back to Transylvania and, in a climactic battle with his Romani bodyguards, finally destroy him.
