alternate_names.name: High Priest of the Great Old Ones

text.id: Tokoh sastra yang diperkenalkan dalam cerpen yang terbit di majalah Weird Tales pada 1928.
text.en: A literary character introduced in a short story published in the magazine Weird Tales in 1928.

short_description.id: Cthulhu adalah entitas kosmik fiktif ciptaan H. P. Lovecraft dalam cerpen "The Call of Cthulhu" (1928), digambarkan sebagai makhluk raksasa berkepala bertentakel yang menunggu sambil bermimpi di R'lyeh.
short_description.en: Cthulhu is a fictional cosmic entity created by H. P. Lovecraft in the short story "The Call of Cthulhu" (1928), depicted as a gigantic being with a tentacled head who waits dreaming in R'lyeh.

long_description.id: Cthulhu adalah tokoh sastra, bukan makhluk dari cerita rakyat atau agama. Ia diciptakan oleh H. P. Lovecraft dan diperkenalkan dalam cerpen "The Call of Cthulhu", yang terbit di majalah pulp Weird Tales pada 1928. Wikipedia menyebutnya Great Old One dan nama bagi Cthulhu Mythos, sedangkan peneliti Corbacho Carrobles menggolongkan gaya Lovecraft sebagai kengerian kosmik, bukan lagi Gotik, karena teror dalam kisahnya berasal dari entitas asing yang berada di luar pemahaman manusia.
long_description.en: Cthulhu is a literary character, not a figure of folklore or religion. He was created by H. P. Lovecraft and introduced in the short story "The Call of Cthulhu", published in the pulp magazine Weird Tales in 1928. Wikipedia calls him a Great Old One and the namesake of the Cthulhu Mythos, while the researcher Corbacho Carrobles describes Lovecraft's style as cosmic horror rather than Gothic, since the terror in his tales relates to alien entities from beyond human understanding.

long_description.id: Dalam cerpen itu, patung kecil Cthulhu digambarkan sebagai monster berbentuk samar mirip manusia dengan kepala seperti gurita yang wajahnya berupa gumpalan sulur, tubuh bersisik dan berkesan seperti karet, cakar besar pada kaki depan dan belakang, serta sayap panjang yang sempit di belakang. Narator juga menyebut ukiran yang membuatnya membayangkan gurita, naga, dan karikatur manusia sekaligus, dengan kepala bertentakel yang gembung. Wikipedia menyebut ia digambarkan raksasa, ratusan meter tingginya, dalam wujud humanoid hijau yang memuat unsur gurita dan naga, sedangkan Corbacho Carrobles menyebutnya perpaduan ganjil dari berbagai konsep yang sulit digolongkan.
long_description.en: In the story, a small statue of Cthulhu is described as a monster of vaguely anthropoid outline with a head like an octopus whose face is a cluster of feelers, a scaly body that looks rubbery, enormous claws on its hind and front feet, and narrow wings at the back. The narrator also describes a carving that made him imagine an octopus, a dragon, and a human caricature at once, with a pulpy, tentacled head. Wikipedia says he is depicted as gigantic, hundreds of meters tall, in a green humanoid form incorporating elements of an octopus and a dragon, while Corbacho Carrobles calls him an odd blend of several concepts that resists easy definition or classification.

long_description.id: Menurut cerita, para pemuja menyembah Great Old Ones yang hidup berabad-abad sebelum ada manusia dan datang dari langit. Mereka menyanyikan bahwa di rumahnya di R'lyeh, Cthulhu yang mati menunggu sambil bermimpi. Para Great Old Ones berbaring di rumah-rumah batu di kota R'lyeh, diawetkan oleh mantra Cthulhu yang perkasa sampai saat kebangkitan ketika bintang-bintang kembali tepat. Cthulhu juga disebut sebagai imam agung yang kelak akan bangkit dari rumahnya di kota di bawah air. Menurut Wikipedia, ia adalah makhluk jahat yang tidur di R'lyeh, kota bawah laut di Pasifik Selatan, dan dipuja oleh banyak kultus manusia serta makhluk lain seperti Deep Ones dan Mi-Go. Dalam cerita ditegaskan bahwa tidak ada manusia yang pernah melihat Great Old Ones, dan arca ukiran itu adalah Cthulhu.
long_description.en: According to the story, cultists worship the Great Old Ones, beings who existed ages before humanity and arrived from the sky. They chant that in his house at R'lyeh dead Cthulhu waits dreaming. The Great Old Ones lie in R'lyeh, their great city of stone houses, kept intact by mighty Cthulhu's spells until the stars are right again for a glorious resurrection. Cthulhu is also called the great priest who is to rise from his dark house in the city under the waters. According to Wikipedia, he is a malevolent entity hibernating in R'lyeh, an underwater city in the South Pacific, worshipped by many human cults and by other monsters such as the Deep Ones and the Mi-Go. The story stresses that no man had ever seen the Old Ones, and the carven idol was great Cthulhu.

long_description.id: Dalam bagian akhir cerpen, Cthulhu terbangun dan, dalam kata-kata narator, "Benda itu tidak dapat dilukiskan" dan "sebuah gunung berjalan atau terhuyung". Setelah vigintillions tahun, ia lepas lagi, lalu meluncur ke air dan mengejar dengan ayunan besar yang menimbulkan gelombang. Johansen memacu kapalnya menabrak langsung makhluk itu; tubuhnya tercerai-berai, tetapi kemudian berkumpul kembali dalam wujud aslinya. Menurut Corbacho Carrobles, bagian ini menyingkap bahwa mimpi sang seniman bermula pada saat gempa dan badai membuat kota makam R'lyeh naik dari kedalaman.
long_description.en: In the story's final section, Cthulhu awakens and, in the narrator's words, "The Thing can not be described" and "A mountain walked or stumbled". After vigintillions of years he is loose again, then slides into the water and pursues with vast wave-raising strokes. Johansen drives his vessel head on against the creature; its form is scattered but then nebulously recombines in its hateful original form. According to Corbacho Carrobles, this part reveals that the artist's dreams began at the very time earthquakes and storms made the ancient tomb city of R'lyeh arise from the depths.

long_description.id: Setelah cerpen pertamanya, Cthulhu dirujuk dalam karya Lovecraft lain, termasuk novela At the Mountains of Madness (1931) yang menyebut "star-spawn of Cthulhu". August Derleth memakai namanya untuk menyebut sistem cerita Cthulhu Mythos dan menyusun kerangka tersendiri yang menempatkan Cthulhu sebagai salah satu Water Elementals yang bermusuhan dengan Hastur; Houellebecq mengkritik Derleth karena mengubah kelanjutan cerita Lovecraft yang sepenuhnya amoral menjadi pertentangan baik dan jahat yang stereotipikal.
long_description.en: After his first story, Cthulhu is referred to in other Lovecraft works, including the novella At the Mountains of Madness (1931), which mentions the "star-spawn of Cthulhu". August Derleth used his name to identify the system of lore called the Cthulhu Mythos and proposed a scheme of his own that makes Cthulhu one of the Water Elementals in an age-old rivalry with Hastur; Houellebecq criticizes Derleth for reshaping Lovecraft's strictly amoral continuity into a stereotypical conflict between objective good and evil.

cultural_context.id: Menurut Corbacho Carrobles, monster dalam Cthulhu Mythos berasal dari luar waktu dan ruang dan selalu dipakai untuk melambangkan kerapuhan dan ketidakberartian umat manusia.
cultural_context.en: Corbacho Carrobles writes that the Mythos monsters originate outside time and space and always stand for humanity's frailty and insignificance.

literal_meaning.id: Nama rekaan Lovecraft pada 1926 yang kemungkinan dipilih untuk menggemakan kata chthonic, dari bahasa Yunani Kuno yang berarti "dari bumi". Menurut Lovecraft, lafal yang ia tuliskan hanyalah yang terdekat yang dapat dicapai alat ucap manusia untuk meniru suku kata bahasa asing.
literal_meaning.en: A name invented by Lovecraft in 1926, probably chosen to echo the word chthonic, from Ancient Greek "of the earth". According to Lovecraft, his transcribed pronunciation is merely the closest the human vocal apparatus can come to reproducing the syllables of an alien language.

who.id: Entitas kosmik fiktif dan Great Old One ciptaan H. P. Lovecraft.
who.en: A fictional cosmic entity and Great Old One created by H. P. Lovecraft.

origin.id: Diperkenalkan dalam cerpen "The Call of Cthulhu" yang terbit di Weird Tales pada 1928.
origin.en: Introduced in the short story "The Call of Cthulhu", published in Weird Tales in 1928.

role.id: Dalam cerita, ia dipuja para pemuja sebagai imam agung Great Old Ones yang menunggu sambil bermimpi di R'lyeh sampai bintang-bintang kembali tepat.
role.en: In the story he is worshipped by cultists as the great priest who waits dreaming in R'lyeh until the stars are right again.

famous_for.id: Gambar siluetnya yang bertentakel menjadi citra utama karya-karya yang terinspirasi Lovecraft, dan namanya dipakai untuk Cthulhu Mythos.
famous_for.en: His tentacled silhouette is the main image of works inspired by Lovecraft, and his name is used for the Cthulhu Mythos.

did_you_know.id: Menurut Wikipedia, beberapa organisme dinamai menurut Cthulhu, termasuk laba-laba California Pimoa cthulhu, ngengat Speiredonia cthulhui dari Papua Nugini, dan Sollasina cthulhu, echinodermata fosil.
did_you_know.en: Wikipedia notes organisms named for Cthulhu, among them a California spider (Pimoa cthulhu), a New Guinea moth (Speiredonia cthulhui), and a fossil echinoderm (Sollasina cthulhu).

description.id: Setelah kapal menabraknya, tubuh makhluk itu tercerai-berai tetapi tampak menyatu kembali dalam wujud aslinya yang dibenci.
description.en: After the ship rams him, the creature's scattered form is seen nebulously recombining in its hateful original form.

description.id: Dalam cerita, para Great Old Ones berbicara kepada orang-orang peka dengan membentuk mimpi mereka; Corbacho Carrobles mencatat bahwa lewat mimpi buruk sang makhluk berhubungan dengan manusia.
description.en: In the story, the Great Old Ones spoke to the sensitive by molding their dreams; Corbacho Carrobles notes that it is through nightmares that the creature gets in touch with people.

description.id: Menurut Wikipedia, usianya digambarkan paling sedikit "vigintillions of years" dan ia disebut melontarkan mantra yang mengawetkan Great Old Ones sampai kebangkitan mereka.
description.en: According to Wikipedia, his age is described as at least "vigintillions of years" and he is said to have cast spells which preserved the Great Old Ones until their reawakening.

role.id: Entitas yang dipuja dan akhirnya terbangun
role.en: The worshipped entity who finally awakens

summary.id: Narator menelusuri patung, mimpi, dan kultus yang berpusat pada Cthulhu. Dalam bagian akhir, kota R'lyeh naik dari laut, Cthulhu terbangun, mengejar kapal para pelaut, dan tubuhnya yang tercerai-berai menyatu kembali setelah ditabrak.
summary.en: The narrator traces statues, dreams, and a cult centred on Cthulhu. In the final section the city of R'lyeh rises from the sea, Cthulhu awakens, pursues the sailors' ship, and his scattered form recombines after being rammed.

role.en: Mentioned through the "star-spawn of Cthulhu"

summary.id: Menurut Wikipedia, novela ini menyebut "star-spawn of Cthulhu" yang berperang dengan ras lain bernama Elder Things sebelum fajar manusia.
summary.en: Per Wikipedia, the novella mentions Cthulhu's "star-spawn", who fought a race called the Elder Things before humans appeared.

title.id: "The Dunwich Horror" (1928) dan The Whisperer in Darkness (1930)
title.en: "The Dunwich Horror" (1928) and The Whisperer in Darkness (1930)

role.en: Referred to

summary.id: Menurut Wikipedia, "The Dunwich Horror" merujuk Cthulhu, sedangkan The Whisperer in Darkness mengisyaratkan bahwa salah satu tokohnya mengetahui asal makhluk itu.
summary.en: According to Wikipedia, "The Dunwich Horror" refers to Cthulhu, while The Whisperer in Darkness hints that one of its characters knows the creature's origins.

description.id: Kota batu raksasa di bawah air tempat Cthulhu menunggu sambil bermimpi; menurut Wikipedia, kota bawah laut di Pasifik Selatan.
description.en: The great stone city under the waters where Cthulhu waits dreaming; according to Wikipedia, an underwater city in the South Pacific.

description.id: Wikipedia menyebut banyak kultus manusia pemuja Cthulhu, termasuk di Selandia Baru, Greenland, Louisiana, dan pegunungan Tiongkok.
description.en: Wikipedia names many human cults worshipping Cthulhu, including some within New Zealand, Greenland, Louisiana, and the Chinese mountains.

description.id: Menurut Wikipedia, nama Cthulhu diciptakan Lovecraft pada 1926.
description.en: According to Wikipedia, the name Cthulhu was invented by Lovecraft in 1926.

description.id: "The Call of Cthulhu" terbit di Weird Tales, memperkenalkan Cthulhu.
description.en: "The Call of Cthulhu" was published in Weird Tales, introducing Cthulhu.

description.id: Novela ini merujuk "star-spawn of Cthulhu".
description.en: The novella refers to the "star-spawn of Cthulhu".

description.id: August Derleth menulis serangkaian cerita pendek di Weird Tales yang dikumpulkan sebagai The Trail of Cthulhu.
description.en: August Derleth wrote a series of short stories in Weird Tales collected as The Trail of Cthulhu.

note.id: Wikipedia menyebut Cthulhu sebagai Great Old One dalam jajaran entitas kosmik Lovecraftian.
note.en: Wikipedia considers Cthulhu a Great Old One within the pantheon of Lovecraftian cosmic entities.

note.id: Wikipedia mencantumkan Azathoth sebagai kakek buyut dari pihak silsilah Cthulhu.
note.en: Wikipedia lists Azathoth as Cthulhu's great-great-grandfather.

note.id: Wikipedia mencantumkan Yog-Sothoth sebagai kakek Cthulhu.
note.en: Wikipedia lists Yog-Sothoth as Cthulhu's grandfather.

note.id: Wikipedia mencantumkan Shub-Niggurath sebagai nenek Cthulhu.
note.en: Wikipedia lists Shub-Niggurath as Cthulhu's grandmother.

note.id: Wikipedia mencantumkan Nug sebagai orang tua Cthulhu.
note.en: Wikipedia lists Nug as Cthulhu's parent.

note.id: Dalam skema August Derleth, Cthulhu bersaing sejak lama dengan Hastur, yang disebut sebagai saudara tirinya.
note.en: In August Derleth's scheme, Cthulhu is in an age-old arch-rivalry with Hastur, described as his half-brother.

note.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Deep Ones termasuk makhluk Lovecraftian yang memuja Cthulhu.
note.en: According to Wikipedia, the Deep Ones are among the Lovecraftian monsters who worship Cthulhu.

note.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Mi-Go termasuk makhluk Lovecraftian yang memuja Cthulhu.
note.en: According to Wikipedia, the Mi-Go are among the Lovecraftian monsters who worship Cthulhu.

description.id: Serangkaian cerita pendek Derleth di Weird Tales (1944–1952) tentang perjuangan Dr. Laban Shrewsbury dan rekan-rekannya melawan Cthulhu dan para pengikutnya.
description.en: Derleth's series of short stories in Weird Tales (1944–1952) depicting the struggle of Dr. Laban Shrewsbury and his associates against Cthulhu and his minions.

description.id: Menurut Wikipedia, perusahaan TSR menyertakan satu bab penuh tentang mitos Cthulhu, termasuk statistik karakter, dalam cetakan pertama buku sumber ini.
description.en: According to Wikipedia, the company TSR included an entire chapter on the Cthulhu mythos, including character statistics, in the first printing of this sourcebook.

modern_depictions.title: Comics and graphic novels from The Call of Cthulhu (Michael Zigerlig)

description.id: Corbacho Carrobles menganalisis adaptasi cerpen ini ke dalam komik dan novel grafis kontemporer, khususnya karya seniman Swiss Michael Zigerlig.
description.en: Corbacho Carrobles analyzes adaptations of the tale into contemporary comics and graphic novels, in particular the one by Swiss writer and artist Michael Zigerlig.

modern_depictions.title: Cthulhu as a parody candidate in elections

description.id: Wikipedia mencatat bahwa Cthulhu muncul sebagai kandidat parodi dalam beberapa pemilu, termasuk pemilihan presiden Polandia 2010 serta pemilihan presiden AS 2012 dan 2016.
description.en: Wikipedia notes that Cthulhu has appeared as a parody candidate in several elections, including the 2010 Polish presidential election and the 2012 and 2016 US presidential elections.

learning_questions.en: What makes cosmic horror different from a Gothic ghost story?

learning_questions.id: Mengapa Cthulhu begitu mudah dikenali lewat siluet kepala bertentakelnya?
learning_questions.en: Why is Cthulhu so easily recognized through the silhouette of his tentacled head?

learning_questions.id: Bagaimana pendapat Derleth dan Houellebecq berbeda tentang dunia cerita Lovecraft?
learning_questions.en: How do Derleth's and Houellebecq's views of Lovecraft's story-world differ?

sources.author: H. P. Lovecraft

claims.quote: It represented a monster of vaguely anthropoid outline, but with an octopus-like head whose face was a mass of feelers, a scaly, rubbery-looking body, prodigious claws on hind and fore feet, and long, narrow wings behind.
claims.locator: Part I, The Horror in Clay (the small statue)

statement.id: Patung kecil itu menggambarkan monster berbentuk samar mirip manusia dengan kepala seperti gurita yang wajahnya berupa gumpalan sulur, tubuh bersisik dan berkesan seperti karet, cakar besar pada kaki depan dan belakang, dan sayap panjang yang sempit di belakang.
statement.en: The small statue represented a monster of vaguely anthropoid outline, with an octopus-like head whose face was a mass of feelers, a scaly, rubbery-looking body, prodigious claws on hind and fore feet, and long, narrow wings behind.

claims.quote: If I say that my somewhat extravagant imagination yielded simultaneous pictures of an octopus, a dragon, and a human caricature, I shall not be unfaithful to the spirit of the thing. A pulpy, tentacled head surmounted a grotesque and scaly body with rudimentary wings
claims.locator: Part I, The Horror in Clay (the carving)

statement.id: Narator berkata bahwa membayangkan gurita, naga, dan karikatur manusia sekaligus tidak mengkhianati semangat benda itu, dengan kepala bertentakel yang gembung di atas tubuh ganjil bersisik yang bersayap kasar.
statement.en: The narrator says that imagining an octopus, a dragon, and a human caricature at once would not be unfaithful to the spirit of the thing, with a pulpy, tentacled head surmounting a grotesque and scaly body with rudimentary wings.

claims.quote: They worshiped, so they said, the Great Old Ones who lived ages before there were any men, and who came to the young world out of the sky.
claims.locator: Part II, The Tale of Inspector Legrasse

statement.id: Para pemuja dalam cerita mengaku menyembah Great Old Ones yang hidup berabad-abad sebelum ada manusia dan datang ke dunia muda dari langit.
statement.en: The cultists in the story say they worshiped the Great Old Ones who lived ages before there were any men and came to the young world out of the sky.

claims.quote: The chant meant only this: “In his house at R’lyeh dead Cthulhu waits dreaming.”
claims.locator: Part II, The Tale of Inspector Legrasse

statement.id: Nyanyian para pemuja berarti hanya ini: di rumahnya di R'lyeh, Cthulhu yang mati menunggu sambil bermimpi.
statement.en: The cultists' chant meant only this: in his house at R'lyeh dead Cthulhu waits dreaming.

claims.quote: They all lay in stone houses in Their great city of R’lyeh, preserved by the spells of mighty Cthulhu for a glorious resurrection when the stars and the earth might once more be ready for Them.
claims.locator: Part II, The Tale of Inspector Legrasse

statement.id: Para Great Old Ones semuanya berbaring di rumah-rumah batu di kota besar mereka, R'lyeh, diawetkan oleh mantra Cthulhu yang perkasa untuk kebangkitan mulia ketika bintang-bintang dan bumi kembali siap bagi mereka.
statement.en: They all lay in stone houses in their great city of R'lyeh, preserved by the spells of mighty Cthulhu for a glorious resurrection when the stars and the earth might once more be ready for them.

claims.quote: until the time when the great priest Cthulhu, from his dark house in the mighty city of R’lyeh under the waters, should rise and bring the earth again beneath his sway.
claims.locator: Part II, The Tale of Inspector Legrasse

statement.id: Kultus itu tersembunyi sampai saatnya imam agung Cthulhu bangkit dari rumah gelapnya di kota perkasa R'lyeh di bawah air dan membawa bumi kembali di bawah kekuasaannya.
statement.en: The cult remains hidden until the time when the great priest Cthulhu, from his dark house in the mighty city of R'lyeh under the waters, should rise and bring the earth again beneath his sway.

claims.quote: the Great Old Ones spoke to the sensitive among them by molding their dreams; for only thus could Their language reach the fleshly minds of mammals.
claims.locator: Part II, The Tale of Inspector Legrasse

statement.id: Dalam cerita, para Great Old Ones berbicara kepada orang-orang peka dengan membentuk mimpi mereka, karena hanya begitu bahasa mereka dapat mencapai pikiran berdaging mamalia.
statement.en: In the story, the Great Old Ones spoke to the sensitive among men by molding their dreams, for only thus could their language reach the fleshly minds of mammals.

claims.quote: The Thing of the idols, the green, sticky spawn of the stars, had awaked to claim his own. The stars were right again ... After vigintillions of years great Cthulhu was loose again, and ravening for delight.
claims.locator: Part III, The Madness from the Sea

statement.id: Benda dari arca-arca itu, keturunan bintang yang hijau dan lengket, terbangun untuk menuntut miliknya; bintang-bintang kembali tepat dan setelah vigintillions tahun Cthulhu yang agung lepas lagi dan rakus akan kesenangan.
statement.en: The Thing of the idols, the green, sticky spawn of the stars, had awaked to claim his own; the stars were right again and after vigintillions of years great Cthulhu was loose again and ravening for delight.

claims.quote: The Thing can not be described—there is no language for such abysms of shrieking and immemorial lunacy, such eldritch contradictions of all matter, force, and cosmic order. A mountain walked or stumbled.
claims.locator: Part III, The Madness from the Sea

statement.id: Narasi menyatakan bahwa Benda itu tidak dapat dilukiskan karena tidak ada bahasa untuk jurang teriakan dan kegilaan yang demikian, dan sebuah gunung berjalan atau terhuyung.
statement.en: The narration states that the Thing cannot be described, as there is no language for such abysms of shrieking and immemorial lunacy, and that a mountain walked or stumbled.

claims.quote: great Cthulhu slid greasily into the water and began to pursue with vast wave-raising strokes of cosmic potency.
claims.locator: Part III, The Madness from the Sea

statement.id: Cthulhu yang agung meluncur licin ke dalam air dan mulai mengejar dengan ayunan besar yang menimbulkan gelombang dengan daya kosmik.
statement.en: Great Cthulhu slid greasily into the water and began to pursue with vast wave-raising strokes of cosmic potency.

claims.quote: the brave Norwegian drove his vessel head on against the pursuing jelly which rose above the unclean froth like the stern of a demon galleon. ... the scattered plasticity of that nameless sky-spawn was nebulously recombining in its hateful original form
claims.locator: Part III, The Madness from the Sea

statement.id: Pelaut Norwegia yang gagah berani memacu kapalnya langsung menabrak jeli yang mengejar; kemudian plastisitas yang tercerai-berai dari anak langit tanpa nama itu tampak menyatu kembali secara samar dalam wujud aslinya yang dibenci.
statement.en: The brave Norwegian drove his vessel head on against the pursuing jelly; afterwards the scattered plasticity of that nameless sky-spawn was nebulously recombining in its hateful original form.

claims.quote: No man had ever seen the Old Ones. The carven idol was great Cthulhu, but none might say whether or not the others were precisely like him.
claims.locator: Part II, The Tale of Inspector Legrasse

statement.id: Menurut cerita, tidak ada manusia yang pernah melihat Great Old Ones; arca ukiran itu adalah Cthulhu yang agung, tetapi tak seorang pun dapat mengatakan apakah yang lain persis seperti dia.
statement.en: According to the story, no man had ever seen the Old Ones; the carven idol was great Cthulhu, but none might say whether or not the others were precisely like him.

claims.quote: That cult would never die till the stars came right again, and the secret priests would take great Cthulhu from His tomb to revive His subjects and resume His rule of earth.
claims.locator: Part II, The Tale of Inspector Legrasse

statement.id: Kultus itu tidak akan mati sampai bintang-bintang kembali tepat, dan para imam rahasia akan mengeluarkan Cthulhu yang agung dari makamnya untuk menghidupkan kembali para pengikutnya dan melanjutkan kekuasaannya atas bumi.
statement.en: That cult would never die till the stars came right again, and the secret priests would take great Cthulhu from his tomb to revive his subjects and resume his rule of earth.

claims.quote: The style in which Lovecraft writes is no longer considered Gothic, but cosmic horror. The main reasons are mainly that the terror depicted in Lovecraft's tales is not focused on ghosts or that sort of creatures, but rather it is related to alien entities from beyond human understanding.

statement.id: Corbacho Carrobles menyatakan bahwa gaya Lovecraft tidak lagi dianggap Gotik melainkan kengerian kosmik, karena teror dalam kisahnya berkaitan dengan entitas asing dari luar pemahaman manusia, bukan hantu.
statement.en: Corbacho Carrobles states that Lovecraft's style is no longer considered Gothic but cosmic horror, because the terror in his tales relates to alien entities from beyond human understanding rather than to ghosts.

claims.quote: The monsters in the Cthulhu Mythos come from beyond time and space and are always used to represent the feebleness and meaninglessness of mankind.

statement.id: Menurut Corbacho Carrobles, monster dalam Cthulhu Mythos datang dari luar waktu dan ruang dan selalu dipakai untuk melambangkan kerapuhan dan ketidakberartian umat manusia.
statement.en: Corbacho Carrobles writes that the Mythos monsters originate outside time and space and always stand for humanity's frailty and insignificance.

claims.quote: They are hybrid beings, as Cthulhu, a grotesque amalgam of different concepts, never easy to define or categorize, designed to create ambiguity

statement.id: Corbacho Carrobles menyebut makhluk-makhluk itu sebagai makhluk campuran, seperti Cthulhu, perpaduan ganjil dari berbagai konsep yang tidak mudah ditakrifkan atau digolongkan dan dirancang untuk menciptakan ambiguitas.
statement.en: Corbacho Carrobles calls these creatures hybrid beings, like Cthulhu, a grotesque amalgam of different concepts, never easy to define or categorize, designed to create ambiguity.

claims.quote: Cthulhu, being the best known creature from Lovecraft's imaginary pantheon, is almost a coat of arms for anything branded after him. The sinister silhouette of a gargantuan dragon-like creature with a pulpy head rising from the depths is the main image to be found in anything inspired by Lovecraft's works

statement.id: Menurut Corbacho Carrobles, Cthulhu adalah makhluk paling dikenal dari panteon rekaan Lovecraft, dan siluet makhluk raksasa mirip naga berkepala gembung yang bangkit dari kedalaman adalah citra utama dalam segala karya yang terinspirasi Lovecraft.
statement.en: According to Corbacho Carrobles, Cthulhu is the best known creature from Lovecraft's imaginary pantheon, and the silhouette of a gargantuan dragon-like creature with a pulpy head rising from the depths is the main image in anything inspired by Lovecraft's works.

claims.quote: The climax of the tale unveils during its last part, with the words of the late Sailor Gustaf Johansen as we learn that the dreams of the artist begin at the very same time as earthquakes and storms made the ancient tomb city of Cthulhu, R'lyeh, arise from the depths.

statement.id: Puncak cerita terungkap pada bagian akhir lewat kata-kata mendiang pelaut Gustaf Johansen, yaitu bahwa mimpi sang seniman bermula pada saat yang sama ketika gempa dan badai membuat kota makam kuno Cthulhu, R'lyeh, naik dari kedalaman.
statement.en: The climax of the tale unfolds in its last part through the words of the late sailor Gustaf Johansen, as we learn the artist's dreams began at the very time earthquakes and storms made Cthulhu's ancient tomb city, R'lyeh, arise from the depths.

claims.quote: The weird tales of the Cthulhu Mythos have become the axis for, not only a never ending amount of tales from renowned authors, but also for video-games, films, role-playing games, or graphic novels.

statement.id: Cerita-cerita aneh Cthulhu Mythos telah menjadi poros bukan hanya bagi tak terhitung kisah dari penulis ternama, tetapi juga bagi gim video, film, gim peran, dan novel grafis.
statement.en: The weird tales of the Cthulhu Mythos have become the axis not only for a never-ending number of tales by renowned authors but also for video-games, films, role-playing games, and graphic novels.

claims.quote: My research involves the most renowned tale by the master of modern horror H.P. Lovecraft, The call of Cthulhu, and its adaptations into contemporary comics and graphic novels, in particular the one by Swiss writer/artist Michael Zigerlig.

statement.id: Penelitian ini membahas kisah paling terkenal karya H.P. Lovecraft, The Call of Cthulhu, dan adaptasinya ke dalam komik dan novel grafis kontemporer, khususnya karya penulis dan seniman Swiss Michael Zigerlig.
statement.en: The research concerns H.P. Lovecraft's most renowned tale, The Call of Cthulhu, and its adaptations into contemporary comics and graphic novels, in particular the one by the Swiss writer and artist Michael Zigerlig.

claims.quote: And it is through nightmares that the creature gets in touch with the people of the world as we understand when reading the tale.

statement.id: Corbacho Carrobles mencatat bahwa lewat mimpi buruk sang makhluk berhubungan dengan orang-orang di dunia, seperti yang kita pahami saat membaca kisahnya.
statement.en: Corbacho Carrobles notes that it is through nightmares that the creature gets in touch with the people of the world, as we understand when reading the tale.

claims.quote: Cthulhu is a fictional cosmic entity created by writer H. P. Lovecraft. The character was introduced in his short story "The Call of Cthulhu", published by the American pulp magazine Weird Tales in 1928.

statement.id: Cthulhu adalah entitas kosmik fiktif ciptaan penulis H. P. Lovecraft, yang diperkenalkan dalam cerpen "The Call of Cthulhu" yang diterbitkan majalah pulp Amerika Weird Tales pada 1928.
statement.en: Cthulhu is a fictional cosmic entity created by writer H. P. Lovecraft, introduced in his short story "The Call of Cthulhu", published by the American pulp magazine Weird Tales in 1928.

claims.quote: Considered a Great Old One within the pantheon of Lovecraftian cosmic entities, he is depicted as a gigantic entity worshipped by cultists, in a green humanoid form incorporating visual elements similar to an octopus and dragon.

statement.id: Cthulhu dianggap Great Old One dalam panteon entitas kosmik Lovecraftian, digambarkan sebagai entitas raksasa yang dipuja para pemuja, dalam wujud humanoid hijau yang memuat unsur visual mirip gurita dan naga.
statement.en: Considered a Great Old One within the pantheon of Lovecraftian cosmic entities, Cthulhu is depicted as a gigantic entity worshipped by cultists, in a green humanoid form incorporating visual elements similar to an octopus and dragon.

claims.quote: Invented by Lovecraft in 1926, the name Cthulhu was probably chosen to echo the word chthonic (Ancient Greek "of the earth")

statement.id: Nama Cthulhu diciptakan Lovecraft pada 1926 dan kemungkinan dipilih untuk menggemakan kata chthonic (Yunani Kuno "dari bumi").
statement.en: The name Cthulhu was invented by Lovecraft in 1926 and was probably chosen to echo the word chthonic (Ancient Greek "of the earth").

claims.quote: According to Lovecraft, this is merely the closest that the human vocal apparatus can come to reproducing the syllables of an alien language.

statement.id: Menurut Lovecraft, lafal yang ia tuliskan hanyalah yang terdekat yang dapat dicapai alat ucap manusia untuk meniru suku kata bahasa asing.
statement.en: According to Lovecraft, his transcribed pronunciation is merely the closest that the human vocal apparatus can come to reproducing the syllables of an alien language.

claims.quote: Cthulhu is said to be hundreds of meters tall, with webbed, human-looking arms and legs. Its head is depicted as similar to the entirety of a gigantic octopus, with an unknown number of tentacles surrounding its supposed mouth.

statement.id: Cthulhu disebut setinggi ratusan meter dengan lengan dan kaki berselaput yang tampak seperti manusia, dan kepalanya digambarkan mirip seluruh tubuh gurita raksasa dengan sejumlah tentakel yang tidak diketahui jumlahnya mengelilingi mulutnya.
statement.en: Cthulhu is said to be hundreds of meters tall, with webbed, human-looking arms and legs, and his head is depicted as similar to the entirety of a gigantic octopus with an unknown number of tentacles surrounding his supposed mouth.

claims.quote: His age is described to be at least "vigintillions of years". He is also said to have cast spells which preserved the Great Old Ones until their reawakening.

statement.id: Usianya digambarkan paling sedikit "vigintillions of years", dan ia juga disebut telah melontarkan mantra yang mengawetkan Great Old Ones sampai kebangkitan mereka.
statement.en: His age is described as at least "vigintillions of years", and he is also said to have cast spells which preserved the Great Old Ones until their reawakening.

claims.quote: was published in Weird Tales in 1928, and established the character as a malevolent entity, hibernating within R'lyeh, an underwater city in the South Pacific.

short_description.id: Oceanus adalah dewa Titan Yunani yang melambangkan sungai air tawar besar yang dipercaya mengelilingi bumi.
short_description.en: Oceanus is a Greek Titan deity personifying a great freshwater river believed to encircle the earth.

long_description.id: Oceanus adalah Titan tertua, anak Uranus dan Gaia, serta suami Tethys. Ia adalah dewa dan personifikasi sungai air tawar Oceanus yang dipercaya mengelilingi bumi dan menjadi sumber semua dewa dan makhluk hidup, walau dalam mitologi awal ia sering dipandang sebagai unsur, bukan dewa. Sumber air dari mata air, sumur, dan sungai berasal darinya, dan ia dikatakan mengatur benda-benda langit yang terbit dari dan terbenam ke perairannya. Tethys diperkirakan dibayangkan membagikan air penghidupannya ke seluruh bumi melalui akuifer bawah tanah.
long_description.en: Oceanus is the eldest Titan, child of Uranus and Gaia and husband of Tethys. He is the god and personification of the freshwater river Oceanus, believed to encircle the earth and to be the source of all gods and living creatures, although in early mythology he was often viewed as an element rather than a god. The waters of springs, wells, and rivers came from him, and he is said to have regulated the heavenly bodies that rose from and set into his waters. Tethys was probably envisioned distributing his nourishing waters across the earth through underground aquifers.

long_description.id: Anak-anak Oceanus dan Tethys mencakup dewa-dewa sungai dan nimfa sumber air, antara lain Sungai Styx, Inachos raja Argos, serta para Oceanid seperti Eurynome, Electra, Metis, dan Theia; Homer menyebut tiga putri, yaitu Thetis, Eurynome, dan Perse. Ia dikatakan tinggal di tepi barat bumi dan tidak pernah meninggalkan rumahnya, bahkan untuk sidang para dewa. Dalam puisi Homerik ia tampil sebagai dewa perkasa yang tidak tunduk kepada siapa pun kecuali Zeus.
long_description.en: The children of Oceanus and Tethys include river gods and spring nymphs, among them the River Styx, Inachos the king of Argos, and Oceanids such as Eurynome, Electra, Metis, and Theia; Homer names three daughters, Thetis, Eurynome, and Perse. Tradition places his home on the western shores of the earth, and he never left it, even when the gods assembled. In the Homeric poems he is a mighty god, second only to Zeus.

long_description.id: Oceanus tidak ikut mengebiri Uranus dan tidak bertempur langsung dalam Titanomakhia, sehingga tidak dipenjara di Tartarus, meski ia mengirim putrinya Styx dan anak-anaknya ke pihak Zeus. Ia juga tampil dalam kisah Hercules, yang menakutinya dengan busur hingga ia menenangkan ombak, dan dalam Prometheus Bound, tempat ia bersimpati kepada Prometheus. Bersama Tethys ia menyucikan Glaucus dari sifat fananya.
long_description.en: Oceanus did not take part in the castration of Uranus and did not personally fight in the Titanomachy, so he was not imprisoned in Tartarus, though he sent his daughter Styx and her children to the side of Zeus. He also appears in the story of Hercules, who frightened him with a bow into calming the waves, and in Prometheus Bound, where he sympathises with Prometheus. With Tethys he cleansed Glaucus of his mortal characteristics.

long_description.id: Dalam seni Yunani Oceanus digambarkan dengan ekor ikan panjang, torso manusia, dan kepala bertanduk, memegang tongkat kerajaan, dengan ikan dan ular sebagai atribut; sungai Oceanus juga ditunjukkan di tepi perisai Achilles buatan Hephaestus. Pada era Helenistik ia dibayangkan ulang sebagai dewa samudra, dan dalam seni mozaik ia digambarkan sebagai dewa laut bertanduk capit kepiting. Sumber modern menyatakan belum ada bukti kultus khusus bagi Oceanus, tetapi ia memiliki satu himne Orfik, dan samudra dinamai dengan namanya.
long_description.en: In Greek art Oceanus appears with a human upper body, a horned head, and a long fish's tail, holding a sceptre, with a fish and serpent as attributes; the Oceanus river is also shown on the edges of Achilles' shield made by Hephaestus. In the Hellenistic era he was reimagined as a god of the oceans, and in mosaic art he appears as a sea-god with crab-claw horns. A modern source reports no evidence of a dedicated Oceanus cult, but he has an Orphic Hymn, and the ocean is named after him.

cultural_context.id: Pemujaan dewa-dewa sungai bersifat lokal, dan tidak ada bukti kultus khusus bagi Oceanus; ia tampil dalam Himne-himne Orfik sebagai pencipta manusia fana dan para dewa.
cultural_context.en: Worship of river gods was local, and there is no evidence of a dedicated cult of Oceanus; he is featured in the Orphic Hymns as creator of mortal men and gods.

statement.en: Theoi calls Oceanus the primordial Titan god of the earth-encircling river.

claims.quote: Their children were the Potamoi, gods of rivers, and the Okeanides (Oceanids), nymphs of springs and fountains.

statement.id: Anak-anak Oceanus dan Tethys mencakup dewa sungai Potamoi serta nimfa Okeanides.
statement.en: The children of Oceanus and Tethys include the river gods Potamoi and the nymphs Okeanides.

claims.quote: Okeanos was depicted in ancient Greek vase painting as a bull-horned god with the tail of a serpentine fish

statement.id: Lukisan vas menampilkan Oceanus bertanduk banteng dan berekor ikan menyerupai ular.
statement.en: Vase painting depicts Oceanus with bull horns and a serpentine fish tail.

claims.quote: The ancient Greeks believed that there was a great, wide, flowing stream that surrounded the earth. They called the stream Ocean.

statement.id: The Met juga mencatat kepercayaan Yunani tentang arus besar Ocean yang mengelilingi bumi.
statement.en: The Met also notes the Greek belief in a great encircling stream called Ocean.

claims.quote: font of all of the earth's fresh-water - rivers, wells, springs and rain-clouds. He was also the god who regulated the heavenly bodies which rose from and set into his waters.

statement.id: Okeanos adalah sumber seluruh air tawar bumi (sungai, sumur, mata air, dan awan hujan) dan dewa yang mengatur benda-benda langit yang terbit dari dan terbenam ke perairannya.
statement.en: Okeanos was the font of all the earth's fresh water (rivers, wells, springs, and rain-clouds) and the god who regulated the heavenly bodies that rose from and set into his waters.

claims.quote: Unlike his Titan-brothers Okeanos did not participate in the castration of their father Ouranos nor join the war against Zeus and the Olympian gods.

statement.id: Berbeda dari saudara-saudara Titannya, Okeanos tidak ikut mengebiri ayah mereka, Ouranos, dan tidak bergabung dalam perang melawan Zeus dan para dewa Olimpus.
statement.en: Unlike his Titan brothers, Okeanos did not take part in the castration of their father Ouranos nor join the war against Zeus and the Olympian gods.

claims.quote: Okeanos was probably identical to Ophion, an elder Titan in the Orphic myths who ruled heaven briefly before being wrestled and cast into the Ocean stream by Kronos (Cronus).

statement.id: Okeanos mungkin identik dengan Ophion, Titan yang lebih tua dalam mitos Orfik yang sebentar memerintah langit sebelum dikalahkan dan dilempar ke aliran Ocean oleh Kronos.
statement.en: Okeanos was probably identical to Ophion, an elder Titan in the Orphic myths who ruled heaven briefly before being wrestled and cast into the Ocean stream by Kronos.

claims.quote: His usual attributes were a fish and serpent.

statement.id: Atribut yang lazim bagi Okeanos adalah ikan dan ular.
statement.en: His usual attributes were a fish and serpent.

claims.quote: In the Hellenistic era, Okeanos was reimagined as the god of the then increasingly accessible Atlantic and Indian Oceans, and the old cosmological idea of a great, earth-encircling, fresh-water stream was discarded.

statement.id: Pada era Helenistik, Okeanos dibayangkan ulang sebagai dewa Samudra Atlantik dan Hindia yang makin mudah dijangkau, dan gagasan kosmologis lama tentang aliran air tawar yang mengelilingi bumi ditinggalkan.
statement.en: In the Hellenistic era Okeanos was reimagined as the god of the increasingly accessible Atlantic and Indian Oceans, and the old cosmological idea of an earth-encircling fresh-water stream was discarded.

claims.quote: In mosaic art he is therefore usually depicted as a sea-god or the sea itself personified, with crab-claw horns, and for attributes, a serpent, oar and school of fish.

statement.id: Dalam seni mozaik ia biasanya digambarkan sebagai dewa laut atau laut yang dipersonifikasikan, bertanduk capit kepiting, dengan atribut ular, dayung, dan kawanan ikan.
statement.en: In mosaic art he is usually depicted as a sea-god or the sea itself personified, with crab-claw horns and, as attributes, a serpent, oar, and school of fish.

claims.quote: Okeanos' wife Tethys "the Nurse" was probably envisioned distributing his nourishing waters across the earth through subterranean acquifers.

statement.id: Istri Okeanos, Tethys "Sang Pengasuh", mungkin dibayangkan membagikan air penghidupannya ke seluruh bumi melalui akuifer bawah tanah.
statement.en: Okeanos' wife Tethys "the Nurse" was probably envisioned distributing his nourishing waters across the earth through subterranean aquifers.

claims.quote: In the Homeric poems he appears as a mighty god, who yields to none save Zeus.

statement.id: Dalam puisi Homerik, Okeanos tampil sebagai dewa perkasa yang tidak tunduk kepada siapa pun kecuali Zeus.
statement.en: In the Homeric poems he appears as a mighty god who yields to none save Zeus.

claims.quote: Homer does not mention his parentage, but calls Tethys his wife, by whom he had three daughters, Thetis, Eurynome and Perse.

statement.id: Homer tidak menyebut orang tuanya, tetapi menyebut Tethys istrinya dan mereka memiliki tiga putri: Thetis, Eurynome, dan Perse.
statement.en: Homer does not mention his parentage but calls Tethys his wife, by whom he had three daughters, Thetis, Eurynome, and Perse.

claims.quote: [1.2] AITHER (or OURANOS) & GAIA (Hyginus Preface)

statement.id: Menurut Hyginus (Preface), orang tua Oceanus adalah Aither (atau Ouranos) dan Gaia.
statement.en: In Hyginus (Preface), Oceanus's parents are Aither (or Ouranos) and Gaia.

claims.quote: He was said to dwell on the western shores of the earth and never left his home, not even to attend the assemblies of the gods.

statement.id: Oceanus dikatakan tinggal di tepi barat bumi dan tidak pernah meninggalkan rumahnya, bahkan untuk menghadiri sidang para dewa.
statement.en: Oceanus was said to dwell on the western shores of the earth and never left his home, not even to attend the assemblies of the gods.

claims.quote: which was thought to encircle the earth and was said to be the source of all living gods and creatures. However, in early mythology, Oceanus was often viewed as an element rather than a god.

statement.id: Sungai Oceanus dianggap mengelilingi bumi dan dikatakan sumber semua dewa dan makhluk hidup; namun dalam mitologi awal Oceanus sering dipandang sebagai unsur, bukan dewa.
statement.en: The river Oceanus was thought to encircle the earth and was said to be the source of all living gods and creatures; in early mythology, however, Oceanus was often viewed as an element rather than a god.

claims.quote: so he did not share their dreadful fate of being imprisoned in Tartarus (the deepest part of the underworld). As a reward, Oceanus was allowed to rule over Oceanus in undisturbed peace.

statement.id: Karena tidak ikut bertempur, Oceanus tidak mengalami nasib buruk dipenjara di Tartarus; sebagai ganjaran ia dibiarkan memerintah Oceanus dengan damai.
statement.en: Because he did not fight, Oceanus did not share the dreadful fate of imprisonment in Tartarus; as a reward he was allowed to rule over Oceanus in undisturbed peace.

claims.quote: In an attempt to stop Hercules from reaching his grandson, Oceanus caused great waves to overcome the golden vessel that Hercules clung to. Hercules drew his bow and frightened Oceanus into calming the waters so he could reach Erytheia safely.

statement.id: Untuk menghentikan Hercules mencapai cucunya, Oceanus menimbulkan ombak besar yang menimpa kapal emas tempat Hercules berpegangan; Hercules menarik busurnya dan menakuti Oceanus hingga menenangkan air sehingga ia tiba dengan selamat di Erytheia.
statement.en: To stop Hercules from reaching his grandson, Oceanus caused great waves to overcome the golden vessel Hercules clung to; Hercules drew his bow and frightened Oceanus into calming the waters so he could reach Erytheia safely.

claims.quote: In Prometheus Bound, Prometheus, the Titan god of fire and brother and son-in-law to Oceanus, lies chained to a rock as punishment from Zeus after Prometheus gave fire to humankind

statement.id: Dalam Prometheus Bound, Prometheus, Titan api dan saudara sekaligus menantu Oceanus, terbelenggu pada batu sebagai hukuman Zeus setelah memberi api kepada manusia.
statement.en: In Prometheus Bound, Prometheus, Titan god of fire and brother and son-in-law to Oceanus, lies chained to a rock as Zeus's punishment after giving fire to humankind.

claims.quote: Oceanus travels to where Prometheus lies in chains and sympathised with his plight, telling him that even beyond their blood relation, there is nobody he is more fond of.

statement.id: Oceanus mendatangi Prometheus yang terbelenggu dan bersimpati pada nasibnya, mengatakan bahwa di luar hubungan darah pun tak ada yang lebih ia sayangi.
statement.en: Oceanus travels to where Prometheus lies in chains and sympathises with his plight, saying that even beyond their blood relation there is nobody he is more fond of.

claims.quote: The chorus is sung by Oceanus' many children who step onto the stage to welcome their father, who enters on a giant bird, most likely a griffin.

statement.id: Paduan suara dinyanyikan banyak anak Oceanus yang menyambut ayah mereka, yang masuk ke panggung dengan menunggang burung raksasa, kemungkinan griffin.
statement.en: The chorus is sung by Oceanus' many children, who welcome their father as he enters on a giant bird, most likely a griffin.

claims.quote: Glaucus was a fisherman who was transformed into a sea god. ... with Oceanus and Tethys purging him of all his mortal characteristics and performing a ritual cleansing.

statement.id: Oceanus dan Tethys membersihkan Glaucus dari seluruh sifat fananya dan melakukan ritual penyucian.
statement.en: Oceanus and Tethys purged Glaucus of all his mortal characteristics and performed a ritual cleansing.

claims.quote: As described in the Iliad, Oceanus is featured on Achilles' shield, which Hephaestus, the god of metallurgy, made. The Oceanus river was shown on the shield's edges, surrounding all the other images depicted on the shield.

statement.id: Seperti dalam Iliad, Oceanus tampil pada perisai Achilles buatan Hephaestus; sungai Oceanus ditunjukkan di tepi perisai, mengelilingi semua gambar lainnya.
statement.en: As described in the Iliad, Oceanus is featured on Achilles' shield, made by Hephaestus; the Oceanus river is shown on the shield's edges, surrounding all the other images.

claims.quote: He holds a sceptre to represent his power and rides on a sea creature alone or by the side of his wife, Tethys.

statement.id: Dalam seni Yunani ia memegang tongkat kerajaan sebagai lambang kekuasaan dan menunggang makhluk laut, sendiri atau di samping istrinya, Tethys.
statement.en: In art he holds a sceptre to represent his power and rides a sea creature alone or beside his wife Tethys.

claims.quote: He is, however, featured in The Orphic Hymns and has an Orphic Hymn dedicated to him. In the hymn, he is mentioned as being the creator of mortal men and gods.

statement.id: Oceanus tampil dalam Himne-himne Orfik dan memiliki satu himne khusus; dalam himne itu ia disebut pencipta manusia fana dan para dewa.
statement.en: Oceanus is featured in The Orphic Hymns and has an Orphic Hymn dedicated to him, in which he is called the creator of mortal men and gods.

claims.quote: Oceanus was given the ultimate honour of having the largest body of saltwater that encircles the earth named after him

statement.id: Oceanus mendapat kehormatan tertinggi: badan air asin terbesar yang mengelilingi bumi dinamai dengan namanya.
statement.en: Oceanus was given the ultimate honour of having the largest body of saltwater that encircles the earth named after him.

claims.quote: On the far side of Oceanus lay strange, mysterious places like the Garden of the Hesperides and the island of Erytheia.

statement.id: Di seberang Oceanus terletak tempat-tempat aneh dan misterius seperti Taman Hesperides dan pulau Erytheia.
statement.en: On the far side of Oceanus lay strange, mysterious places like the Garden of the Hesperides and the island of Erytheia.

claims.quote: Their most well-known children were the River Styx (the barrier between earth and the underworld), Inachos, the king of Argos, and the Oceanids Eurynome, Electra, Metis (Zeus' first notable wife), and Theia.

statement.id: Anak-anak mereka yang paling terkenal adalah Sungai Styx, Inachos raja Argos, dan para Oceanid Eurynome, Electra, Metis, dan Theia.
statement.en: Their best-known children were the River Styx, Inachos the king of Argos, and the Oceanids Eurynome, Electra, Metis, and Theia.

claims.quote: His siblings include Cronus, Hyperion, Mnemosyne, Rhea, Tethys, and Themis.

statement.id: Saudara-saudaranya antara lain Cronus, Hyperion, Mnemosyne, Rhea, Tethys, dan Themis.
statement.en: His siblings include Cronus, Hyperion, Mnemosyne, Rhea, Tethys, and Themis.

claims.quote: Helios, the sun god, lived in the east, near the banks of Oceanus.

statement.id: Helios, dewa matahari, tinggal di timur dekat tepi Oceanus.
statement.en: Helios, the sun god, lived in the east, near the banks of Oceanus.

summary.id: Oceanus adalah putra Uranus dan Gaia.
summary.en: Oceanus is a son of Uranus and Gaia.

summary.id: Dalam Hyginus (Preface), orang tuanya Aither (atau Ouranos) dan Gaia.
summary.en: In Hyginus (Preface), his parents are Aither (or Ouranos) and Gaia.

summary.id: Homer tidak menyebut orang tuanya.
summary.en: Homer does not mention his parentage.

summary.id: 3.000 putri bersama Tethys (nimfa darat dan air).
summary.en: 3,000 daughters with Tethys (nymphs of land and water).

summary.id: Homer menyebut tiga putri: Thetis, Eurynome, dan Perse.
summary.en: Homer names three daughters: Thetis, Eurynome, and Perse.

summary.id: Oceanus tidak ikut campur secara langsung dalam konflik itu.
summary.en: Oceanus did not personally get involved in the conflict.

summary.id: Namun ia mengirim putrinya Styx dan anak-anaknya ke pihak Zeus.
summary.en: However, he sent his daughter Styx and her children to Zeus' side.

short_description.id: Helios adalah dewa matahari Yunani yang mengendarai kereta emas melintasi langit setiap hari.
short_description.en: Helios is the Greek sun god who drives a golden chariot across the sky each day.

long_description.id: Helios adalah dewa matahari Yunani, anak Hyperion dan Theia serta saudara Selene dan Eos. Ia dikisahkan membawa matahari dari timur ke barat dengan kereta emas yang ditarik empat kuda bersayap, dan juga disebut penjaga sumpah serta dewa penglihatan. Ia tinggal di istana emas di Sungai Okeanos di ujung bumi, lalu menyeberang kembali ke tempat terbitnya dengan cawan emas atau, menurut penyair kemudian, perahu emas buatan Hephaestus.
long_description.en: Helios is the Greek sun god, child of Hyperion and Theia and brother of Selene and Eos. He is said to carry the sun east to west in a golden chariot drawn by four winged horses, and is also called a guardian of oaths and god of sight. His golden palace stood in the River Okeanos at the earth's far ends, and he returned to his rising place in a golden cup or, according to later poets, a golden boat made by Hephaestus.

long_description.id: Ia digambarkan sebagai pria tampan, biasanya tak berjanggut, berjubah ungu dan bermahkota lingkar cahaya matahari; dalam seni Yunani dan Romawi ia biasanya pemuda bermahkota sinar matahari. Helios diidentifikasi dengan dewa api dan cahaya lain seperti Hephaistos dan Phoibos Apollon, dan kaitan Apollo dengan Matahari makin kuat sejak periode Helenistik. Ia disebut mengetahui segalanya: ia membongkar kepada Hephaestus ketidaksetiaan Aphrodite dan memberi tahu Demeter tentang penculikan putrinya, tetapi tidak tahu bahwa kawan-kawan Odysseus mencuri sapinya sampai diberi tahu oleh Lampetia.
long_description.en: He was depicted as a handsome, usually beardless man in purple robes, crowned with the shining aureole of the sun; in Greek and Roman art he is usually a youth wearing a crown of sun rays. Helios was identified with other gods of fire and light such as Hephaistos and Phoibos Apollon, and the link between Apollo and the Sun grew stronger from the Hellenistic period. He is said to know everything: he betrayed Aphrodite's faithlessness to Hephaestus and told Demeter of the carrying off of her daughter, yet was unaware that the companions of Odysseus robbed his oxen until Lampetia informed him.

long_description.id: Putranya, Phaethon, mencoba mengendarai kereta matahari, tetapi gagal menguasai kuda-kudanya, membakar bumi, dan disambar petir Zeus. Sapi keramat Helios di Thrinacia pernah dicuri raksasa Alkyoneus dan dibalas Hercules; kemudian kawan-kawan Odysseus memakan sebagian kawanannya, sehingga Helios meminta bantuan Zeus yang menghancurkan kapal dan menenggelamkan awaknya. Ketika Hercules mengancam menembaknya karena terik matahari, Helios justru menghadiahinya mangkuk emas. Helios juga memiliki anak dari Perseis, yaitu Circe dan Aietes.
long_description.en: His son Phaethon tried to drive the sun chariot but could not control its horses, set the earth ablaze, and was struck down by Zeus's thunderbolt. The sacred cattle of Helios on Thrinacia were once stolen by the giant Alkyoneus and avenged by Hercules; later the comrades of Odysseus ate part of his flock, so Helios enlisted Zeus, who destroyed the ship and drowned the crew. When Hercules threatened to shoot him because of the burning sun, Helios instead rewarded him with a golden bowl. Helios also had children by Perseis, Circe and Aietes.

long_description.id: Pemujaan Helios tidak meluas, tetapi di Yunani tempat pemujaan yang penting adalah Rhodes, tempat pertandingan Halieia diadakan setiap lima tahun dan setiap tahun sebuah kereta dengan empat kuda dilemparkan ke laut sebagai persembahan. Persembahan kepadanya berupa domba jantan putih, babi hutan, banteng, kambing, anak domba, terutama kuda putih, dan madu, dan ayam jantan keramat baginya. Dalam konteks Romawi ia juga dikenal sebagai Sol. Sebuah vas Yunani di sebuah museum menuliskan namanya dalam huruf Yunani kuno, dan panduan museum itu menyebut arus Ocean yang diyakini mengelilingi bumi.
long_description.en: Worship of Helios was not widespread, but the one important place in Greece was Rhodes, where the Halieia games were held every five years and each year a chariot and four horses were thrown into the sea as an offering. Sacrificial victims included white rams, boars, bulls, goats, and lambs, with white horses singled out, and honey was offered too; the cock was sacred to him. In Roman contexts he was also known as Sol. A Greek vase in a museum bears his name in ancient Greek letters, and the museum guide describes the stream Ocean, believed to encircle the earth.

cultural_context.id: Pemujaan Helios tidak meluas di Yunani; menurut Plato banyak orang, termasuk Socrates, menyambut Matahari dan berdoa setiap hari, sedangkan di Rhodes ia dipuja dengan pertandingan dan persembahan kereta.
cultural_context.en: Worship of Helios was not widespread in Greece; according to Plato many people, including Socrates, greeted the Sun and prayed daily, while on Rhodes he was honored with games and the offering of a chariot.

who.id: Helios adalah dewa matahari dalam mitologi Yunani.
who.en: Helios is the god of the Sun in Greek mythology.

origin.id: Helios adalah anak Titan Hyperion dan Theia.
origin.en: Helios is the offspring of the titans Hyperion and Theia.

role.id: Helios mengendarai kereta emas yang membawa Matahari melintasi langit setiap hari.
role.en: Helios rode a golden chariot that brought the Sun across the skies each day.

famous_for.id: Helios terkenal sebagai subjek Colossus of Rhodes dan sebagai ayah Phaethon.
famous_for.en: Helios is famous as the subject of the Colossus of Rhodes and as the father of Phaethon.

did_you_know.id: Hercules pernah mengancam menembak Helios karena terik matahari, tetapi Helios justru menghadiahinya mangkuk emas untuk berlayar lebih nyaman.
did_you_know.en: Hercules once threatened to shoot Helios over the burning sun, but Helios instead gave him a golden bowl to sail more comfortably.

description.id: Helios membawa matahari melintasi langit dengan kereta emas yang ditarik empat kuda bersayap.
description.en: Helios carries the sun across the sky in a golden chariot drawn by four winged horses.

description.id: Helios digambarkan sebagai dewa yang melihat dan mendengar segalanya, sehingga dapat membongkar ketidaksetiaan Aphrodite kepada Hephaestus dan penculikan putri Demeter.
description.en: Helios is described as the god who sees and hears everything, so he could reveal Aphrodite's faithlessness to Hephaestus and the carrying off of Demeter's daughter.

name.en: Guardian of oaths and god of sight

description.id: Helios disebut dewa Titan matahari, penjaga sumpah, dan dewa penglihatan.
description.en: Helios is called the Titan god of the sun, a guardian of oaths, and the god of sight.

description.id: Atas perlakuan terhadap ternaknya, Helios meminta bantuan Zeus yang menghancurkan kapal dan menenggelamkan awak Odysseus.
description.en: For the treatment of his flock, Helios enlisted Zeus, who destroyed the ship and drowned the crew of Odysseus.

name.en: Unaware of the theft of his oxen

description.id: Walaupun digambarkan melihat dan mendengar segalanya, Helios tidak tahu kawan-kawan Odysseus mencuri sapinya sampai diberi tahu oleh Lampetia.
description.en: Although described as seeing and hearing everything, Helios was unaware that Odysseus' companions had robbed his oxen until Lampetia informed him.

description.id: Dalam konteks Romawi Helios juga dikenal sebagai Sol dan menjadi dewa kultus penting; Circus Maximus memiliki kuil untuk Sol dan Luna sejak abad ke-3 SM.
description.en: In Roman contexts Helios was also known as Sol and became an important cult god; the Circus Maximus had a temple dedicated to Sol and Luna from the 3rd century BCE.

role.en: Father of Phaethon

summary.id: Phaethon, putra Helios, mencoba mengendarai kereta matahari; ia tak mampu mengendalikan kuda-kuda itu dan Zeus menjatuhkannya dengan petir agar seluruh dunia tidak terbakar.
summary.en: Phaethon, son of Helios, tried to drive the sun chariot; he could not control the horses and Zeus struck him down with a thunderbolt lest the whole world burn.

role.en: Owner of the sacred cattle who takes revenge

summary.id: Sapi keramat Helios di Thrinacia dicuri Alkyoneus dan dibalas Hercules; kemudian kawan-kawan Odysseus memakan sebagian kawanannya, sehingga Helios meminta Zeus menghancurkan kapal mereka.
summary.en: Helios's sacred cattle on Thrinacia were stolen by Alkyoneus and avenged by Hercules; later Odysseus' comrades ate part of the flock, so Helios asked Zeus to destroy their ship.

role.en: God who rewards daring

summary.id: Hercules mengancam menembak Helios; Helios tidak menghukumnya, melainkan memberinya mangkuk emas untuk berlayar lebih nyaman.
summary.en: Hercules threatened to shoot Helios; Helios did not punish him but gave him a golden bowl to sail more comfortably.

role.en: The revealer

summary.en: The Sun god shines on Aphrodite and Ares, revealing to Hephaistos his wife's affair.

description.id: Satu-satunya tempat di Yunani tempat pemujaan Helios penting; ia pelindung pulau itu dan tempat pertandingan Halieia diadakan.
description.en: The one place in Greece where worship of Helios was important; he was the patron of the island, which held the Halieia games.

description.id: Patung perunggu raksasa Helios, dianggap salah satu Tujuh Keajaiban Dunia Kuno.
description.en: The giant bronze statue of Helios, considered one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

description.id: Pulau keramat Helios tempat kawanan sapi dan dombanya dirawat putri-putrinya.
description.en: Island sacred to Helios where his flocks were tended by his daughters.

name.en: Golden palace in the River Okeanos

description.id: Tempat tinggal Helios di ujung bumi, tempat ia muncul setiap fajar.
description.en: Helios's dwelling at the far ends of the earth, from which he emerged each dawn.

description.id: Circus Maximus di Roma memiliki kuil untuk Sol dan Luna sejak abad ke-3 SM.
