note.id: Hyperion adalah ayah Helios.
note.en: Hyperion is Helios's father.

note.id: Theia adalah ibu Helios; sumber lain menyebut ibu yang berbeda.
note.en: Theia is Helios's mother in the main account; other sources name different mothers.

note.id: Selene adalah saudari Helios.
note.en: Selene is Helios's sister.

note.id: Eos adalah saudari Helios.
note.en: Eos is Helios's sister.

note.id: Phaethon adalah putra Helios.
note.en: Phaethon is Helios's son.

note.id: Circe adalah anak Helios dengan Perseis.
note.en: Circe is a child of Helios and Perseis.

note.id: Raja Aietes adalah anak Helios dengan Perseis.
note.en: King Aietes is a child of Helios and Perseis.

note.id: Apollodorus menambahkan Pasiphae sebagai anak Helios.
note.en: Apollodorus adds Pasiphae as a child of Helios.

note.id: Helios diidentifikasi dengan Phoibos Apollon, dan Apollo dikaitkan dengan Matahari sejak abad ke-5 SM.
note.en: Helios was identified with Phoibos Apollon, and Apollo was linked with the Sun from the 5th century BCE.

note.id: Helios diidentifikasi dengan Hephaistos, dan ia membongkar perselingkuhan istri Hephaistos.
note.en: Helios was identified with Hephaistos, and he revealed the affair of Hephaistos's wife.

note.id: Helios menghadiahi Hercules mangkuk emas, dan Hercules membalas pencurian sapi Helios oleh Alkyoneus.
note.en: Helios gave Hercules a golden bowl, and Hercules avenged the theft of Helios's cattle by Alkyoneus.

note.id: Dalam konteks Romawi Helios juga dikenal sebagai Sol.
note.en: In Roman contexts Helios was also known as Sol.

claims.quote: Helios (also Helius) was the god of the Sun in Greek mythology.

statement.id: Helios adalah dewa matahari dalam mitologi Yunani.
statement.en: Helios is the Greek sun god.

claims.quote: Helios rode a golden chariot which brought the Sun across the skies each day from the east (Ethiopia) to the west (Hesperides).

statement.id: Helios mengendarai kereta emas yang membawa matahari dari timur ke barat setiap hari.
statement.en: Helios drove a golden chariot bearing the sun from east to west each day.

claims.quote: In Greek mythology, Helios is the offspring of the titans Hyperion and Theia.

statement.id: Helios adalah anak pasangan Titan Hyperion dan Theia.
statement.en: Helios is the child of the Titans Hyperion and Theia.

claims.quote: His sisters were Selene (the Moon) and Eos (Dawn).

statement.id: Saudari Helios adalah Selene sang bulan dan Eos sang fajar.
statement.en: Helios's sisters are Selene the moon and Eos the dawn.

claims.quote: Helios is also the father of Phaethon, whose mother was Clymene.

statement.id: Phaethon adalah putra Helios dan Clymene.
statement.en: Phaethon is the son of Helios and Clymene.

claims.quote: Phaethon proved unable to control Helios' wild horses, and when he spun out of control, Zeus was obliged to strike down Phaethon with a thunderbolt lest he set the whole world on fire.

statement.id: Phaethon gagal mengendalikan kuda kereta Helios; Zeus menyambarnya dengan petir agar bumi tidak terbakar.
statement.en: Phaethon lost control of Helios's horses, and Zeus struck him with lightning to avert a worldwide fire.

claims.quote: In vengeance, Helios enlisted the help of Zeus who destroyed the ship and drowned Odysseus' crew for their impiety.

statement.id: Setelah ternaknya dimakan awak Odysseus, Helios meminta Zeus menghukum mereka.
statement.en: After Odysseus's crew ate his cattle, Helios asked Zeus to punish them.

claims.quote: The one place in Greece where the worship of Helios was important was on Rhodes.

statement.id: Pemujaan Helios sangat penting di Rhodes.
statement.en: The worship of Helios was important on Rhodes.

claims.quote: In honour of Helios, Panhellenic games, the Halieia, were held on the island every five years

statement.id: Pertandingan Halieia di Rhodes diselenggarakan untuk menghormati Helios.
statement.en: The Halieia games on Rhodes honored Helios.

claims.quote: The Romans went one step further and made Helios, also known as Sol, an important cult god.

statement.id: Dalam konteks Romawi, Helios dikenal pula sebagai Sol.
statement.en: In Roman contexts Helios was also known as Sol.

claims.quote: HELIOS (Helius) was the Titan god of the sun, a guardian of oaths, and the god of sight.

statement.id: Theoi menyebut Helios dewa matahari dari golongan Titan, penjaga sumpah, dan dewa penglihatan.
statement.en: Theoi describes Helios as a Titan sun god, guardian of oaths, and god of sight.

claims.quote: he emerged each dawn, crowned with the aureole of the sun, driving a chariot drawn by four winged steeds.

statement.id: Helios muncul setiap fajar dengan mahkota cahaya dan kereta empat kuda bersayap.
statement.en: Helios appears at dawn with a solar aureole and a chariot drawn by four winged horses.

claims.quote: We can tell who Helios is on this vase because the artist wrote his name above, in ancient Greek letters.

statement.id: Sebuah vas Yunani menamai sosok Helios dalam huruf Yunani kuno.
statement.en: A Greek vase identifies Helios by writing his name in ancient Greek letters.

claims.quote: The ancient Greeks believed that there was a great, wide, flowing stream that surrounded the earth. They called the stream Ocean.

statement.id: Orang Yunani kuno membayangkan arus besar bernama Ocean mengelilingi bumi.
statement.en: Ancient Greeks imagined a great stream called Ocean encircling the earth.

claims.quote: He dwelt in a golden palace in the River Okeanos (Oceanus) at the far ends of the earth from which he emerged each dawn

statement.id: Helios tinggal di istana emas di Sungai Okeanos di ujung bumi, tempat ia muncul setiap fajar.
statement.en: Helios dwelt in a golden palace in the River Okeanos (Oceanus) at the far ends of the earth, from which he emerged each dawn.

claims.quote: When he reached the the land of the Hesperides in the far West he descended into a golden cup which bore him through the northern streams of Okeanos back to his rising place in the East.

statement.id: Sesampainya di negeri Hesperides di barat jauh, Helios turun ke dalam cawan emas yang membawanya melalui aliran utara Okeanos kembali ke tempat terbitnya di timur.
statement.en: On reaching the land of the Hesperides in the far West, Helios descended into a golden cup that bore him through the northern streams of Okeanos back to his rising place in the East.

claims.quote: Once his son Phaethon tried to drive the chariot of the sun, but he lost control and set the earth ablaze. Zeus struck the boy down with a thunderbolt.

statement.id: Putranya, Phaethon, pernah mencoba mengendarai kereta matahari, tetapi kehilangan kendali dan membakar bumi; Zeus menjatuhkan anak itu dengan petir.
statement.en: His son Phaethon once tried to drive the chariot of the sun but lost control and set the earth ablaze; Zeus struck the boy down with a thunderbolt.

claims.quote: Helios was depicted as a handsome, usually beardless, man clothed in purple robes and crowned with the shining aureole of the sun.

statement.id: Helios digambarkan sebagai pria tampan, biasanya tak berjanggut, berjubah ungu dan bermahkota lingkar cahaya matahari.
statement.en: Helios was depicted as a handsome, usually beardless man in purple robes, crowned with the shining aureole of the sun.

claims.quote: Helios was identified with several other gods of fire and light such as Hephaistos (Hephaestus) and light-bringing Phoibos Apollon (Phoebus Apollo).

statement.id: Helios diidentifikasi dengan beberapa dewa api dan cahaya lain seperti Hephaistos dan Phoibos Apollon.
statement.en: Helios was identified with several other gods of fire and light such as Hephaistos (Hephaestus) and Phoibos Apollon (Phoebus Apollo).

claims.quote: Helios is described even in the Homeric poems as the god who sees and hears every thing, but, notwithstanding this, he is unaware of the fact that the companions of Odysseus robbed his oxen, until he was informed of it by Lampetia.

statement.id: Bahkan dalam puisi Homerik Helios digambarkan sebagai dewa yang melihat dan mendengar segalanya, tetapi ia tidak tahu bahwa kawan-kawan Odysseus mencuri sapinya sampai diberi tahu oleh Lampetia.
statement.en: Even in the Homeric poems Helios is described as the god who sees and hears everything, yet he is unaware that the companions of Odysseus robbed his oxen until informed by Lampetia.

claims.quote: But, owing to his omniscience, he was able to betray to Hephaestus the faithlessness of Aphrodite, and to reveal to Demeter the carrying off of her daughter.

statement.id: Karena kemahatahuannya, Helios dapat membongkar kepada Hephaestus ketidaksetiaan Aphrodite dan memberi tahu Demeter tentang penculikan putrinya.
statement.en: Owing to his omniscience, Helios was able to betray to Hephaestus the faithlessness of Aphrodite and to reveal to Demeter the carrying off of her daughter.

claims.quote: The island of Thrinacia (Sicily) was sacred to Helios, and he there had flocks of oxen and sheep, each consisting of 350 heads, which never increased or decreased, and were attended to by his daughters Phaetusa and Lampetia.

statement.id: Pulau Thrinacia (Sisilia) keramat bagi Helios; di sana ia memiliki kawanan sapi dan domba masing-masing 350 ekor yang tidak pernah bertambah atau berkurang, dirawat putri-putrinya Phaetusa dan Lampetia.
statement.en: The island of Thrinacia (Sicily) was sacred to Helios, where he had flocks of oxen and sheep of 350 head each that never increased or decreased, tended by his daughters Phaetusa and Lampetia.

claims.quote: The sacrifices offered to Helios consisted of white rams, boars, bulls, goats, lambs, especially white horses, and honey.

statement.id: Persembahan kepada Helios berupa domba jantan putih, babi hutan, banteng, kambing, anak domba, terutama kuda putih, dan madu.
statement.en: The sacrifices offered to Helios consisted of white rams, boars, bulls, goats, lambs, especially white horses, and honey.

claims.quote: Among the animals sacred to him, the cock is especially mentioned.

statement.id: Di antara hewan yang keramat baginya, ayam jantan disebut secara khusus.
statement.en: Among the animals sacred to him, the cock is especially mentioned.

claims.quote: later poets make him sail in a golden boat round one-half of the earth, and thus arrive in the east at the point from which he has to rise again. This golden boat is the work of Hephaestus.

statement.id: Penyair kemudian membuatnya berlayar dengan perahu emas mengelilingi separuh bumi hingga tiba di titik timur tempat ia terbit lagi; perahu emas itu buatan Hephaestus.
statement.en: Later poets make him sail in a golden boat round one-half of the earth to arrive at the point in the east from which he must rise again; this golden boat is the work of Hephaestus.

claims.quote: [1.2] HYPERION & EURYPHAESSA (Homeric Hymn 31)

statement.id: Menurut Homeric Hymn 31, orang tua Helios adalah Hyperion dan Euryphaessa.
statement.en: In Homeric Hymn 31, Helios's parents are Hyperion and Euryphaessa.

claims.quote: [1.3] HYPERION & AETHRA (Hyginus Pref)

statement.id: Menurut Hyginus (Pref), orang tua Helios adalah Hyperion dan Aethra.
statement.en: In Hyginus (Preface), Helios's parents are Hyperion and Aethra.

claims.quote: Helios was famously the subject of the Colossus of Rhodes, the giant bronze statue considered one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

statement.id: Helios terkenal sebagai subjek Colossus of Rhodes, patung perunggu raksasa yang dianggap salah satu Tujuh Keajaiban Dunia Kuno.
statement.en: Helios was famously the subject of the Colossus of Rhodes, the giant bronze statue considered one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

claims.quote: Hesiod informs us in his Theogony that with Perseis, daughter of Ocean, he had two children, Circe and king Aietes, who ruled at Kolchis. Later, Apollodorus adds Pasiphae too.

statement.id: Hesiodos dalam Theogony menyebut bahwa Helios dengan Perseis, putri Ocean, memiliki dua anak, Circe dan raja Aietes yang memerintah di Kolchis; Apollodorus kemudian menambahkan Pasiphae.
statement.en: Hesiod tells in the Theogony that Helios had with Perseis, daughter of Ocean, two children, Circe and King Aietes, who ruled at Kolchis; Apollodorus later adds Pasiphae.

claims.quote: The famous sacred cattle of Helios, which he kept on Thrinacia (perhaps Sicily or Malta), were stolen once by the giant Alkyoneus, an outrageous act which was avenged by Hercules. Helios again had some of his flock attacked, and this time eaten too, by the hungry comrades of Odysseus

statement.id: Sapi keramat Helios di Thrinacia pernah dicuri raksasa Alkyoneus dan dibalas oleh Hercules; kemudian sebagian kawanannya diserang dan dimakan kawan-kawan Odysseus yang kelaparan.
statement.en: The sacred cattle of Helios on Thrinacia were once stolen by the giant Alkyoneus, avenged by Hercules; later some of his flock were attacked and eaten by Odysseus' hungry comrades.

claims.quote: Fed up with the burning sun on his outward voyage, Hercules threatened to fire one of his arrows at Helios. The god, rather than punish Hercules for his petulance, rewarded his daring by gifting him a golden bowl which he used to sail the seas in greater comfort.

statement.id: Hercules yang jengkel pada terik matahari mengancam akan menembak Helios dengan panah; Helios tidak menghukumnya, melainkan menghadiahinya mangkuk emas yang ia pakai untuk berlayar lebih nyaman.
statement.en: Fed up with the burning sun, Hercules threatened to shoot an arrow at Helios; instead of punishing him, the god rewarded his daring with a golden bowl that Hercules used to sail the seas in greater comfort.

claims.quote: The Sun god shines on the amorous couple Aphrodite and Ares revealing to Hephaistos the illicit shenanigans of his wife in the trap he had set.

statement.id: Dewa Matahari menyinari pasangan Aphrodite dan Ares dan mengungkapkan kepada Hephaistos perselingkuhan istrinya dalam jebakan yang ia pasang.
statement.en: The Sun god shines on the amorous couple Aphrodite and Ares, revealing to Hephaistos his wife's illicit affair in the trap he had set.

claims.quote: In its founding mythology, the name of the island derives from the nymph Rhodos who bore seven sons to Helios, the patron of the island.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi pendiriannya, nama pulau Rhodes berasal dari nimfa Rhodos yang melahirkan tujuh putra bagi Helios, pelindung pulau itu.
statement.en: In its founding mythology the island's name derives from the nymph Rhodos, who bore seven sons to Helios, the patron of the island.

claims.quote: each year a chariot and four horses (quadriga) were thrown into the sea as an offering to the god.

statement.id: Setiap tahun sebuah kereta dengan empat kuda (quadriga) dilemparkan ke laut sebagai persembahan bagi sang dewa.
statement.en: Each year a chariot and four horses (quadriga) were thrown into the sea as an offering to the god.

claims.quote: The god was not the subject of a wide-spread cult, but Plato informs us in his Symposium and other works that many people, including Socrates, would greet the Sun and offer prayers each day.

statement.id: Sang dewa bukan objek pemujaan yang meluas, tetapi menurut Plato banyak orang, termasuk Socrates, menyambut Matahari dan berdoa setiap hari.
statement.en: The god was not the subject of a wide-spread cult, but according to Plato many people, including Socrates, would greet the Sun and offer prayers each day.

claims.quote: The god Apollo was linked with the Sun from the 5th century BCE, and the association became ever stronger from the Hellenistic period

statement.id: Dewa Apollo dikaitkan dengan Matahari sejak abad ke-5 SM, dan kaitan itu makin kuat sejak periode Helenistik.
statement.en: The god Apollo was linked with the Sun from the 5th century BCE, and the association grew ever stronger from the Hellenistic period.

claims.quote: Helios appears in all forms of Greek and Roman art, where he is usually depicted as a youth wearing a crown of sun rays.
claims.locator: How is Helios Represented in Art?

statement.id: Helios muncul dalam semua bentuk seni Yunani dan Romawi, biasanya sebagai pemuda bermahkota sinar matahari.
statement.en: Helios appears in all forms of Greek and Roman art, usually depicted as a youth wearing a crown of sun rays.

claims.quote: Rome's Circus Maximus, for example, had a temple dedicated to Sol and Luna (the Moon) from the 3rd century BCE.

statement.id: Circus Maximus di Roma memiliki kuil untuk Sol dan Luna (Bulan) sejak abad ke-3 SM.
statement.en: Rome's Circus Maximus had a temple dedicated to Sol and Luna (the Moon) from the 3rd century BCE.

claims.quote: Built between 304 and 280 BCE, it was toppled by an earthquake in either 228 or 226 BCE.

statement.id: Colossus dibangun antara 304 dan 280 SM dan roboh oleh gempa pada 228 atau 226 SM.
statement.en: The Colossus was built between 304 and 280 BCE and toppled by an earthquake in either 228 or 226 BCE.

summary.id: Helios adalah anak Hyperion dan Theia.
summary.en: Helios is the child of Hyperion and Theia.

summary.id: Dalam Homeric Hymn 31, orang tuanya Hyperion dan Euryphaessa.
summary.en: In Homeric Hymn 31, his parents are Hyperion and Euryphaessa.

summary.id: Dalam Hyginus (Pref), orang tuanya Hyperion dan Aethra.
summary.en: In Hyginus (Preface), his parents are Hyperion and Aethra.

short_description.id: Huitzilopochtli adalah dewa matahari dan perang dalam agama Aztec serta dewa pelindung bangsa Aztec dan ibu kota mereka, Tenochtitlán.
short_description.en: Huitzilopochtli is the solar and war deity in Aztec religion and the patron god of the Aztecs and their capital, Tenochtitlán.

long_description.id: Huitzilopochtli adalah salah satu dewa terpenting dalam jajaran dewa Aztec, dan bagi bangsa Méxica ia dewa tertinggi. Ia dikenal sebagai dewa matahari dan perang, pelindung Tenochtitlán, dan dikaitkan dengan emas, prajurit, serta penguasa. Ia menggunakan Xiuhcoatl, ular api, sebagai senjata, sehingga dikaitkan juga dengan api. Menurut sumber lain, ia semula kurang penting bagi bangsa Nahua sampai Tlacaelel mereformasi agama Aztec dan menempatkannya sejajar dengan Quetzalcoatl, Tlaloc, dan Tezcatlipoca.
long_description.en: Huitzilopochtli ranks among the foremost deities of the Aztec pantheon, and the Méxica held him to be the highest god. He is the god of sun and war, protector of Tenochtitlán, linked with gold, warriors and rulers. His weapon was Xiuhcoatl, the fire serpent, which ties him to fire as well. Another source adds that he was of little importance to the Nahuas until Tlacaelel reformed Aztec religion and raised him to the level of Quetzalcoatl, Tlaloc and Tezcatlipoca.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah yang terkenal, Huitzilopochtli membalas pembunuhan ibunya, Coatlícue, dengan mengalahkan saudara-saudaranya di Gunung Coatepec. Ia melompat keluar dari jasad ibunya dengan senjata lengkap dan memenggal Coyolxauhqui, yang kepalanya kemudian menjadi bulan. Bagi bangsa Aztec, pergulatan itu terulang setiap hari dan menjelaskan pergantian antara matahari dan bulan di langit.
long_description.en: In a famous story, Huitzilopochtli avenged the murder of his mother Coatlícue by defeating his siblings on Mt. Coatepec. He sprang from her corpse with all his weapons and beheaded Coyolxauhqui, whose head then became the moon. For the Aztecs this struggle recurred every day and explained the daily exchange of the sky between sun and moon.

long_description.id: Bangsa Méxica percaya Huitzilopochtli memimpin mereka dari Aztlán menuju Tenochtitlán. Di ibu kota itu ia memiliki patung kayu dan kuil di puncak piramida Temple Mayor, di samping kuil Tláloc. Karena begitu penting, ia menerima korban manusia yang darahnya dipercaya menguatkan sang dewa. Pada bulan Toxcatl, sebuah patung adonan amaranta berpakaian dirinya diarak ke kuilnya lalu dimakan.
long_description.en: The Méxica believed Huitzilopochtli led them from Aztlán to Tenochtitlán. In that capital he had a wooden statue and shrine atop the Temple Mayor pyramid, alongside that of Tláloc. Because he was so important, he received human sacrifices whose blood was believed to strengthen the god. In the month of Toxcatl, a dough effigy of amaranth dressed as him was paraded to his temple and eaten.

long_description.id: Dalam seni, ia dapat digambarkan membawa pelontar tombak berbentuk ular yang melambangkan Xiuhcóatl, dan dilambangkan dengan kolibri atau elang di atas kaktus pir berduri.
long_description.en: In art he may be shown carrying a snake-shaped spear-thrower representing Xiuhcóatl, and he is symbolised by a hummingbird or an eagle on a prickly pear cactus.

cultural_context.id: Dalam pandangan dunia Aztec, matahari terus mengejar bulan dan bintang, sehingga memberi persembahan kepada Huitzilopochtli penting sebagai santapan bagi Matahari.
cultural_context.en: In the Aztec worldview the Sun constantly chases the Moon and stars, so providing tribute to Huitzilopochtli was important as sustenance for the Sun.

literal_meaning.id: "kolibri" + "sisi tangan kiri"; sering diterjemahkan "Kolibri Kidal" atau "Kolibri dari Selatan"
literal_meaning.en: "hummingbird" + "left hand side"; often translated "Left-Handed Hummingbird" or "Hummingbird of the South"

who.id: Dewa matahari dan perang, pelindung bangsa Aztec dan Tenochtitlán.
who.en: The sun and war god, patron of the Aztecs and Tenochtitlán.

origin.id: Dewa dalam agama Aztec; bangsa Méxica menganggapnya dewa tertinggi.
origin.en: A god of Aztec religion; the Méxica considered him the supreme god.

role.id: Memimpin bangsa Méxica menuju ibu kota baru mereka dan menerima persembahan yang menguatkannya.
role.en: Led the Méxica to their new capital and received offerings believed to strengthen him.

famous_for.id: Membalas pembunuhan ibunya dengan mengalahkan saudara-saudaranya di Gunung Coatepec.
famous_for.en: Avenging the murder of his mother by defeating his siblings on Mt. Coatepec.

did_you_know.id: Arwah prajurit yang gugur dipercaya menemani Huitzilopochtli melintasi langit dan kelak kembali ke bumi sebagai burung kolibri.
did_you_know.en: The spirits of fallen warriors were believed to accompany Huitzilopochtli across the sky and later return to earth as hummingbirds.

description.id: Ia menggunakan Xiuhcoatl, ular api, sebagai senjata.
description.en: He wielded Xiuhcoatl, the fire serpent, as a weapon.

role.en: Son who avenged his mother

summary.id: Huitzilopochtli melompat dari jasad ibunya dengan senjata di tangan, memenggal Coyolxauhqui, melemparkan kepalanya ke langit hingga menjadi bulan, lalu menyebarkan saudara-saudaranya ke langit.
summary.en: Huitzilopochtli sprang from his mother's corpse with weapons in hand, beheaded Coyolxauhqui and slung her head into the skies where it became the moon, then dispersed his other siblings into the heavens.

role.en: Guide and giver of directions

summary.id: Arca sang dewa dibawa para imam selama perjalanan dan membisikkan arah; ia memerintahkan jantung pemberontak dilempar ke Danau Texcoco untuk menentukan lokasi kota baru, yang ditandai seekor elang di atas kaktus pir berduri.
summary.en: The god's idol was carried by priests during the journey and whispered directions; he instructed that the rebel's heart be thrown into Lake Texcoco to indicate the site of the new city, marked by an eagle on a prickly-pear cactus.

role.en: Co-creator

summary.id: Dalam satu kisah asal-usul, Huitzilopochtli dan Quetzalcoatl bersama-sama menciptakan api, manusia pertama, Bumi, dan Matahari.
summary.en: In one origin story, Huitzilopochtli and Quetzalcoatl together made fire, the first humans, the Earth and the Sun.

title.en: The daily journey across the sky

role.id: Dewa yang melintasi langit dan Dunia Bawah
role.en: God travelling the sky and Underworld

summary.id: Huitzilopochtli ditemani arwah prajurit yang gugur pada paruh pertama perjalanannya melintasi langit, lalu bergerak melalui Dunia Bawah pada malam hari sampai fajar.
summary.en: Huitzilopochtli was accompanied by the spirits of fallen warriors on the first half of his journey across the sky, then moved through the Underworld at night until dawn.

description.id: Di puncak piramida ini Huitzilopochtli memiliki patung kayu dan kuil di samping milik Tláloc.
description.en: Atop this pyramid Huitzilopochtli had a wooden statue and shrine alongside that of Tláloc.

description.id: Gunung ular, tempat Huitzilopochtli mengalahkan saudara-saudaranya.
description.en: The snake mountain, where Huitzilopochtli defeated his siblings.

description.id: Tempat jantung pemberontak dilempar atas perintah sang dewa untuk menandai lokasi rumah baru bangsa Méxica.
description.en: Where the rebel's heart was thrown at the god's instruction to mark the site of the Méxica's new home.

note.id: Saudari yang dipenggal Huitzilopochtli; kepalanya menjadi bulan.
note.en: The sister whom Huitzilopochtli beheaded; her head became the moon.

note.id: Ibunya dalam kisah Coatepec, yang pembunuhannya ia balas atau yang (dalam beberapa versi) ia selamatkan; dalam versi lain ia anak Coatlícue sebagai dewi bumi tertinggi.
note.en: His mother in the Coatepec story, whose murder he avenged or whom (in some versions) he saved; in an alternative version he is the offspring of Coatlícue, the supreme earth goddess.

note.id: Dianggap saudara Huitzilopochtli.
note.en: Considered a brother of Huitzilopochtli.

note.id: Dianggap saudara Huitzilopochtli.
note.en: Considered a brother of Huitzilopochtli.

note.id: Dianggap saudara Huitzilopochtli.
note.en: Considered a brother of Huitzilopochtli.

note.id: Kuilnya berdampingan dengan kuil Huitzilopochtli di Temple Mayor.
note.en: His shrine stood alongside that of Huitzilopochtli on the Temple Mayor.

note.id: Saudara-saudara yang dikalahkan Huitzilopochtli di Gunung Coatepec.
note.en: Siblings whom Huitzilopochtli defeated on Mt. Coatepec.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa kisah kelahiran di Coatepec dianggap menjelaskan pergantian matahari dan bulan?
learning_questions.en: Why was the Coatepec birth story taken to explain the exchange between sun and moon?

learning_questions.id: Bagaimana persembahan kepada Huitzilopochtli mencerminkan pandangan bangsa Aztec tentang kelangsungan matahari?
learning_questions.en: How do the offerings to Huitzilopochtli reflect the Aztec view of the Sun's survival?

claims.quote: He was also the patron god of the Aztecs and their capital city, Tenochtitlan.

statement.id: Ia adalah dewa pelindung bangsa Aztecs dan ibu kota Tenochtitlan.
statement.en: He was also the patron god of the Aztecs and their capital city, Tenochtitlan.

claims.quote: He wielded Xiuhcoatl, the fire serpent, as a weapon, thus also associating Huitzilopochtli with fire.

statement.id: Ia menggunakan Xiuhcoatl sang ular api sebagai senjatanya.
statement.en: He wielded Xiuhcoatl, the fire serpent, as a weapon.

claims.quote: The Spaniards recorded the deity's name as Huichilobos.

statement.id: Orang Spanyol mencatat nama dewa ini sebagai Huichilobos.
statement.en: The Spaniards recorded the deity's name as Huichilobos.

claims.quote: was one of the most important deities in the Aztec pantheon and for the Méxica he was the supreme god.

statement.id: Huitzilopochtli adalah salah satu dewa terpenting dalam jajaran dewa Aztec, dan bagi bangsa Méxica ia dewa tertinggi.
statement.en: Huitzilopochtli was one of the most important deities in the Aztec pantheon, and for the Méxica he was the supreme god.

claims.quote: He was the god of the sun and war, considered the patron of the Aztec capital Tenochtitlán and associated with gold, warriors and rulers.

statement.id: Ia dewa matahari dan perang, dianggap pelindung ibu kota Aztec Tenochtitlán, serta dikaitkan dengan emas, prajurit, dan penguasa.
statement.en: He was the god of the sun and war, considered the patron of the Aztec capital Tenochtitlán and associated with gold, warriors and rulers.

claims.quote: Generally it is agreed that there are two elements, huītzilin "hummingbird" and ōpōchtli "left hand side".

statement.id: Umumnya disepakati bahwa namanya terdiri atas dua unsur: huītzilin yang berarti burung kolibri dan ōpōchtli yang berarti sisi tangan kiri.
statement.en: It is generally agreed that his name has two elements: huītzilin, "hummingbird", and ōpōchtli, "left hand side".

claims.quote: The name is often translated as "Left-Handed Hummingbird" or "Hummingbird of the South" on the basis that Aztec cosmology associated the south with the left hand side of the body.

statement.id: Nama itu sering diterjemahkan sebagai "Kolibri Kidal" atau "Kolibri dari Selatan", karena kosmologi Aztec mengaitkan selatan dengan sisi kiri tubuh.
statement.en: The name is often translated as "Left-Handed Hummingbird" or "Hummingbird of the South", because Aztec cosmology associated the south with the left hand side of the body.

claims.quote: Huitzilopochtli famously avenged the murder of his mother Coatlίcue (or in some versions actually saved her) when he defeated his siblings the 400 Centzonhuitznahuac and Centzonmimizcoa on Mt. Coatepec, the snake mountain.

statement.id: Huitzilopochtli terkenal membalas pembunuhan ibunya, Coatlícue (atau dalam beberapa versi justru menyelamatkannya), dengan mengalahkan saudara-saudaranya, 400 Centzonhuitznahuac dan Centzonmimizcoa, di Gunung Coatepec, gunung ular.
statement.en: Huitzilopochtli famously avenged the murder of his mother Coatlícue (or in some versions actually saved her) when he defeated his siblings, the 400 Centzonhuitznahuac and Centzonmimizcoa, on Mt. Coatepec, the snake mountain.

claims.quote: Her children were outraged at this development and attacked Coatlίcue but when they decapitated their mother Huitzilopochtli sprang from the corpse with all his weapons in hand and lopped off his sister Coyolxauhqui's head.

statement.id: Ketika anak-anak Coatlícue memenggal ibu mereka, Huitzilopochtli melompat keluar dari jasadnya dengan semua senjata di tangan dan memenggal kepala saudarinya, Coyolxauhqui.
statement.en: When Coatlícue's children decapitated their mother, Huitzilopochtli sprang from the corpse with all his weapons in hand and lopped off his sister Coyolxauhqui's head.

claims.quote: Huitzilopochtli dismembered her corpse so that her torso fell to the bottom of the mountain and when he slung the head into the skies it became the moon.

statement.id: Huitzilopochtli memotong-motong jasad Coyolxauhqui sehingga badannya jatuh ke kaki gunung, dan kepalanya yang ia lemparkan ke langit menjadi bulan.
statement.en: Huitzilopochtli dismembered her corpse so that her torso fell to the bottom of the mountain, and the head he slung into the skies became the moon.

claims.quote: putting an end to their takeover attempt and dispersing them into the heavens to become the southern and northern constellations respectively.

statement.id: Huitzilopochtli menghentikan upaya perebutan kuasa saudara-saudaranya dan menyebarkan mereka ke langit sebagai rasi bintang selatan dan utara.
statement.en: Huitzilopochtli put an end to his siblings' takeover attempt and dispersed them into the heavens to become the southern and northern constellations respectively.

claims.quote: For the Aztecs the tussle between Coyolxauhqui and Huitzilopochtli was thought to reoccur everyday which explained the daily exchange for control of the sky between the sun and moon.

statement.id: Bagi bangsa Aztec, pergulatan antara Coyolxauhqui dan Huitzilopochtli dianggap terulang setiap hari, dan itu menjelaskan pergantian harian penguasa langit antara matahari dan bulan.
statement.en: For the Aztecs the tussle between Coyolxauhqui and Huitzilopochtli was thought to reoccur every day, which explained the daily exchange for control of the sky between the sun and moon.

claims.quote: Huitzilopochtli was believed to be accompanied on the first half of his journey across the sky by the spirits of fallen warriors (who would later return to earth as hummingbirds).

statement.id: Pada paruh pertama perjalanannya melintasi langit, Huitzilopochtli dipercaya ditemani arwah prajurit yang gugur, yang kelak kembali ke bumi sebagai burung kolibri.
statement.en: On the first half of his journey across the sky Huitzilopochtli was believed to be accompanied by the spirits of fallen warriors, who would later return to earth as hummingbirds.

claims.quote: When night fell Huitzilopochtli moved through the Underworld until dawn and he then once more travelled the skies.

statement.id: Ketika malam tiba, Huitzilopochtli bergerak melalui Dunia Bawah sampai fajar, lalu kembali menempuh langit.
statement.en: When night fell Huitzilopochtli moved through the Underworld until dawn, and he then once more travelled the skies.

claims.quote: The focal point of worship to Huitzilopochtli was at the Aztec capital where he had a wooden statue and shrine alongside that of Tláloc atop the Temple Mayor pyramid or Hueteocalli.

statement.id: Di ibu kota Aztec, ia memiliki patung kayu dan kuil di samping milik Tláloc di puncak piramida Temple Mayor atau Hueteocalli.
statement.en: In the Aztec capital he had a wooden statue and shrine alongside that of Tláloc atop the Temple Mayor pyramid, or Hueteocalli.

claims.quote: As Huitzilopochtli was such an important deity he was the beneficiary of human sacrifices whose blood would feed and strengthen the god.

statement.id: Karena begitu pentingnya, Huitzilopochtli menerima korban manusia yang darahnya dipercaya memberi makan dan menguatkan sang dewa.
statement.en: Because he was such an important deity, Huitzilopochtli was the beneficiary of human sacrifices whose blood would feed and strengthen the god.

claims.quote: The Méxica, especially, revered Huitzilopochtli as they believed he had led them from the legendary Aztlán cave in the northwest desert on a protracted journey that eventually led to their new capital Tenochtitlán.

statement.id: Bangsa Méxica sangat memuliakan Huitzilopochtli karena percaya ia memimpin mereka dari gua Aztlán yang legendaris di gurun barat laut dalam perjalanan panjang menuju ibu kota baru mereka, Tenochtitlán.
statement.en: The Méxica especially revered Huitzilopochtli because they believed he had led them from the legendary Aztlán cave in the northwest desert on a protracted journey that eventually led to their new capital Tenochtitlán.

claims.quote: During this migration priests had carried a huge idol of the god who whispered directions, gave the Méxica their name and promised great wealth and prosperity if he was suitably worshipped.

statement.id: Selama perpindahan itu, para imam membawa arca besar sang dewa yang membisikkan arah, memberi bangsa Méxica nama mereka, dan menjanjikan kekayaan dan kemakmuran bila ia dipuja dengan layak.
statement.en: During this migration priests carried a huge idol of the god, who whispered directions, gave the Méxica their name and promised great wealth and prosperity if he was suitably worshipped.

claims.quote: The great war god instructed that the rebel's heart be thrown as far as possible into Lake Texcoco and where it landed would indicate the place the Méxica should build their new home, the precise spot being marked by an eagle sitting on a prickly-pear cactus.

statement.id: Sang dewa perang memerintahkan agar jantung pemberontak dilempar sejauh mungkin ke Danau Texcoco; tempat jatuhnya menunjukkan lokasi rumah baru bangsa Méxica, yang ditandai seekor elang di atas kaktus pir berduri.
statement.en: The great war god instructed that the rebel's heart be thrown as far as possible into Lake Texcoco; where it landed would indicate the place the Méxica should build their new home, marked by an eagle sitting on a prickly-pear cactus.

claims.quote: Huitzilopochtli may be depicted carrying his snake-shaped spear-thrower (atl-atl) which represents the fire-serpent Xiuhcóatl. He may also carry a shield, hold feathered arrows or darts and be painted with blue arms and legs.

statement.id: Huitzilopochtli dapat digambarkan membawa pelontar tombak berbentuk ular (atl-atl) yang melambangkan ular api Xiuhcóatl; ia juga bisa membawa perisai atau anak panah berbulu dan dilukis dengan lengan dan kaki biru.
statement.en: Huitzilopochtli may be depicted carrying his snake-shaped spear-thrower (atl-atl), which represents the fire-serpent Xiuhcóatl; he may also carry a shield or feathered arrows or darts and be painted with blue arms and legs.

claims.quote: The god could be symbolised by either a hummingbird (huitzilin) - whose feathers he wore in his helmet - or an eagle sitting on a prickly pear cactus holding a snake in one of its talons, an image seen today in the national flag of Mexico.

statement.id: Sang dewa dapat dilambangkan dengan kolibri (huitzilin), yang bulunya ia kenakan di helmnya, atau elang di atas kaktus pir berduri yang mencengkeram ular, gambar yang kini terlihat pada bendera nasional Meksiko.
statement.en: The god could be symbolised by a hummingbird (huitzilin), whose feathers he wore in his helmet, or by an eagle sitting on a prickly pear cactus holding a snake, an image seen today on the national flag of Mexico.

claims.quote: In Aztec mythology Huitzilopochtli was the son of Omecίhuatl and Ometecuhtli, respectively, the female and male aspects of the androgynous primordial god Ometeotl. ... In an alternative version, the god is the offspring of Coatlίcue, the supreme earth goddess.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Aztec, Huitzilopochtli adalah putra Omecíhuatl dan Ometecuhtli; dalam versi lain ia anak Coatlícue, dewi bumi tertinggi.
statement.en: In Aztec mythology Huitzilopochtli was the son of Omecíhuatl and Ometecuhtli; in an alternative version he is the offspring of Coatlícue, the supreme earth goddess.

claims.quote: Huitzilopochtli was also considered the brother of those other great Mesoamerican gods Quetzalcoatl, Tezcatlipoca and Xipe Totec.

statement.id: Huitzilopochtli juga dianggap saudara dewa-dewa besar Mesoamerika lainnya: Quetzalcoatl, Tezcatlipoca, dan Xipe Totec.
statement.en: Huitzilopochtli was also considered the brother of the other great Mesoamerican gods Quetzalcoatl, Tezcatlipoca and Xipe Totec.

claims.quote: he was also celebrated during the month of Toxcatl when an effigy or tzoalli made from dough using the amaranth plant and dressed as Huitzilopochtli was taken to the god's temple in a great procession and then eaten.

statement.id: Ia juga dirayakan pada bulan Toxcatl, ketika sebuah patung adonan amaranta (tzoalli) berpakaian Huitzilopochtli diarak ke kuilnya lalu dimakan.
statement.en: He was also celebrated in the month of Toxcatl, when an effigy (tzoalli) made from amaranth dough and dressed as Huitzilopochtli was taken to the god's temple in a great procession and then eaten.

claims.quote: Originally, he was of little importance to the Nahuas, but after the rise of the Aztecs, Tlacaelel reformed their religion and put Huitzilopochtli at the same level as Quetzalcoatl, Tlaloc, and Tezcatlipoca, making him a solar god.

statement.id: Mulanya ia kurang penting bagi bangsa Nahua, tetapi setelah bangkitnya bangsa Aztec, Tlacaelel mereformasi agama mereka dan menempatkannya sejajar dengan Quetzalcoatl, Tlaloc, dan Tezcatlipoca sebagai dewa matahari.
statement.en: Originally he was of little importance to the Nahuas, but after the rise of the Aztecs, Tlacaelel reformed their religion and put him at the same level as Quetzalcoatl, Tlaloc and Tezcatlipoca, making him a solar god.

claims.quote: Huitzilopochtli is seen as the sun in mythology, while his many male siblings are perceived as the stars and his sister as the moon. In the Aztec worldview, this is the reason why the Sun is constantly chasing the Moon and stars. It is also why it was so important to provide tribute for Huitzilopochtli as sustenance for the Sun.

statement.id: Dalam pandangan dunia Aztec, matahari terus mengejar bulan dan bintang, dan karena itu penting memberi persembahan kepada Huitzilopochtli sebagai santapan bagi Matahari.
statement.en: In the Aztec worldview the Sun is constantly chasing the Moon and stars, which is why it was so important to provide tribute for Huitzilopochtli as sustenance for the Sun.

claims.quote: Together, Huitzilopochtli and Quetzalcoatl created fire, the first male and female humans, the Earth, and the Sun.

statement.id: Dalam satu kisah asal-usul, Huitzilopochtli dan Quetzalcoatl bersama-sama menciptakan api, manusia laki-laki dan perempuan pertama, Bumi, dan Matahari.
statement.en: In one origin story, Huitzilopochtli and Quetzalcoatl together created fire, the first male and female humans, the Earth, and the Sun.

claims.quote: Huitzilopochtli (Classical Nahuatl: Huītzilōpōchtli ... is the solar and war deity of sacrifice in Aztec religion.

statement.id: Huitzilopochtli (dalam bahasa Nahuatl Klasik: Huītzilōpōchtli) adalah dewa matahari dan perang, serta dewa pengorbanan, dalam agama Aztec.
statement.en: Huitzilopochtli (Classical Nahuatl: Huītzilōpōchtli) is the solar and war deity of sacrifice in Aztec religion.

summary.id: Putra Omecíhuatl dan Ometecuhtli, aspek perempuan dan laki-laki dewa primordial Ometeotl.
summary.en: Son of Omecíhuatl and Ometecuhtli, the female and male aspects of the primordial god Ometeotl.

summary.id: Dalam versi lain, anak Coatlícue, dewi bumi tertinggi.
summary.en: In an alternative version, the offspring of Coatlícue, the supreme earth goddess.

summary.id: Ia membalas pembunuhan ibunya.
summary.en: He avenged the murder of his mother.

summary.id: Dalam beberapa versi, ia justru menyelamatkannya.
summary.en: In some versions he actually saved her.

short_description.id: Minerva adalah dewi Romawi kebijaksanaan, kerajinan, dan seni, pelindung perang dan kemenangan, anggota Triad Kapitolin yang disamakan dengan Athena.
short_description.en: Minerva is the Roman goddess of wisdom, crafts and the arts, later linked with war and victory, a member of the Capitoline Triad identified with Athena.

long_description.id: Minerva dipuja dalam tradisi Romawi sebagai dewi kebijaksanaan, kerajinan, seni, dan kemudian perang. Britannica 1911 menyebutnya menguasai semua kerajinan, penemuan, seni, dan ilmu. Ia dikaitkan dengan Athena Yunani, tetapi penelitian menelusuri asalnya pula pada Menrva Etruska. Minerva termasuk Triad Kapitolin bersama Jupiter dan Juno, dan dalam mitos dilahirkan dari kepala Jupiter.
long_description.en: Minerva was worshipped in Roman tradition as goddess of wisdom, crafts, arts, and later war. The 1911 Britannica says she presided over all handicrafts, inventions, arts and sciences. She was associated with Greek Athena, while scholarship also traces her to Etruscan Menrva. She formed the Capitoline Triad with Jupiter and Juno, and myth has her born from Jupiter's head.

long_description.id: Di Roma, tempat suci tertuanya berada di kuil Capitol; ia juga punya kuil di Aventine, tempat berkumpul penyair drama dan aktor, dan di Bukit Caelius sebagai Capta. Pestanya, Quinquatrus, jatuh pada 19 Maret; sekolah libur dan murid membawa bayaran (minerval) kepada guru. Pesta itu kemudian dikaitkan dengan perang, dan Minerva dianggap pemberi kemenangan; Pompeius mendirikan kuil baginya setelah kampanye di timur, dan pemujaannya mencapai puncak kepopulerannya pada masa Domitianus.
long_description.en: At Rome her oldest sanctuary was in the Capitol temple; she also had a temple on the Aventine, meeting-place of dramatic poets and actors, and one on the Caelian Hill as Capta. Her festival, the Quinquatrus, fell on 19 March; schools had holidays and pupils brought a fee (minerval) to their teachers. The festival later became linked with war, and Minerva was seen as bestower of victory; Pompey dedicated a temple to her after his campaigns in the east, and her worship reached its greatest vogue under Domitian.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah Arachne, Minerva menantang penenun yang mengaku lebih unggul itu. Ia menyamar sebagai perempuan tua lalu menyingkapkan diri, menenun potret dirinya bersama perisai dan tombak, dan akhirnya mengubah Arachne menjadi laba-laba. Patung perunggu Romawi menampilkannya dengan helm bergaya Yunani, dan arca di Museum Capitolini menampilkan aegis dengan Medusa, perisai, dan helm Korintus.
long_description.en: In the Arachne story Minerva challenges the weaver who claimed to surpass her. She disguises herself as an old woman then reveals herself, weaves a portrait of herself with shield and lance, and finally transforms Arachne into a spider. A Roman bronze bust depicts her in a Greek-style helmet, and the statue in the Capitoline Museums shows an aegis with Medusa, a shield, and a Corinthian helmet.

long_description.id: Dalam legenda, arca keramat Minerva dibawa Aeneas ke Roma dan disimpan di kuil Vesta; kota itu diyakini aman selama arca terjaga. Sumber berbeda tentang bagaimana arca itu sampai ke Roma, dan tentang arti namanya.
long_description.en: In legend Minerva's sacred statue was brought to Rome by Aeneas and kept in the temple of Vesta; the city was believed safe while the statue was preserved. Sources differ on how the statue reached Rome and on the meaning of her name.

cultural_context.id: Menurut Britannica 1911, Minerva adalah pelindung tenun dan pintal kaum perempuan serta kerajinan pekerja, sehingga pesta Quinquatrus menjadi hari libur di rumah dan sekolah.
cultural_context.en: According to the 1911 Britannica, Minerva was patron of women's weaving and spinning and the workmen's craft, so the Quinquatrus was a holiday in homes and schools.

literal_meaning.id: menurut Britannica 1911 mungkin "pemikir"; menurut World History Encyclopedia berasal dari meminisse, "mengingat"
literal_meaning.en: probably "thinker" according to the 1911 Britannica; from meminisse, "to remember", according to World History Encyclopedia

who.id: Minerva adalah dewi Romawi kebijaksanaan, kerajinan, dan seni.
who.en: Minerva is the Roman goddess of wisdom, crafts, and the arts.

origin.id: Ia dewi Italia yang disamakan dengan Athena dan menurut para sarjana diturunkan dari Menrva Etruska.
origin.en: She is an Italian goddess identified with Athena and, according to scholars, passed down from Etruscan Menrva.

role.id: Ia anggota Triad Kapitolin dan pelindung kerajinan, kemudian dikaitkan dengan perang dan kemenangan.
role.en: She is a member of the Capitoline Triad and patron of crafts, later linked with war and victory.

famous_for.id: Minerva paling dikenal karena kisah Arachne dan perannya dalam Triad Kapitolin.
famous_for.en: Minerva is best known for the story of Arachne and her place in the Capitoline Triad.

did_you_know.id: Pada pesta Quinquatrus, murid yang kembali ke sekolah membawa bayaran bernama minerval kepada guru mereka.
did_you_know.en: At the Quinquatrus festival, pupils returning to school brought their teachers a fee called the minerval.

description.id: Minerva menguasai kerajinan, penemuan, seni, dan ilmu, dan menjadi pelindung tenun, pintal, dan kerajinan pekerja.
description.en: Minerva presided over handicrafts, inventions, arts and sciences and was patron of weaving, spinning and the workmen's craft.

description.id: Dalam kisah Arachne, ia menenun tapestri yang menampilkan para dewa dan dirinya sendiri memenangkan perlombaan atas Athena melawan Poseidon.
description.en: In the Arachne story she wove a tapestry showing the gods and herself winning the contest over Athens against Poseidon.

description.id: Dalam Ovid, Minerva menanggalkan wujud perempuan tua lalu menyingkapkan dirinya sebagai dewi.
description.en: In Ovid, Minerva puts aside the shape of an old woman and reveals herself as the goddess.

description.id: Minerva memercikkan sari ramuan Hecate kepada Arachne sehingga ia menyusut dan menjadi laba-laba.
description.en: Minerva sprinkled Arachne with juice of herbs of Hecate so that she shrank and became a spider.

name.en: Bestower of victory and war patron

description.id: Minerva dianggap pemberi kemenangan dan dewi perang; pesta Quinquatrus menandai awal musim kampanye tentara Romawi.
description.en: Minerva was seen as bestower of victory and goddess of war; the Quinquatrus marked the start of the Roman army's campaign season.

name.en: Safeguarding the city through her statue

description.id: Menurut legenda, kota itu diyakini aman dari bahaya selama arca Minerva di kuil Vesta terjaga.
description.en: According to legend the city was believed safe from harm as long as Minerva's statue in the temple of Vesta was preserved.

description.id: Wujud Minerva di Aventine berasal dari Yunani dan tempatnya menjadi pusat perkumpulan penulis, aktor, dan pengrajin.
description.en: The Aventine Minerva was of Greek origin and her site was a centre for writers, actors and craftsmen.

description.id: Di Bukit Caelius Minerva dipuja dengan nama Capta, yang asal-usulnya tidak diketahui.
description.en: On the Caelian Hill Minerva was worshipped as Capta, whose origin is unknown.

description.id: Minerva dipuja bersama Jupiter dan Juno di kuil Capitol, tempat suci tertuanya di Roma.
description.en: Minerva was worshipped with Jupiter and Juno in the Capitol temple, her oldest sanctuary at Rome.

role.en: Minerva challenges and punishes Arachne.

summary.id: Arachne membanggakan tenunannya melebihi Minerva, dan sang dewi menantangnya dalam perlombaan menenun. Menurut Ovid, Minerva menyingkapkan diri dari wujud perempuan tua, menenun kisah perebutan Athena, lalu merobek tenunan Arachne dan memukulnya; setelah iba menyelamatkannya dari kematian, ia mengubahnya menjadi laba-laba.
summary.en: Arachne boasted her weaving surpassed Minerva's, and the goddess challenged her to a weaving contest. In Ovid, Minerva reveals herself from the shape of an old woman, weaves the contest over Athens, then rips Arachne's web and strikes her; moved to pity she saves her from death and turns her into a spider.

role.en: Minerva is born from her father's head.

summary.id: Dalam mitos Minerva dianggap putri Jupiter yang dilahirkan dari kepalanya.
summary.en: In myth Minerva is considered the daughter of Jupiter, from whose head she was born.

role.en: Minerva's statue protects the city.

summary.id: Menurut legenda Aeneas membawa arca sang dewi ke Roma, dan kota diyakini aman selama arca itu terjaga di kuil Vesta; versi lain menyebut keluarga Nautii membawanya dari Lavinium.
summary.en: According to legend Aeneas brought the goddess's statue to Rome, and the city was believed safe while it was preserved in the temple of Vesta; another version says the family of the Nautii brought it from Lavinium.

role.en: Minerva refuses the advances of Mars.

summary.id: Minerva termasyhur karena kesuciannya dan pernah menolak rayuan Mars, dewa perang.
summary.en: Minerva was renowned for her chastity and once refused the amorous advances of Mars, the god of war.

description.id: Tempat suci tertua Minerva di Roma, dibangun Tarquin, tempat ia dipuja bersama Jupiter dan Juno.
description.en: Minerva's oldest sanctuary at Rome, built by Tarquin, where she was worshipped with Jupiter and Juno.

description.id: Situs pemujaan penting Minerva yang kuilnya didirikan pada 263 atau 262 SM dan menjadi tempat pertemuan penyair drama dan aktor.
description.en: An important site of Minerva's worship, with a shrine built in 263 or 262 BCE, and a meeting-place for dramatic poets and actors.

description.id: Lokasi kuil Minerva Capta dan pesta quinquatrus kecil.
description.en: Site of the temple of Minerva Capta and the lesser quinquatrus.

description.id: Tempat Domitianus membangun kuil bagi Minerva pada paruh kedua abad ke-1 M.
description.en: Where Domitian commissioned a temple to Minerva in the second half of the 1st century CE.

description.id: Tempat arca Minerva (Palladium) disimpan dan dijaga demi keselamatan kota.
description.en: Where Minerva's statue (the Palladium) was kept and guarded for the city's safety.

description.id: Kuil Minerva dibangun di Aventine pada 263 atau 262 SM.
description.en: A shrine to Minerva was built on the Aventine in 263 or 262 BCE.

timeline.period: the second half of the 1st century CE

description.id: Domitianus membangun kuil bagi Minerva di Forum Nerva.
description.en: Domitian commissioned a temple to Minerva in the Nerva Forum.

note.id: Minerva dikaitkan dengan Athena Yunani.
note.en: Minerva was associated with Greek Athena.

note.id: Mitos menyebut Minerva lahir dari kepala Jupiter.
note.en: Myth says Minerva was born from Jupiter's head.

note.id: Minerva membentuk Triad Kapitolin bersama Jupiter dan Juno.
note.en: Minerva formed the Capitoline Triad with Jupiter and Juno.

note.id: Menurut konsensus ilmiah, Minerva diturunkan dari dewi Etruska Menrva.
note.en: According to scholarly consensus Minerva passed to the Romans from the Etruscan goddess Menrva.

note.id: Minerva mengambil alih peran utama dalam pesta Quinquatrus yang semula milik Mars, dan pernah menolak rayuannya.
note.en: Minerva took over as the main focus of the Quinquatrus, previously Mars's domain, and once refused his advances.

note.id: Minerva menantang Arachne menenun dan mengubahnya menjadi laba-laba.
note.en: Minerva challenged Arachne to weave and transformed her into a spider.

note.id: Tapestri Minerva menampilkan kemenangannya atas Poseidon dalam perlombaan menjadi pelindung Athena.
note.en: Minerva's tapestry shows her winning the competition with Poseidon to become patron of Athens.

note.id: Arca Minerva disimpan di kuil Vesta.
note.en: Minerva's statue was kept in the temple of Vesta.

learning_questions.en: Why do different sources give different meanings for the name Minerva?

learning_questions.id: Apa yang berubah ketika Minerva dikaitkan dengan perang dan kemenangan di samping kerajinan?
learning_questions.en: What changed when Minerva became linked with war and victory alongside crafts?

sources.title: Ovid, Metamorphoses, Book 6 (translated by Brookes More)
sources.author: Ovid

claims.quote: Minerva was the Roman goddess of wisdom, medicine, commerce, handicrafts, poetry, the arts in general, and later, war.

statement.id: Minerva adalah dewi Romawi yang dikaitkan dengan kebijaksanaan, kerajinan, seni, dan kemudian perang.
statement.en: Minerva was a Roman goddess of wisdom, crafts, arts, and later war.

claims.quote: In many ways similar to the Greek goddess Athena, she had important temples in Rome and was patron of the Quinquatras festival.

statement.id: Minerva dekat dengan Athena Yunani dan menjadi pelindung festival Quinquatras.
statement.en: Minerva was associated with Greek Athena and patronized Quinquatras.

claims.quote: The scholarly consensus, however, is that Minerva was indigenous, passing to the Romans from the Etruscan goddess Menrva

statement.id: Sebagian sarjana menelusuri Minerva pada dewi Etruska Menrva.
statement.en: Scholarly consensus traces Minerva to the Etruscan goddess Menrva.

claims.quote: Considered the daughter of Jupiter, from whose head she was born

statement.id: Dalam mitos, Minerva dilahirkan dari kepala Jupiter.
statement.en: In myth Minerva was born from Jupiter's head.

claims.quote: the goddess was first worshipped in Rome as one of the Capitoline Triad along with Jupiter and Juno.

statement.id: Minerva termasuk dalam Triad Kapitolin bersama Jupiter dan Juno.
statement.en: Minerva belonged to the Capitoline Triad with Jupiter and Juno.

claims.quote: In the myth, a Lydian girl named Arachne unwisely boasts that her weaving skills are even better than Minerva's.

statement.id: Arachne menyombongkan keterampilan tenunnya melebihi Minerva.
statement.en: Arachne boasted that her weaving surpassed Minerva's.

claims.quote: she promptly challenged the presumptuous Arachne to a weaving competition.

statement.id: Minerva menantang Arachne dalam pertandingan menenun.
statement.en: Minerva challenged Arachne to a weaving contest.

claims.quote: punished Arachne for her audacity by hitting her on the head three times and changing her into a spider.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Ovid, Minerva mengubah Arachne menjadi laba-laba.
statement.en: In Ovid's tale, Minerva transformed Arachne into a spider.

claims.quote: Perhaps the most important site of worship of Minerva was on the Aventine where a shrine was built in either 263 or 262 BCE.

statement.id: Sebuah tempat suci Minerva dibangun di Bukit Aventine pada 263 atau 262 SM.
statement.en: A shrine to Minerva was built on the Aventine in 263 or 262 BCE.

claims.quote: Modeled on the Greek goddess Athena, the Roman Minerva had many of the same duties and attributes, as shown here by her Greek-style helmet.

statement.id: Patung perunggu Minerva di The Met menampilkan helm bergaya Yunani.
statement.en: A Met bronze bust of Minerva bears a Greek-style helmet.

claims.quote: Together with Jupiter and Juno, she formed part of the Capitoline Triad, the very center and focus of Roman state religion.

statement.id: Triad Kapitolin yang mencakup Minerva menjadi pusat agama negara Romawi.
statement.en: The Capitoline Triad including Minerva was central to Roman state religion.

claims.quote: and that her name derives from meminisse, meaning 'to remember'.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, namanya berasal dari meminisse yang berarti "mengingat".
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia her name derives from meminisse, meaning 'to remember'.

claims.quote: In legend, the great hero Aeneas, who escaped from fallen Troy, brought a cult statue of the goddess to Rome. Residing within the Temple of Vesta it was believed that the city would be safe from harm as long as the statue was preserved.

statement.id: Dalam legenda, Aeneas membawa arca pemujaan sang dewi ke Roma; di Kuil Vesta diyakini kota itu aman selama arca itu terjaga.
statement.en: In legend Aeneas brought a cult statue of the goddess to Rome; housed in the Temple of Vesta, it was believed the city would be safe as long as the statue was preserved.

claims.quote: Like Athena, the goddess was renowned for her chastity, and she once famously refused the amorous advances of Mars, the god of war.

statement.id: Seperti Athena, Minerva termasyhur karena kesuciannya dan pernah menolak rayuan Mars, dewa perang.
statement.en: Like Athena, Minerva was renowned for her chastity and once famously refused the amorous advances of Mars, the god of war.

claims.quote: Over time, Minerva grew in stature within the Roman pantheon and she took over as the most important focus of the Quinquatrus festival, previously the domain of Mars. The five-day festival began on the 19th of March and marked the beginning of the campaign season for the Roman army.

statement.id: Seiring waktu Minerva menjadi fokus terpenting pesta Quinquatrus yang semula milik Mars; pesta lima hari itu dimulai 19 Maret dan menandai awal musim kampanye tentara Romawi.
statement.en: Over time Minerva became the most important focus of the Quinquatrus festival, previously Mars's domain; the five-day festival began on 19 March and marked the start of the Roman army's campaign season.

claims.quote: The goddess also became associated with victory, as illustrated by Pompey's dedication of a temple to the goddess following his successful campaigns in the east.

statement.id: Minerva juga dikaitkan dengan kemenangan, seperti terlihat dari persembahan kuil oleh Pompeius setelah kampanyenya di timur.
statement.en: Minerva also became associated with victory, as illustrated by Pompey's dedication of a temple to her after his campaigns in the east.

claims.quote: The emperor Domitian also claimed the goddess was his special protectress and he commissioned a temple to her in the Nerva Forum in Rome in the second half of the 1st century CE.

statement.id: Kaisar Domitianus menyatakan Minerva pelindung khususnya dan membangun kuil baginya di Forum Nerva di Roma pada paruh kedua abad ke-1 M.
statement.en: The emperor Domitian claimed Minerva as his special protectress and commissioned a temple to her in the Nerva Forum in Rome in the second half of the 1st century CE.

claims.quote: One of the most impressive representations of Minerva in art is the 3 metre high statue of the goddess which now resides in the Capitoline Museums in Rome. Dating to the 2nd century BCE, the standing figure wears a chiton and belt, an aegis with Medusa, carries a shield on her left arm and wears a Corinthian helmet pushed to the back of the head.

statement.id: Arca Minerva setinggi tiga meter di Museum Capitolini, Roma, bertarikh abad ke-2 SM; sosok berdirinya mengenakan chiton dan ikat pinggang, aegis dengan Medusa, membawa perisai di lengan kiri, dan mengenakan helm Korintus yang didorong ke belakang kepala.
statement.en: The 3 metre high statue of Minerva in the Capitoline Museums in Rome, dating to the 2nd century BCE, shows a standing figure who wears a chiton and belt and an aegis with Medusa, carries a shield on her left arm, and wears a Corinthian helmet pushed to the back of the head.

claims.quote: This particular incarnation of the goddess - Aventine Minerva - was of Greek origin and the site was also the location of a writers and actors guild and an important centre for craftsmen.

statement.id: Wujud Minerva di Aventine berasal dari Yunani, dan tempat itu juga lokasi perkumpulan penulis dan aktor serta pusat penting pengrajin.
statement.en: The Aventine Minerva was of Greek origin, and the site was also home to a guild of writers and actors and an important centre for craftsmen.

claims.quote: Minerva's masterpiece showed all the great gods and had Minerva herself taking centre-stage in the act of winning the competition with Poseidon to become patron of Athens.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Arachne, tapestri Minerva menampilkan para dewa dan Minerva sendiri memenangkan perlombaan melawan Poseidon untuk menjadi pelindung Athena.
statement.en: In the Arachne story, Minerva's tapestry showed the great gods and Minerva herself winning the competition with Poseidon to become patron of Athens.

claims.quote: MINERVA, an Italian goddess, subsequently identified with Athena. She presided over all handicrafts, inventions, arts and sciences.

statement.id: Minerva adalah dewi Italia yang kemudian disamakan dengan Athena dan menguasai segala kerajinan, penemuan, seni, dan ilmu.
statement.en: Minerva is an Italian goddess, later identified with Athena, who presided over all handicrafts, inventions, arts and sciences.

claims.quote: Her oldest sanctuary at Rome was in the temple built by Tarquin on the Capitol, where she was worshipped with Jupiter and Juno.

statement.id: Tempat suci tertua Minerva di Roma berada di kuil yang dibangun Tarquin di Capitol, tempat ia dipuja bersama Jupiter dan Juno.
statement.en: Minerva's oldest sanctuary at Rome was in the temple built by Tarquin on the Capitol, where she was worshipped with Jupiter and Juno.

claims.quote: She had also a temple on the Aventine, which was the meeting-place for dramatic poets and actors

statement.id: Minerva juga memiliki kuil di Aventine, tempat pertemuan penyair drama dan aktor.
statement.en: Minerva also had a temple on the Aventine, the meeting-place for dramatic poets and actors.

claims.quote: The dedication day of the temple was the 19th of March, the great festival of Minerva, called quinquatrus, because it fell on the fifth day after the ides.

statement.id: Hari penahbisan kuil itu, 19 Maret, adalah pesta besar Minerva yang disebut quinquatrus karena jatuh pada hari kelima sesudah idus.
statement.en: The temple's dedication day, 19 March, was Minerva's great festival, called quinquatrus because it fell on the fifth day after the ides.

claims.quote: All the schools had holidays at this time, and the pupils on reassembling brought a fee (minerval) to the teachers.

statement.id: Pada pesta itu semua sekolah libur, dan murid yang kembali membawa bayaran (minerval) kepada guru.
statement.en: At this festival all schools had holidays, and pupils on reassembling brought a fee (minerval) to the teachers.

claims.quote: In every house also the quinquatrus was a holiday, for Minerva (like Athena Erganē) was patron of the women’s weaving and spinning and the workmen’s craft.

statement.id: Di setiap rumah quinquatrus juga hari libur karena Minerva adalah pelindung tenun dan pintal kaum perempuan serta kerajinan para pekerja.
statement.en: In every house the quinquatrus was also a holiday, for Minerva was patron of women's weaving and spinning and the workmen's craft.

claims.quote: the last four being chiefly occupied with gladiatorial shows—because Minverva was goddess of war

statement.id: Pada masa kemudian pesta itu diperpanjang lima hari, empat hari terakhir untuk pertunjukan gladiator, karena Minerva adalah dewi perang.
statement.en: At a later time the festival was extended to five days, the last four given to gladiatorial shows, because Minerva was goddess of war.

claims.quote: The erection of a temple to her by Pompey out of the spoils of his eastern conquests shows that she was the bestower of victory, like Athena Nikē

statement.id: Kuil yang didirikan Pompeius dari rampasan penaklukannya di timur menunjukkan bahwa Minerva adalah pemberi kemenangan, seperti Athena Nike.
statement.en: The temple Pompey erected from the spoils of his eastern conquests shows she was the bestower of victory, like Athena Nike.

claims.quote: Under Domitian, who claimed her special protection, the worship of Minerva attained its greatest vogue in Rome.

statement.id: Pada masa Domitianus, yang mengaku dilindunginya secara khusus, pemujaan Minerva mencapai puncak kepopulerannya di Roma.
statement.en: Under Domitian, who claimed her special protection, the worship of Minerva attained its greatest vogue in Rome.

claims.quote: There was another temple of Minerva on the Caelian Hill, where she was worshipped under the name of Capta, the “captive,” the origin of which is unknown.

statement.id: Ada kuil Minerva lain di Bukit Caelius, tempat ia dipuja dengan nama Capta, "tawanan", yang asal-usulnya tidak diketahui.
statement.en: There was another temple of Minerva on the Caelian Hill, where she was worshipped as Capta, "the captive", whose origin is unknown.

claims.quote: Here a festival called the lesser quinquatrus was celebrated on the 13th–14th of June, chiefly by the flute-players

statement.id: Di kuil itu pesta quinquatrus kecil dirayakan pada 13-14 Juni, terutama oleh para pemain seruling.
statement.en: There a festival called the lesser quinquatrus was celebrated on 13-14 June, chiefly by the flute-players.

claims.quote: A carved image of the goddess called the Palladium, said to have been brought from Troy to Lavinium, and thence to Rome by the family of the Nautii, was kept in the temple of Vesta and carefully guarded as necessary to the prosperity of the city.

statement.id: Sebuah arca ukir sang dewi yang disebut Palladium, konon dibawa dari Troya ke Lavinium lalu ke Roma oleh keluarga Nautii, disimpan di kuil Vesta dan dijaga ketat demi kemakmuran kota.
statement.en: A carved image of the goddess called the Palladium, said to have been brought from Troy to Lavinium and then to Rome by the family of the Nautii, was kept in the temple of Vesta and carefully guarded for the city's prosperity.

claims.quote: The older form of the name Minerva is Menerva ... it probably means “thinker.”

statement.id: Menurut Britannica 1911, bentuk lama nama Minerva adalah Menerva, yang mungkin berarti "pemikir".
statement.en: According to the 1911 Britannica, the older form of the name Minerva is Menerva, which probably means "thinker".

claims.quote: As the Romans learnt the use of the flute from the Etruscans, the fact of Minerva being the patron goddess of flute-players is in favour of her Etruscan origin, although it may merely be a reminiscence of the Greek story which attributed the invention of the flute to Athena.

statement.id: Karena bangsa Romawi belajar seruling dari Etruska, kedudukan Minerva sebagai pelindung pemain seruling mendukung asal-usul Etruskanya, meski mungkin hanya gema kisah Yunani tentang Athena.
statement.en: Since the Romans learnt the flute from the Etruscans, Minerva's role as patron of flute-players favours an Etruscan origin, although it may merely echo the Greek story about Athena.

claims.quote: Minerva comes to you!” And with those brief words, put aside the shape of the old woman, and revealed herself, Minerva, goddess.

statement.id: Dalam Ovid, Minerva menanggalkan wujud perempuan tua dan menyingkapkan dirinya sebagai dewi Minerva.
statement.en: In Ovid, Minerva puts aside the shape of the old woman and reveals herself as the goddess Minerva.

claims.quote: Minerva worked the Athenian Hill of Mars, where ancient Cecrops built his citadel, and showed the old contention for the name it should be given.

statement.id: Dalam Ovid, Minerva menenun Bukit Mars di Athena dan perselisihan lama tentang nama kota itu.
statement.en: In Ovid, Minerva wove the Athenian Hill of Mars and the old contention over the city's name.

claims.quote: And then she wove a portrait of herself, bearing a shield, and in her hand a lance,

statement.id: Dalam Ovid, Minerva menenun potret dirinya yang membawa perisai dan tombak di tangannya.
statement.en: In Ovid, Minerva wove a portrait of herself bearing a shield and a lance in her hand.

claims.quote: she ripped the web, and ruined all the scenes that showed those wicked actions of the Gods; and with her boxwood shuttle in her hand, struck the unhappy mortal on her head,—struck sharply thrice, and even once again.

statement.id: Dalam Ovid, Minerva merobek tenunan Arachne dan menghantam kepalanya dengan teropong buksus berulang kali.
statement.en: In Ovid, Minerva ripped Arachne's web and struck her on the head with her boxwood shuttle repeatedly.

short_description.id: Succubus adalah iblis perempuan dalam cerita rakyat Eropa yang muncul dalam mimpi lelaki untuk merayunya, menguras kesehatannya, dan dapat melahirkan anak setengah iblis bernama cambion.
short_description.en: The succubus is a female demon of European folklore who visits men in dreams to seduce them, drains their health and may bear a half-demon child called a cambion.

long_description.id: Succubus, dari bahasa Latin succuba, "yang berbaring di bawah", adalah iblis perempuan yang muncul dalam mimpi lelaki untuk merayunya. Hubungan berulang dengannya dapat melahirkan cambion, anak setengah iblis, tetapi menguras jiwa dan raga lelaki itu hingga mati. Ia berwujud perempuan cantik yang bila diamati memiliki cakar burung atau ekor ular, dan kemudian juga digambarkan sebagai siren.
long_description.en: The succubus, from Latin succuba, 'one who lies beneath', is a female demon who appears in men's dreams to seduce them. Repeated unions can produce a cambion, a half-demon child, but drain the man body and mind until he dies. She looks like a beautiful woman who on closer view shows bird claws or a serpent's tail, and later lore also made her a siren.

long_description.id: Malleus Maleficarum (1486) menyebut succubi mengumpulkan air mani yang lalu dipakai incubi untuk menghamili perempuan, sementara Thomas Aquinas menganggap keduanya satu makhluk yang berganti wujud; Raja James membantah bahwa makhluk semacam itu dapat berkembang biak, dan Sinistrari menganggap mereka makhluk berakal yang bukan iblis. Merlin konon anak incubus. Imam dan rabi seperti Hanina ben Dosa berusaha membatasi kuasanya.
long_description.en: The Malleus Maleficarum (1486) says succubi gather semen that incubi then use to impregnate women, while Thomas Aquinas saw them as one shape-changing being; King James denied such beings could breed, and Sinistrari held them rational creatures, not demons. Merlin was said to be an incubus's son. Priests and rabbis such as Hanina ben Dosa tried to curb their power.

long_description.id: Kepercayaan ini didorong oleh mimpi basah dan kelumpuhan tidur. Kini succubus lebih sering digambarkan sebagai penggoda cantik daripada iblis menakutkan, dan menurut artikel bahasa Indonesia sasarannya adalah orang yang lemah iman atau kesepian.
long_description.en: The belief was driven by wet dreams and sleep paralysis. Today the succubus is more often drawn as a beautiful seductress than a frightening demon, and the Indonesian article names her targets as the weak in faith or the lonely.

long_description.id: Sumber klasik dan akademik menambah gambaran ini. Britannica 1911 menyebut succubae sebagai padanan perempuan dari setan incubus yang diyakini menghantui perempuan dalam tidurnya. Dalam Summa Theologiae, Aquinas menyatakan bahwa bila ada anak lahir dari iblis, itu berasal dari benih manusia yang diambil untuk tujuan itu, dengan iblis mengambil rupa perempuan lalu rupa lelaki. Montague Summers mengutip pernyataan bahwa roh jahat yang sama dapat menjadi succubus bagi lelaki dan incubus bagi perempuan, serta bahwa roh jahat tampil sebagai incubi dan succubi untuk melukai manusia pada jiwa dan raganya; ia sendiri mengakui bahwa banyak kisah semacam ini dapat dikembalikan pada histeria, halusinasi, dan mimpi buruk.
long_description.en: Classical and scholarly sources add to this picture. The 1911 Britannica calls succubae the female counterparts of the incubus, a male demon supposed to haunt women in their sleep. In the Summa Theologiae, Aquinas holds that if children are born from demons, it is from the seed of men taken for the purpose, with the demon assuming first the form of a woman and afterwards of a man. Montague Summers quotes statements that a single evil spirit can act as a succubus toward a man and as an incubus toward a woman, and that evil spirits appear as incubi and succubi to hurt man in soul and body; he himself allows that many such accounts may be ascribed to hysteria, hallucinations and nightmare.

role.en: Seduces men and drains their life.

short_description.id: Agni adalah dewa api dalam tradisi Hindu, penting dalam himne Weda dan berperan membawa persembahan kepada para dewa.
short_description.en: Agni is the Hindu fire deity, important in the Vedic hymns and believed to carry offerings to the gods.

long_description.id: Agni dipandang sebagai sahabat dan pelindung manusia, terutama penjaga rumah. Berbagai bentuk api dikaitkan dengannya, dari api rumah dan kurban hingga petir dan api pembakaran jenazah; ia disebut juga bertanggung jawab atas petir. Pada api pembakaran jenazah, ia menuntun orang mati ke penghakiman akhir oleh Yama. Ia dianggap mengetahui pikiran semua orang dan menjadi saksi tindakan penting, karena itu api hadir dalam upacara Hindu seperti pernikahan. Hingga kini ia masih dianggap hadir di mana-mana, meski tidak dipuja secara langsung.
long_description.en: Agni is regarded as friend and protector of humanity, in particular safeguarding the home. Many forms of fire are associated with him, from domestic and sacrificial fires to lightning and the funeral pyre, and he is said to be responsible for lightning. At the funeral pyre he leads the dead to their final judgement by Yama. He is thought to know the thoughts of all people and to witness important acts, so fire appears in Hindu ceremonies such as marriages. He is still considered omnipresent today, though not directly worshipped.

long_description.id: Dalam tradisi kurban, Agni diyakini membawa persembahan manusia kepada para dewa. Himne pertama Rig Weda memujinya sebagai imam dan pelayan kurban, layak dipuji oleh orang hidup maupun resi terdahulu, serta penjaga hukum abadi, dan sebuah himne lain menyebutnya utusan, pewarta, serta Penguasa Rumah. Sebuah esai museum juga menyebut Agni sebagai dewa api dan menyatakan bahwa Hinduisme berakar pada teks-teks kuno. Agni sangat penting pada periode Weda, dan Weda memuat lebih banyak himne untuknya daripada untuk dewa lain.
long_description.en: In sacrificial tradition, Agni is believed to carry human offerings to the gods. The first Rig Veda hymn praises him as priest and minister of sacrifice, worthy of praise by the living and ancient seers, and guardian of eternal law, and another hymn calls him messenger, herald, and Lord of the House. A museum essay also names Agni as the god of fire and says Hinduism has its roots in ancient texts. Agni was especially important in the Vedic period, and the Vedas contain more hymns to him than to any other deity.

long_description.id: Mitos menceritakan bahwa Agni mula-mula takut mengemban tugas membawa kurban karena tiga saudaranya sudah terbunuh saat menjalankannya, lalu bersembunyi di perairan bawah tanah. Ikan membocorkan tempatnya, sehingga ia mengutuknya menjadi mangsa mudah manusia; dalam versi lain katak, gajah, dan burung beo yang membocorkan dan dihukum dengan ucapan yang cacat. Tempat persembunyian terakhirnya adalah pohon sami, dan ia kemudian menerima bagian tetap dari kurban serta hidup abadi.
long_description.en: Myths say Agni was at first afraid to take on the task of carrying the sacrifice because his three brothers had already been killed performing it, and hid in the subterranean waters. Fish revealed his hiding place, so he cursed them to become easy prey of men; in another version frogs, elephants, and parrots revealed him and were punished with distorted speech. His final hiding place was a sami tree, and he afterward received a fixed share of the sacrifice and ever-lasting life.

long_description.id: Agni juga memiliki sisi gelap: dalam sebuah himne Rigweda ia memiliki taring besi dan melahap korbannya tanpa belas kasihan, tetapi ia membinasakan para raksasa dengan tombak apinya bila dipanggil para dewa. Ia disebut sebagai putra Air Surgawi, atau dalam Visnu Purana sebagai putra sulung Brahma dengan Svaha sebagai istrinya. Pentingnya sebagai dewa disebut berkurang karena kelewat banyak menyantap persembahan.
long_description.en: Agni also has a darker side: in a Rigveda hymn he has iron tusks and devours his victims without mercy, but he destroys the raksasa with his flaming spears when called upon by the gods. He is described as son of the Celestial Waters, or in the Visnu Purana as the eldest son of Brahma with Svaha as his wife. His importance as a god is said to diminish because of overindulgence in consuming offerings.

long_description.id: Penggambaran seni dapat memperlihatkan Agni dengan dua kepala, empat lengan, dan tunggangan kambing. Dua kepala itu ditafsirkan sebagai api rumah dan api kurban. Ia membawa kipas, sendok kurban, kapak, serta obor menyala atau lembing. Ia juga dikaitkan dengan penjagaan arah tenggara sebagai salah satu Dikpala.
long_description.en: Art may show Agni with two heads, four arms, and a goat mount. The two heads symbolize domestic and sacrificial fires. He carries a fan, a sacrificial ladle, an axe, and a flaming torch or javelin. He is also associated with guarding the southeast as one of the Dikpalas.

cultural_context.id: Agni dianggap mengetahui pikiran semua orang dan menjadi saksi semua tindakan penting, sehingga api dipakai dalam banyak upacara Hindu penting seperti pernikahan; ia juga dipandang membawa persembahan manusia kepada para dewa.
cultural_context.en: Agni is thought to know the thoughts of all people and witness all important actions, so fire is used in many important Hindu ceremonies such as marriages; he is also thought to carry human offerings to the gods.
