claims.quote: In later Hindu art, Agni is also represented as one of the Dikpalas who were the eight guardians of the directions of space.

statement.id: Dalam seni Hindu yang lebih kemudian, Agni juga digambarkan sebagai salah satu Dikpala, delapan penjaga arah ruang.
statement.en: In later Hindu art Agni is also represented as one of the Dikpalas, the eight guardians of the directions of space.

claims.quote: He is still considered today omnipresent though not directly worshipped.

statement.id: Hingga kini Agni masih dianggap hadir di mana-mana, meski tidak dipuja secara langsung.
statement.en: Agni is still considered today to be omnipresent though not directly worshipped.

claims.quote: WE choose Agni the messenger, the herald, master of all wealth, Well skilled in this our sacrifice.

statement.id: Sebuah himne menyebut Agni sebagai utusan dan pewarta, tuan segala kekayaan, yang terampil dalam kurban.
statement.en: A hymn calls Agni the messenger and herald, master of all wealth, well skilled in sacrifice.

claims.quote: Bring the Gods hither, Agni, born for him who strews the sacred grass: Thou art our herald, meet for praise.

statement.id: Agni diminta membawa para dewa ke tempat kurban dan disebut pewarta yang layak dipuji.
statement.en: Agni is asked to bring the Gods to the sacrifice and is called the herald, meet for praise.

claims.quote: With callings ever they invoke Agni, Agni, Lord of the House, Oblation-bearer, much beloved.

statement.id: Agni diseru sebagai Penguasa Rumah dan Pembawa Persembahan yang sangat dicintai.
statement.en: Agni is invoked as Lord of the House and Oblation-bearer, much beloved.

claims.quote: O Agni, radiant One, to whom the holy oil is poured, burn up Our enemies whom fiends protect.

statement.id: Agni diminta membakar habis musuh-musuh para pemuja yang dilindungi oleh para iblis.
statement.en: Agni is asked to burn up the enemies whom fiends protect.

summary.id: Agni adalah putra Air Surgawi.
summary.en: Agni is the son of the Celestial Waters.

summary.id: Dalam Visnu Purana, ia putra sulung Brahma.
summary.en: In the Visnu Purana he is the eldest son of Brahma.

summary.id: Ikan membocorkannya, lalu Agni mengutuk ikan.
summary.en: Fish revealed it, and Agni cursed them.

summary.id: Dalam versi lain, katak, gajah, lalu burung beo yang membocorkannya.
summary.en: In another version frogs, then elephants, and then parrots revealed it.

summary.id: Agni dipandang sebagai sahabat dan pelindung manusia.
summary.en: Agni is regarded as friend and protector of humanity.

summary.id: Sebuah himne Rigweda menggambarkan sisi gelapnya: ia melahap korban tanpa belas kasihan.
summary.en: A Rigveda hymn describes a darker side: he devours victims without mercy.

text.en: attested from at least the 10th century CE; still remembered in Iceland around the year 1000 CE

short_description.id: Freyja adalah dewi Nordik dari kelompok Vanir, terkait cinta, kesuburan, kekayaan, seiðr, dan perang; ia menerima separuh prajurit gugur di Fólkvangr.
short_description.en: Freyja is a Norse Vanir goddess linked to love, fertility, wealth, seiðr, and battle; she receives half the battle dead in Fólkvangr.

long_description.id: Freyja adalah dewi Nordik kesuburan, cinta, dan keindahan, juga terkait sihir dan perang. Ia putri Njord dan saudari Freyr dari kelompok Vanir; nama ibunya tidak disebut dalam sumber. Tongkatnya menandai penguasaan seiðr, dan ia dikisahkan mengajarkan praktik ini kepada Odin. Nama Freyja dalam Nordik Kuno berarti nyonya, dan ia punya banyak nama lain seperti Mardol, Horn, Gefn, Syr, dan Vanadis.
long_description.en: Freyja is a Norse goddess of fertility, love, and beauty, also linked to magic and war. She is Njord's daughter and Freyr's sister among the Vanir; her mother's name is not given in the sources. Her staff marks her mastery of seiðr, which she is said to have taught Odin. Her Old Norse name means lady or mistress, and she has many other names such as Mardol, Horn, Gefn, Syr, and Vanadis.

long_description.id: Keretanya ditarik dua kucing besar, dan pakaian bulu elang termasuk atributnya. Sebagai dewi pertempuran ia menerima separuh prajurit yang gugur di Fólkvangr, sedangkan separuh lainnya menuju Valhalla. Ia juga disebut dewi kekayaan; menurut Edda Muda air matanya adalah emas merah ketika ia menangisi suaminya Oder yang pergi jauh.
long_description.en: Two great cats draw her chariot, and a falcon-feather garment is among her attributes. As a battle goddess she receives half the slain in Fólkvangr, while the rest go to Valhalla. She is also called a goddess of wealth; in the Younger Edda her tears are red gold as she weeps for her husband Oder, who went far away.

long_description.id: Freyja mengenakan kalung Brísingamen, yang menurut mitos ia peroleh dari empat kurcaci; ia tinggal di rumah megah yang dijaga ketat. Dalam satu kisah, Loki menjadi kutu untuk mencurinya; sumber berbeda tentang rincian pencurian itu. Freyja juga muncul dalam Þrymskviða, Hyndluljóð, kisah tukang bangunan, kisah raksasa Hrungnir, dan kisah Idun, ketika ia meminjamkan wujud elangnya kepada Loki.
long_description.en: Freyja wore the necklace Brísingamen, which according to the myth she obtained from four dwarfs; she lived in a splendid, well-guarded house. In one tale Loki becomes a flea to steal it; sources differ on the details of the theft. Freyja also appears in the Þrymskviða, the Hyndluljóð, the story of the builder, the story of the giant Hrungnir, and the story of Idun, when she lends her falcon guise to Loki.

long_description.id: Pemujaan Freyja ditunjukkan oleh banyak nama tempat di Swedia dan Norwegia, meski sumber Nordik Kuno tidak merinci kultusnya. Ia salah satu dari sedikit dewi perorangan yang berperan besar dalam kultus yang lebih resmi, dan orang Islandia sekitar tahun 1000 M masih mengingatnya. Museum Sejarah Swedia menyimpan liontin perak Zaman Viking yang diperkirakan menggambarkannya.
long_description.en: Freyja's worship is shown by many place-names in Sweden and Norway, although the Old Norse sources do not detail her cult. She is one of the few individual goddesses with a major role in the more official cult, and the people of Iceland around the year 1000 CE still remembered her. The Swedish History Museum holds a Viking Age silver pendant thought to depict her.

cultural_context.id: Menurut sarjana yang dikutip World History Encyclopedia, Freyja adalah salah satu dari sedikit dewi perorangan yang berperan besar dalam kultus keagamaan yang lebih resmi, bukan hanya dalam mitos dan ritual sebagai kelompok.
cultural_context.en: According to a scholar quoted by World History Encyclopedia, Freyja is one of the few individual goddesses who had a major role in the more official religious cult, rather than a collective in myth and ritual.

who.id: Freyja adalah dewi Nordik dari kelompok Vanir.
who.en: Freyja is a Norse goddess of the Vanir.

origin.id: Ia putri Njord dan saudari kembar Freyr dalam mitologi Nordik.
origin.en: She is the daughter of Njord and twin sister of Freyr in Norse mythology.

role.id: Ia dewi cinta, kesuburan, dan kekayaan yang menguasai seiðr dan menerima separuh prajurit gugur.
role.en: She is a goddess of love, fertility, and wealth who masters seiðr and receives half the slain warriors.

famous_for.id: Freyja paling dikenal karena kalung Brísingamen, keretanya yang ditarik kucing, dan penguasaannya atas seiðr.
famous_for.en: Freyja is best known for the necklace Brísingamen, her cat-drawn chariot, and her mastery of seiðr.

did_you_know.id: Dalam catatan Edda Muda tentang Odin, Freyja satu-satunya dewa yang tersisa dan namanya dipakai sebagai gelar kehormatan bagi perempuan terpandang, yaitu Frue.
did_you_know.en: In the Younger Edda's account of Odin, Freyja alone remained of the gods and her name became the honorific title Frue for women of distinction.

description.id: Freyja menguasai seiðr, bentuk sihir yang memungkinkan orang melihat masa depan, dan menurut catatan Ynglinga ia pertama kali mengajarkan seni sihir kepada orang Asaland.
description.en: Freyja masters seiðr, a form of magic through which one can see into the future, and in the Ynglinga account she first taught the magic art to the Asaland people.

description.id: Freyja mengajarkan Odin cara berlatih seiðr dan seni ramalan.
description.en: Freyja teaches Odin how to practise seiðr and the art of divination.

description.id: Atas tuntutan Odin, Freyja menggunakan sihirnya untuk menjatuhkan mantra pada dua raja perkasa agar bertarung abadi.
description.en: At Odin's demand, Freyja used her magic to cast a spell upon two mighty kings, forcing them to fight in an eternal battle.

description.id: Sebagai dewi pertempuran, Freyja menerima separuh prajurit gugur di Fólkvangr, sedangkan separuh lainnya menuju Odin di Valhalla.
description.en: As a battle goddess Freyja receives half the slain warriors in Fólkvangr, while the other half go to Odin in Valhalla.

description.id: Freyja bepergian dengan kereta yang ditarik dua kucing besar.
description.en: Freyja travels in a chariot drawn by two great cats.

description.id: Salah satu atribut Freyja adalah pakaian dari bulu elang, dan dalam kisah Idun ia meminjamkan wujud elangnya kepada Loki.
description.en: One of Freyja's attributes is a garment of falcon feathers, and in the story of Idun she lends her falcon guise to Loki.

description.id: Ketika menangisi Ódr, Freyja meneteskan air mata emas.
description.en: When she weeps for Ódr, Freyja sheds golden tears.

description.id: Dalam catatan ini Freyja putri Njord adalah pendeta kurban yang mengajarkan seni sihir kepada orang Asaland, dan ia menjadi sangat termasyhur sehingga perempuan terpandang bergelar Frue.
description.en: In this account Njord's daughter Freyja is priestess of the sacrifices who taught the magic art to the Asaland people, and she became so celebrated that women of distinction bear the title Frue.

description.id: Versi paling rinci dan paling muda menceritakan Freyja tidur dengan empat kurcaci untuk mendapat kalung dan Odin memaksa Loki mencurinya.
description.en: The most detailed and youngest version tells how Freyja sleeps with four dwarves to get the necklace and how Odin forces Loki to steal it.

role.id: Freyja memperoleh, kehilangan, dan menebus kembali kalungnya.
role.en: Freyja acquires, loses, and regains her necklace.

summary.id: Dalam satu kisah, Freyja melihat empat kurcaci menempa kalung dan menyetujui permintaan mereka demi memperolehnya. Loki, berubah menjadi kutu, mencurinya atas perintah Odin, dan Odin hanya mau mengembalikannya jika Freyja memakai sihirnya agar dua raja bertarung abadi.
summary.en: In one tale Freyja sees four dwarfs forging a necklace and agrees to their proposal to obtain it. Loki, turned into a flea, steals it at Odin's bidding, and Odin will return it only if Freyja uses her magic to make two kings fight eternally.

role.id: Freyja dituntut sebagai harga palu Thor.
role.en: Freyja is demanded as the price of Thor's hammer.

summary.id: Raksasa Thrym mencuri palu Thor dan hanya akan mengembalikannya jika mendapat Freyja. Freyja menolak ikut, dan menyerahkan Brísingamen untuk membantu Thor menyamar sebagai dirinya.
summary.en: The giant Thrym steals Thor's hammer and will return it only if he gets Freyja. Freyja refuses to go and gives up the Brísingamen to help Thor disguise himself as her.

role.en: Freyja is demanded as the builder's reward.

summary.id: Seorang tukang bangunan menawarkan membangun benteng bagi para dewa dan menuntut Freyja, matahari, dan bulan sebagai upahnya.
summary.en: A builder offered to build a fortress for the gods and demanded Freyja, the sun and the moon as his reward.

role.id: Freyja meminjamkan wujud elangnya kepada Loki.
role.en: Freyja lends her falcon guise to Loki.

summary.id: Untuk memulangkan Idun dari Jotunheim, Loki meminta wujud elang milik Freyja dan berjanji akan membawanya kembali.
summary.en: To fetch Idun home from Jotunheim, Loki asked for Freyja's falcon guise and promised to bring her back.

role.id: Freyja termasuk dewa yang akan dibawa pulang Hrungnir.
role.en: Freyja is among those Hrungnir would take home.

summary.id: Hrungnir membual akan memindahkan Valhalla ke Jotunheimen, menenggelamkan Asgard, dan membunuh semua dewa kecuali Freyja dan Sif.
summary.en: Hrungnir boasts he would move Valhalla into Jotunheimen, sink Asgard, and kill all the gods except Freyja and Sif.

role.en: Freyja seeks genealogical knowledge.

summary.id: Freyja mengunjungi perempuan bijak Hyndla dan memintanya mengurai silsilah pahlawan Óttar, dengan menunggangi babi hutan Hildisvíni.
summary.en: Freyja visits the wise-woman Hyndla and asks her to unravel the hero Óttar's ancestry, riding the boar Hildisvíni.

role.id: Freyja mencari suaminya sambil menangis emas.
role.en: Freyja searches for her husband weeping gold.

summary.id: Ódr mengembara dan meninggalkan Freyja, yang lalu mencarinya sambil menangis air mata emas.
summary.en: Ódr went on long journeys and left Freyja behind, who then searched for him weeping golden tears.

description.id: Aula Freyja, tempat separuh prajurit gugur berkumpul, sedangkan separuh lainnya menuju Valhalla.
description.en: Freyja's hall, where half of the slain warriors go, while the other half go to Valhalla.

name.id: Nama tempat Frøihov dan Frǫvi (Swedia dan Norwegia)
name.en: Place-names Frøihov and Frǫvi (Sweden and Norway)

description.id: Nama tempat yang berasal dari "kuil Freyja" dan "tempat suci Freyja" menunjukkan pemujaan yang jelas.
description.en: Place-names derived from "Freyja's temple" and "Freyja's shrine" show clear worship.

title.id: Kisah Ódr dan air mata emas
title.en: The tale of Ódr and the golden tears

description.id: Kisah Freyja mencari Ódr sambil menangis air mata emas berasal sekurangnya dari abad ke-10 M.
description.en: The tale of Freyja searching for Ódr weeping golden tears dates back to at least the 10th century CE.

description.id: Orang Islandia menjelang peralihan ke agama Kristen masih jelas mengingat Freyja.
description.en: The people of Iceland on the cusp of conversion to Christianity still clearly had Freyja on their mind.

description.id: Sumber-sumber Nordik Kuno akhir menetapkan kalung Brísingamen sebagai milik Freyja.
description.en: Late Old Norse sources assign the necklace Brísingamen to Freyja.

note.id: Freyja adalah putri Njord.
note.en: Freyja is Njord's daughter.

note.id: Freyja adalah saudari kembar Freyr.
note.en: Freyja is Freyr's twin sister.

note.id: Freyja dikisahkan mengajarkan seiðr kepada Odin, dan menurut mitos adalah kekasih Odin; separuh prajurit gugur menjadi milik Odin.
note.en: Freyja was said to teach Odin seiðr and in myth was Odin's lover; the other half of the slain belong to Odin.

note.id: Freyja bersuami Oder (Ódr), yang pergi mengembara; Ódr dan Odin umumnya dianggap semula satu pribadi.
note.en: Freyja is wedded to Oder (Ódr), who went away on journeys; Ódr and Odin are commonly thought to have been one and the same.

note.id: Hnos adalah putri Freyja, bersama saudarinya Gersame.
note.en: Hnos is Freyja's daughter, together with her sister Gersame.

note.id: Gersame adalah putri Freyja.
note.en: Gersame is Freyja's daughter.

note.id: Menurut Edda Muda, Freyja disejajarkan dengan Frigg.
note.en: According to the Younger Edda, Freyja is ranked with Frigg.

note.id: Loki mencuri kalung Freyja dan meminjam wujud elangnya.
note.en: Loki steals Freyja's necklace and borrows her falcon guise.

note.id: Freyja menyerahkan Brísingamen untuk membantu Thor menyamar sebagai dirinya demi memulihkan palunya.
note.en: Freyja gives up the Brísingamen to help Thor disguise himself as her.

note.id: Raksasa Thrym menuntut Freyja sebagai harga palu Thor yang dicurinya.
note.en: The giant Thrym demands Freyja as the price for Thor's stolen hammer.

note.id: Freyja mengunjungi Hyndla untuk menanyakan silsilah Óttar.
note.en: Freyja visits Hyndla to ask about Óttar's ancestry.

note.id: Dalam Hyndluljóð, Freyja menunggangi babi hutan Hildisvíni.
note.en: In the Hyndluljóð, Freyja rides the boar Hildisvíni.

learning_questions.en: Why do different sources tell the theft of the Brísingamen in different ways?

learning_questions.id: Apa yang ditunjukkan nama-nama tempat tentang pemujaan Freyja ketika sumber tertulis tidak merinci kultusnya?
learning_questions.en: What do place-names show about the worship of Freyja when the written sources do not detail her cult?

statement.id: Freyja adalah dewi Nordik kesuburan, cinta, dan keindahan yang juga berkaitan dengan sihir serta perang.
statement.en: Freyja is a Norse goddess of fertility, love, and beauty, also linked to magic and war.

claims.quote: She is the daughter of the sea god Njord and the twin sister of Freyr, who, like her, belongs to the family of gods known as the Vanir.

statement.id: Freyja adalah putri Njord, saudari Freyr, dan anggota kelompok dewa Vanir.
statement.en: Freyja is Njord's daughter, Freyr's sister, and a member of the Vanir.

claims.quote: Freyja often carries a staff, a sign of her mastery of seiðr, a form of magic through which one can see into the future.

statement.id: Tongkat Freyja melambangkan penguasaannya atas seiðr, sihir untuk melihat masa depan.
statement.en: Freyja's staff signifies mastery of seiðr, a magic associated with foresight.

claims.quote: It is Freyja who teaches Odin, foremost of the Æsir, how to practise seiðr and the art of divination.

statement.id: Freyja dikisahkan mengajarkan seiðr dan ramalan kepada Odin.
statement.en: Freyja is said to have taught seiðr and divination to Odin.

claims.quote: As a goddess of battle, she receives half of the slain warriors into her hall, Fólkvangr, while the other half go to Odin in Valhalla.

claims.quote: Freyja wore a jewel called Brísingamen. It was the most beautiful necklace in the world and greatly coveted.

statement.id: Freyja memiliki kalung Brísingamen yang sangat diinginkan.
statement.en: Freyja wore the coveted necklace Brísingamen.

claims.quote: Loki saw that the clasp was at her neck. He changed into a flea, bit her on the cheek, and waited until she turned in her sleep.

statement.en: In one tale Loki becomes a flea to steal Freyja's necklace.

claims.quote: Freyja (Old Norse for 'Lady', 'Woman', or 'Mistress') is the best-known and most important goddess in Norse mythology.

statement.en: The Old Norse name Freyja means lady or mistress.

claims.quote: Another is a garment - a coat, cloak or dress-like thing - made out of falcon feathers.

statement.id: Salah satu atribut Freyja adalah pakaian dari bulu elang.
statement.en: One of Freyja's attributes is a garment of falcon feathers.

claims.quote: The Old Norse sources do not specifically detail the existence of a cult of Freyja per se, but the large number of place-names in Sweden and Norway related to her name

statement.id: Nama tempat di Swedia dan Norwegia menunjukkan jejak pemujaan Freyja, meski rincian kultusnya terbatas.
statement.en: Place-names in Sweden and Norway suggest Freyja's worship, though cult details are sparse.

claims.quote: Name: Freyja (also spelt Freja, Freyia)

statement.id: Nama: Freyja (juga ditulis Freja, Freyia).
statement.en: Name: Freyja (also spelt Freja, Freyia).

claims.quote: She lived in a splendid and well-guarded house, into which no one could enter without her leave.

statement.id: Menurut mitos, Freyja tinggal di rumah megah yang dijaga ketat, yang tidak boleh dimasuki siapa pun tanpa izinnya.
statement.en: According to the myth, Freyja lived in a splendid, well-guarded house that no one could enter without her leave.

claims.quote: They proposed that she should lie with each of them for one night in exchange for the jewel. Freyja agreed to the bargain.

statement.id: Menurut mitos, empat kurcaci meminta Freyja menemani masing-masing semalam sebagai ganti permata itu, dan Freyja menyetujuinya.
statement.en: According to the myth, four dwarfs proposed that Freyja lie with each of them for a night in exchange for the jewel, and she agreed.

claims.quote: Odin agreed to return the jewel, but only if Freyja first used her magic. He required her to cast a spell upon two mighty kings, forcing them to fight each other in an eternal battle.

statement.id: Odin setuju mengembalikan permata itu hanya jika Freyja lebih dahulu memakai sihirnya untuk menjatuhkan mantra pada dua raja perkasa agar bertarung abadi.
statement.en: Odin agreed to return the jewel only if Freyja first used her magic to cast a spell on two mighty kings, forcing them to fight each other in an eternal battle.

claims.quote: Viking Age silver pendant thought to depict Freyja.

statement.id: Museum Sejarah Swedia menyimpan liontin perak Zaman Viking yang diperkirakan menggambarkan Freyja.
statement.en: The Swedish History Museum holds a Viking Age silver pendant thought to depict Freyja.

claims.quote: Symbolism: Love, fertility, beauty, seiðr (Old Norse magic)

statement.id: Lambang Freyja menurut museum adalah cinta, kesuburan, kecantikan, dan seiðr (sihir Nordik Kuno).
statement.en: According to the museum, Freyja symbolises love, fertility, beauty, and seiðr (Old Norse magic).

claims.quote: Parents: Njord (father) – her mother’s name is not mentioned in the sources

statement.id: Ayah Freyja adalah Njord; nama ibunya tidak disebut dalam sumber.
statement.en: Freyja's father is Njord; her mother's name is not mentioned in the sources.

claims.quote: According to the myth, Freyja was Odin’s lover.

statement.id: Menurut mitos, Freyja adalah kekasih Odin.
statement.en: According to the myth, Freyja was Odin's lover.

claims.quote: Freyja is the most famous of the goddesses. She has in heaven a dwelling which is called Folkvang, and when she rides to the battle, one half of the slain belong to her, and the other half to Odin.

statement.id: Menurut Edda Muda, Freyja adalah dewi paling termasyhur; ia punya tempat tinggal di surga bernama Folkvang, dan ketika ia berkuda ke pertempuran separuh yang gugur menjadi miliknya dan separuh lagi milik Odin.
statement.en: According to the Younger Edda, Freyja is the most famous of the goddesses; she has a dwelling in heaven called Folkvang, and when she rides to battle half of the slain belong to her and half to Odin.

claims.quote: Oder went far away. Freyja weeps for him, but her tears are red gold.

statement.id: Menurut Edda Muda, Oder pergi jauh dan Freyja menangisinya, tetapi air matanya adalah emas merah.
statement.en: According to the Younger Edda, Oder went far away and Freyja weeps for him, but her tears are red gold.

claims.quote: Freyja has many names, and the reason therefor is that she changed her name among the various nations to which she came in search of Oder. She is called Mardol, Horn, Gefn, and Syr. She has the necklace Brising, and she is called Vanadis.

statement.id: Freyja punya banyak nama karena ia berganti nama di berbagai bangsa saat mencari Oder: Mardol, Horn, Gefn, Syr, dan Vanadis; ia memiliki kalung Brising.
statement.en: Freyja has many names because she changed her name among the nations she visited in search of Oder: Mardol, Horn, Gefn, Syr, and Vanadis; she has the necklace Brising.

claims.quote: The sixth is Freyja, who is ranked with Frigg. She is wedded to the man whose name is Oder; their daughter’s name is Hnos, and she is so fair that all things fair and precious are called, from her name, Hnos.

statement.id: Freyja disejajarkan dengan Frigg dan bersuami Oder; putri mereka bernama Hnos, yang begitu cantik sehingga semua yang indah dan berharga disebut dengan namanya.
statement.en: Freyja is ranked with Frigg and wedded to Oder; their daughter is Hnos, so fair that all things fair and precious are called by her name.

claims.quote: But he demanded as his reward, that he should have Freyja, and he wanted the sun and moon besides.

statement.id: Dalam kisah tukang bangunan, ia menuntut Freyja beserta matahari dan bulan sebagai upahnya.
statement.en: In the story of the builder, he demanded Freyja as his reward, and the sun and moon besides.

claims.quote: Heimdal rode his steed Gulltop, and Freyja drove her cats.

statement.id: Pada pembakaran jenazah Baldr, Freyja mengendarai kucing-kucingnya.
statement.en: At Balder's funeral pyre, Freyja drove her cats.

claims.quote: he became frightened, and promised to bring Idun back from Jotunheim if Freyja would lend him the falcon-guise that she had.

statement.id: Loki berjanji membawa Idun kembali dari Jotunheim jika Freyja meminjamkan wujud elang yang dimilikinya.
statement.en: Loki promised to bring Idun back from Jotunheim if Freyja would lend him the falcon-guise that she had.

claims.quote: Njord’s daughter, Freyja, was priestess of the sacrifices, and first taught the Asaland people the magic art, as it was in use and fashion among the Vanaland people.

statement.id: Dalam catatan Ynglinga, Freyja putri Njord adalah pendeta kurban dan pertama kali mengajarkan seni sihir kepada orang Asaland, seperti yang lazim di antara orang Vanaland.
statement.en: In the Ynglinga account, Njord's daughter Freyja was priestess of the sacrifices and first taught the Asaland people the magic art, as practised among the Vanaland people.

claims.quote: Njord, in Noatun, afterward begat two children: a son, by name Frey, and a daughter, by name Freyja. They were fair of face, and mighty.

statement.id: Njord kemudian memiliki dua anak, putra bernama Frey dan putri bernama Freyja, yang rupawan dan perkasa.
statement.en: Njord afterward had two children, a son named Frey and a daughter named Freyja, fair of face and mighty.

claims.quote: Freyja alone remained of the gods, and she became on this account so celebrated that all women of distinction were called by her name, whence they now have the title Frue

statement.id: Freyja menjadi begitu termasyhur sehingga semua perempuan terpandang dipanggil dengan namanya, maka mereka bergelar Frue.
statement.en: Freyja became so celebrated that all women of distinction were called by her name, whence they have the title Frue.

claims.quote: Her husband was called Oder, and her daughters Hnos and Gersame.

statement.id: Suami Freyja bernama Oder, dan putri-putrinya Hnos dan Gersame.
statement.en: Freyja's husband was called Oder, and her daughters Hnos and Gersame.

claims.quote: The story tells of Thor's hammer being stolen by the giant Thrym, who will not return the hammer unless he gets his hands on Freyja. Freyja refuses to tag along, however, giving up the Brísingamen to help Thor disguise himself as her.

statement.id: Dalam Þrymskviða, raksasa Thrym mencuri palu Thor dan menuntut Freyja; Freyja menolak ikut dan menyerahkan Brísingamen untuk membantu Thor menyamar sebagai dirinya.
statement.en: In the Þrymskviða the giant Thrym steals Thor's hammer and demands Freyja; Freyja refuses to go and gives up the Brísingamen to help Thor disguise himself as her.

claims.quote: The Hyndluljóð poem emphasises she was more than just a pretty face; in it, Freyja visits wise-woman Hyndla asking her to unravel the hero Óttar's ancestry, soaking up this knowledge.

statement.id: Dalam Hyndluljóð, Freyja mengunjungi perempuan bijak Hyndla dan memintanya mengurai silsilah pahlawan Óttar.
statement.en: In the Hyndluljóð, Freyja visits the wise-woman Hyndla and asks her to unravel the hero Óttar's ancestry.

claims.quote: Possibly, the boar Hildisvíni should also be counted among Freyja's attributes; the Hyndluljóð poem has her riding said boar

statement.id: Babi hutan Hildisvíni mungkin termasuk atribut Freyja; dalam Hyndluljóð ia menungganginya.
statement.en: The boar Hildisvíni may be counted among Freyja's attributes; in the Hyndluljóð she rides it.

claims.quote: Freyja is also a goddess of wealth, as attested to by the many poetic references that link her to treasure.

statement.id: Freyja juga dewi kekayaan, sebagaimana dibuktikan banyak rujukan puitis yang mengaitkannya dengan harta.
statement.en: Freyja is also a goddess of wealth, as attested by the many poetic references linking her to treasure.

claims.quote: Ódr is said to have gone traipsing around on long journeys, inexplicably leaving Freyja behind, who would then search for him while weeping golden tears; this tale dates back to at least as early as the 10th century CE.

statement.id: Ódr konon pergi mengembara dan meninggalkan Freyja, yang lalu mencarinya sambil menangis air mata emas; kisah ini berasal sekurangnya dari abad ke-10 M.
statement.en: Ódr is said to have gone on long journeys, leaving Freyja behind, who searched for him weeping golden tears; this tale dates back to at least the 10th century CE.

claims.quote: the Sǫrla Þáttr, which survives in the 14th century CE Flateyjarbók, describes how Freyja sleeps with four dwarves to get the Brísingamen, and how Odin then forces Loki to steal the necklace from her.

statement.id: Sǫrla Þáttr dalam Flateyjarbók abad ke-14 M menceritakan Freyja tidur dengan empat kurcaci demi Brísingamen, dan Odin lalu memaksa Loki mencurinya.
statement.en: The Sǫrla Þáttr, preserved in the 14th-century Flateyjarbók, describes Freyja sleeping with four dwarves to get the Brísingamen and Odin forcing Loki to steal it.

claims.quote: By contrast, Snorri Sturluson has Loki and Heimdall fighting each other over the necklace (Skáldskaparmál, 8).

statement.id: Sebaliknya, Snorri Sturluson menggambarkan Loki dan Heimdall berkelahi memperebutkan kalung itu.
statement.en: By contrast, Snorri Sturluson has Loki and Heimdall fighting each other over the necklace.

claims.quote: Regarding her necklace Brísingamen, which is assigned to Freyja by Late Old Norse sources (13th and 14th centuries CE)

statement.id: Brísingamen dikaitkan dengan Freyja oleh sumber-sumber Nordik Kuno akhir (abad ke-13 dan ke-14 M).
statement.en: The Brísingamen is assigned to Freyja by Late Old Norse sources (13th and 14th centuries CE).

claims.quote: Freyja is one of the few individual goddesses who has had a major role in the more official religious cult

statement.id: Menurut sarjana yang dikutip World History Encyclopedia, Freyja adalah salah satu dari sedikit dewi perorangan yang berperan besar dalam kultus keagamaan yang lebih resmi.
statement.en: According to a scholar quoted by World History Encyclopedia, Freyja is one of the few individual goddesses who had a major role in the more official religious cult.

claims.quote: such as Frøihov (from Freyjuhof, 'Freyja's temple') and Frǫvi (from Freyjuvé, 'Freyja's shrine'), show clear worship, perhaps even pointing to a public cult

statement.id: Nama tempat seperti Frøihov ("kuil Freyja") dan Frǫvi ("tempat suci Freyja") menunjukkan pemujaan yang jelas, mungkin bahkan kultus publik.
statement.en: Place-names such as Frøihov ("Freyja's temple") and Frǫvi ("Freyja's shrine") show clear worship, perhaps even a public cult.

claims.quote: It is clear that the people of Iceland on the cusp of conversion to Christianity around the year 1000 CE still had Freyja clearly on their mind.

statement.id: Orang Islandia menjelang peralihan ke agama Kristen sekitar tahun 1000 M masih jelas mengingat Freyja.
statement.en: The people of Iceland on the cusp of conversion to Christianity around the year 1000 CE still clearly had Freyja on their mind.

claims.quote: Specifically, her other name Horn (Hǫrn, or Härn) probably comes from Old Norse horr, which means flax or linen.

statement.id: Nama lain Freyja, Horn, mungkin berasal dari kata Nordik Kuno horr yang berarti rami atau linen.
statement.en: Freyja's other name Horn probably comes from Old Norse horr, meaning flax or linen.

claims.quote: Another one of her names, Gefn, is Old Norse for 'giver', bringing to mind a role as a goddess of plenty.

statement.id: Nama lain Freyja, Gefn, berarti "pemberi" dalam bahasa Nordik Kuno, yang mengingatkan pada peran dewi kelimpahan.
statement.en: Another of Freyja's names, Gefn, is Old Norse for "giver", bringing to mind a role as a goddess of plenty.

claims.quote: Sýr, another name of Freyja's, is sometimes translated as 'sow', too, but it also might mean 'to protect', 'to shield,'

statement.id: Sýr, nama lain Freyja, kadang diterjemahkan "babi betina", tetapi mungkin juga berarti "melindungi" atau "menaungi".
statement.en: Sýr, another name of Freyja, is sometimes translated "sow" but might also mean "to protect" or "to shield".

claims.quote: the giant Hrungnir boasts he would bodily move Valhalla into Jotunheimen (the realm of the giants), sink Asgard (the realm of the gods), and kill all the gods except for Freyja and Sif, who he will take home with him

statement.id: Raksasa Hrungnir membual akan memindahkan Valhalla ke Jotunheimen, menenggelamkan Asgard, dan membunuh semua dewa kecuali Freyja dan Sif, yang akan dibawanya pulang.
statement.en: The giant Hrungnir boasts he would move Valhalla into Jotunheimen, sink Asgard, and kill all the gods except Freyja and Sif, whom he will take home.

claims.quote: He and Odin are commonly thought to have originally been one and the same person, with Ódr functioning as a shortened form of Odin.

statement.id: Ódr dan Odin umumnya dianggap semula satu pribadi, dengan Ódr sebagai bentuk singkat dari Odin.
statement.en: Ódr and Odin are commonly thought to have originally been one and the same, with Ódr a shortened form of Odin.

short_description.id: Viracocha adalah dewa pencipta dan dewa tertinggi dalam mitologi pra-Inca dan Inca di wilayah Andes. Menurut mitos ia berwujud manusia berjanggut dan memerintahkan pembangunan Tiwanaku.
short_description.en: Viracocha is the creator and supreme deity in pre-Inca and Inca mythology in the Andes region. According to myth he had human appearance, was bearded, and ordered the construction of Tiwanaku.

long_description.id: Viracocha adalah dewa pencipta dan dewa tertinggi dalam mitologi pra-Inca dan Inca di wilayah Andes. Ia dianggap membentuk bumi, langit, matahari, bulan, dan semua makhluk hidup, dan ia dipuja sebagai dewa matahari dan badai. Menurut sumber lain, ia adalah dewa terpenting dalam jajaran dewa Inca dan sangat lekat dengan laut.
long_description.en: Viracocha is the creator and supreme deity in pre-Inca and Inca mythology in the Andes region. He is said to have formed the earth, heavens, sun, moon and all living beings, and he was worshipped as god of the sun and of storms. According to another source, he was the most important deity in the Inca pantheon and intimately associated with the sea.

long_description.id: Menurut mitos, Viracocha berwujud manusia dan umumnya dianggap berjanggut. Dalam versi yang dicatat dari sumber Spanyol, ia bangkit dari Danau Titicaca pada masa kegelapan, membuat matahari, bulan, dan bintang, lalu menciptakan raksasa yang kemudian dimusnahkan dengan banjir sebelum membuat manusia yang lebih baik. Dalam penuturan lain, manusia dibuat dari tanah liat setelah raksasa batu dihukum dengan banjir. Kisah "dewa putih" dianggap sebagian besar sarjana modern sebagai rekaan Spanyol pascapenaklukan, karena kulit putihnya tidak disebut dalam legenda asli bangsa Inca.
long_description.en: According to myth, Viracocha had human appearance and was generally considered bearded. In a version recorded from Spanish sources, he rose from Lake Titicaca in the time of darkness, made the sun, moon and stars, and created giants who were destroyed by a flood before he made better humans. In another telling, humans were made of clay after the stone giants were punished with a flood. Most modern scholars regard the "white god" story as a Spanish invention made after the conquest, since his whiteness is absent from the original Inca legends.

long_description.id: Setelah selesai berkarya, ia dipercaya berkelana, mengajar manusia, dan membawa seni peradaban, lalu menuju barat melintasi Pasifik dan berjanji suatu hari kembali. Dalam perjalanannya ia berpakaian pengemis dan dibantu dua putra atau saudara, Imaymana Viracocha dan Tocapo Viracocha.
long_description.en: When his work was finished he was believed to have travelled, teaching humanity and bringing the civilised arts, before heading west across the Pacific and promising one day to return. On his travels he dressed as a beggar and was assisted by two sons or brothers, Imaymana Viracocha and Tocapo Viracocha.

long_description.id: Viracocha sudah dipuja bangsa pra-Inca di Peru sebelum dimasukkan ke dalam jajaran dewa Inca. Di Cuzco ia dipuja dan memiliki kuil serta patung, tetapi ia terutama dipuja kaum bangsawan pada masa krisis politik. Dalam seni, ia sering digambarkan sebagai lelaki tua berjanggut berjubah panjang yang ditopang tongkat.
long_description.en: Peruvian peoples before the Inca already worshipped Viracocha, and he was later taken into the Inca pantheon. At Cuzco he had worship, temples and statues, yet his devotees were chiefly nobles at times of political crisis. In art he is often shown as an elderly bearded man in a long robe leaning on a staff.

cultural_context.id: Menurut salah satu sumber, karena dewa Inca lain lebih berperan dalam kehidupan sehari-hari rakyat biasa, Viracocha terutama dipuja kaum bangsawan, biasanya pada masa krisis politik.
cultural_context.en: One source says that, since other Inca gods mattered more to ordinary people in everyday life, Viracocha was mainly honoured by the nobility, typically during political crises.

literal_meaning.id: Maknanya diperdebatkan: unsur wira (lemak) dan qucha (danau, laut, waduk); ada pula tafsir "busa laut" yang ditinggalkan karena tata bahasa
literal_meaning.en: Disputed: the elements wira (fat) and qucha (lake, sea, reservoir); a "sea foam" reading has been discarded on grammatical grounds

who.id: Dewa pencipta dan dewa tertinggi dalam mitologi pra-Inca dan Inca.
who.en: The creator and supreme deity of pre-Inca and Inca mythology.

origin.id: Mitologi pra-Inca dan Inca di wilayah Andes.
origin.en: Pre-Inca and Inca mythology in the Andes region.

role.id: Pencipta alam semesta dan manusia, serta pembawa peradaban bagi mereka.
role.en: Creator of the universe and of humans, and bringer of civilization to them.

famous_for.id: Menciptakan dunia, mengajar manusia, lalu menghilang ke barat melintasi Pasifik dengan janji kembali.
famous_for.en: Creating the world, teaching humanity and then vanishing west across the Pacific with a promise to return.

did_you_know.id: Salah satu sebutan sang dewa, Kon-Tiki Viracocha, menjadi sumber nama rakit milik Thor Heyerdahl.
did_you_know.en: One epithet of the god, Kon-Tiki Viracocha, was the source of the name of Thor Heyerdahl's raft.

description.id: Ia menciptakan alam semesta, matahari, bulan, bintang, waktu, dan peradaban.
description.en: He created the universe, sun, moon and stars, time and civilization.

description.id: Ia berjalan di atas perairan Pasifik menuju barat.
description.en: He walked across the waters of the Pacific heading west.

title.en: Creation of the giants and humankind

role.en: Creator

summary.id: Viracocha menciptakan raksasa dari batu pada zaman kegelapan, menghukum mereka yang membangkang dengan banjir besar, lalu menciptakan manusia dari tanah liat dan menciptakan matahari, bulan, dan bintang dari pulau-pulau di Danau Titicaca.
summary.en: Viracocha created giants from stone in the age of darkness, punished the unruly ones with a great flood, then created humans from clay and the sun, moon and stars from islands in Lake Titicaca.

role.en: Teacher of civilization

summary.id: Dengan berpakaian pengemis dan dibantu dua putra atau saudara, Viracocha berkelana menyebarkan pengetahuan, kadang dilempari batu, lalu berjalan di atas Pasifik menuju barat dengan janji kembali.
summary.en: Dressed as a beggar and assisted by two sons or brothers, Viracocha travelled spreading knowledge, sometimes suffering stones thrown at him, then walked across the Pacific heading west with a promise to return.

role.en: Punisher and saviour

summary.id: Dalam satu legenda, Viracocha memusnahkan orang-orang di sekitar Danau Titicaca dengan Banjir Besar selama 60 hari 60 malam dan menyelamatkan dua orang untuk membawa peradaban.
summary.en: In one legend Viracocha destroyed the people around Lake Titicaca with a Great Flood lasting 60 days and 60 nights, saving two to bring civilization.

description.id: Menurut mitos, Viracocha memerintahkan pembangunannya; di sana terdapat gerbang dengan pahatan sang dewa yang memegang petir.
description.en: According to myth he ordered its construction; a gateway there carries a sculpture of the god holding thunderbolts.

description.id: Tempat Viracocha dikatakan bangkit pada masa kegelapan, dan pulau-pulaunya menjadi asal benda langit.
description.en: Where Viracocha is said to have risen in the time of darkness, and whose islands were the source of the heavenly bodies.

description.id: Ibu kota Inca tempat Viracocha dipuja dan memiliki kuil serta patung.
description.en: The Inca capital where Viracocha was worshipped and had temples and statues.

title.id: Nama sang dewa dipakai raja Viracocha Inca
title.en: The god's name assumed by king Viracocha Inca

description.id: Raja yang dikenal sebagai Viracocha Inca wafat pada 1438 M dan memakai nama sang dewa; saat itu mungkin dewa ini secara resmi ditambahkan ke keluarga dewa Inca.
description.en: The king known as Viracocha Inca died in 1438 CE and had assumed the god's name; this may also be the time the god was formally added to the family of Inca gods.

description.id: Viracocha dipuja bangsa pra-Inca di Peru sebelum dimasukkan ke dalam jajaran dewa Inca.
description.en: Viracocha was worshipped by the pre-Inca of Peru before being incorporated into the Inca pantheon.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa kisah "dewa putih" dipandang sebagian sarjana sebagai rekaan pascapenaklukan?
learning_questions.en: Why do some scholars see the "white god" story as a post-conquest invention?

learning_questions.id: Apa arti penting kisah penciptaan yang berulang dari batu dan tanah liat bagi pandangan Andes tentang manusia?
learning_questions.en: What might the repeated creation stories with stone and clay tell us about Andean views of humankind?

claims.quote: Viracocha (also Wiraqocha, Huiracocha; Quechua Wiraqucha) is the creator and supreme deity in the pre-Inca and Inca mythology in the Andes region of South America.

statement.id: Viracocha adalah dewa pencipta tertinggi dalam mitologi Inca di Andes.
statement.en: Viracocha is the creator and supreme deity in pre-Inca and Inca mythology in the Andes.

claims.quote: According to the myth Viracocha had human appearance and was generally considered as bearded.

statement.id: Menurut mitos, Viracocha berwujud manusia dan umumnya digambarkan berjanggut.
statement.en: According to myth, Viracocha had human appearance and was generally considered bearded.

claims.quote: According to the myth he ordered the construction of Tiwanaku.

statement.id: Menurut mitos, ia memerintahkan pembangunan Tiwanaku.
statement.en: According to the myth he ordered the construction of Tiwanaku.

claims.quote: Such compound names include Ticsi Viracocha (T'iqsi Wiraqocha), Contiti Viracocha, and, occasionally, Kon-Tiki Viracocha (the source of the name of Thor Heyerdahl's raft).

statement.id: Nama majemuk Viracocha antara lain Ticsi Viracocha dan Contiti Viracocha, serta kadang Kon-Tiki Viracocha, yang menjadi sumber nama rakit Thor Heyerdahl.
statement.en: Compound names of Viracocha include Ticsi Viracocha and Contiti Viracocha and, occasionally, Kon-Tiki Viracocha, the source of the name of Thor Heyerdahl's raft.

claims.quote: Considered the creator god he was the father of all other Inca gods and it was he who formed the earth, heavens, sun, moon and all living beings.

statement.id: Sebagai dewa pencipta, ia dianggap ayah semua dewa Inca lainnya dan dialah yang membentuk bumi, langit, matahari, bulan, dan semua makhluk hidup.
statement.en: Considered the creator god, he was the father of all other Inca gods and formed the earth, heavens, sun, moon and all living beings.

claims.quote: When he finished his work he was believed to have travelled far and wide teaching humanity and bringing the civilised arts before he headed west across the Pacific, never to be seen again but promising one day to return.

statement.id: Setelah menyelesaikan karyanya, ia dipercaya berkelana jauh mengajar manusia dan membawa seni peradaban, lalu menuju barat melintasi Pasifik dan tak terlihat lagi, tetapi berjanji suatu hari kembali.
statement.en: When he finished his work he was believed to have travelled far and wide teaching humanity and bringing the civilised arts, before heading west across the Pacific, never to be seen again but promising one day to return.

claims.quote: These other names, perhaps used because the god's real name was too sacred to be spoken, included Ilya (light), Ticci (beginning), and Wiraqoca Pacayacaciq (instructor).

statement.id: Nama-nama lain, yang mungkin dipakai karena nama aslinya terlalu sakral untuk diucapkan, mencakup Ilya (cahaya), Ticci (permulaan), dan Wiraqoca Pacayacaciq (pengajar).
statement.en: Other names, perhaps used because the god's real name was too sacred to be spoken, included Ilya (light), Ticci (beginning) and Wiraqoca Pacayacaciq (instructor).

claims.quote: It was believed that human beings were actually Viracocha's second attempt at living creatures as he first created a race of giants from stone in the age of darkness.

statement.id: Manusia dipercaya merupakan percobaan kedua Viracocha menciptakan makhluk hidup, karena ia lebih dulu menciptakan ras raksasa dari batu pada zaman kegelapan.
statement.en: Human beings were believed to be Viracocha's second attempt at living creatures, as he first created a race of giants from stone in the age of darkness.

claims.quote: However, these giants proved unruly and it became necessary for Viracocha to punish them by sending a great flood. In the legend all these giants except two then returned to their original stone form and several could still be seen in much later times standing imposingly at sites such as Tiahuanaco

statement.id: Para raksasa itu ternyata membangkang sehingga Viracocha menghukum mereka dengan banjir besar; semuanya kecuali dua kembali menjadi batu, dan beberapa masih terlihat di tempat seperti Tiahuanaco.
statement.en: The giants proved unruly, so Viracocha punished them with a great flood; all but two returned to stone form, and several could still be seen at sites such as Tiahuanaco.

claims.quote: Then Viracocha created men and women but this time he used clay. He also gave them such gifts as clothes, language, agriculture and the arts and then created all animals.

statement.id: Kemudian Viracocha menciptakan laki-laki dan perempuan, kali ini dari tanah liat, memberi mereka pakaian, bahasa, pertanian, dan seni, lalu menciptakan semua hewan.
statement.en: Viracocha then created men and women, this time from clay, gave them gifts such as clothes, language, agriculture and the arts, and then created all animals.

claims.quote: Viracocha's decision to create the sun, moon and stars and so bring light to the world. These heavenly bodies were created from islands in Lake Titicaca.

statement.id: Viracocha menciptakan matahari, bulan, dan bintang sehingga membawa cahaya ke dunia; benda-benda langit itu dibuat dari pulau-pulau di Danau Titicaca.
statement.en: Viracocha created the sun, moon and stars and so brought light to the world; these heavenly bodies were created from islands in Lake Titicaca.

claims.quote: Viracocha then set off to spread his civilizing knowledge around the world and for this he dressed as a beggar and assumed such names as Con Ticci Viracocha (also spelt Kon-Tiki), Atun-Viracocha and Contiti Viracocha Pachayachachic.

statement.id: Viracocha lalu berkelana menyebarkan pengetahuan beradab ke seluruh dunia dengan berpakaian pengemis dan memakai nama seperti Con Ticci Viracocha (juga Kon-Tiki), Atun-Viracocha, dan Contiti Viracocha Pachayachachic.
statement.en: Viracocha then set off to spread his civilizing knowledge around the world, dressed as a beggar and assuming names such as Con Ticci Viracocha (also spelt Kon-Tiki), Atun-Viracocha and Contiti Viracocha Pachayachachic.

claims.quote: He was assissted on his travels by two sons or brothers called Imaymana Viracocha and Tocapo Viracocha.

statement.id: Dalam perjalanannya ia dibantu dua putra atau saudara bernama Imaymana Viracocha dan Tocapo Viracocha.
statement.en: On his travels he was assisted by two sons or brothers called Imaymana Viracocha and Tocapo Viracocha.

claims.quote: Ending up at Manta (in Ecuador), Viracocha then walked across the waters of the Pacific (in some versions he sails a raft) heading into the west but promising to return one day

statement.id: Setibanya di Manta (di Ekuador), Viracocha berjalan di atas perairan Pasifik (dalam beberapa versi ia berlayar dengan rakit) menuju barat sambil berjanji akan kembali suatu hari.
statement.en: Ending up at Manta (in Ecuador), Viracocha walked across the waters of the Pacific (in some versions he sails a raft) heading west, promising to return one day.

claims.quote: Viracocha was actually worshipped by the pre-Inca of Peru before being incorporated into the Inca pantheon.

statement.id: Viracocha sudah dipuja oleh bangsa pra-Inca di Peru sebelum dimasukkan ke dalam jajaran dewa Inca.
statement.en: Viracocha was worshipped by the pre-Inca of Peru before being incorporated into the Inca pantheon.

claims.quote: As other Inca gods were more important for the daily life of common people, Viracocha was principally worshipped by the nobility, and then usually in times of political crisis.

statement.id: Karena dewa Inca lain lebih penting bagi kehidupan sehari-hari rakyat biasa, Viracocha terutama dipuja oleh kaum bangsawan, biasanya pada masa krisis politik.
statement.en: As other Inca gods were more important for the daily life of common people, Viracocha was principally worshipped by the nobility, and then usually in times of political crisis.

claims.quote: Worshipped at the Inca capital of Cuzco, Viracocha also had temples and statues dedicated to him at Caha and Urcos and sacrifices of humans (including children) and, quite often, llamas, were made to the god on important ceremonial occasions.

statement.id: Di ibu kota Inca, Cuzco, Viracocha dipuja, dan juga memiliki kuil serta patung di Caha dan Urcos; korban manusia (termasuk anak-anak) dan cukup sering llama dipersembahkan pada upacara penting.
statement.en: Worshipped at the Inca capital of Cuzco, Viracocha also had temples and statues at Caha and Urcos, and sacrifices of humans (including children) and, quite often, llamas were made to the god on important ceremonial occasions.

claims.quote: In art Viracocha is often depicted as an old bearded man wearing a long robe and supported by a staff.

statement.id: Dalam seni, Viracocha sering digambarkan sebagai lelaki tua berjanggut berjubah panjang yang ditopang tongkat.
statement.en: In art Viracocha is often depicted as an old bearded man wearing a long robe and supported by a staff.

claims.quote: One of his earliest representations may be the weeping statue at the ruins of Tiwanaku, close to Lake Titicaca, the traditional Inca site where all things were first created. Here, sculpted on the lintel of a massive gateway, the god holds thunderbolts in each hand and wears a crown with rays of the sun whilst his tears represent the rain.

statement.id: Pada ambang gerbang besar di Tiwanaku, sang dewa dipahat memegang petir di kedua tangan dan bermahkota sinar matahari, sementara air matanya melambangkan hujan.
statement.en: Sculpted on the lintel of a massive gateway at Tiwanaku, the god holds thunderbolts in each hand and wears a crown with rays of the sun, while his tears represent the rain.

claims.quote: In the Quechuan languages, tiqsi means "origin" or "beginning", wira means fat, and qucha means lake, sea, or reservoir.

statement.id: Dalam rumpun bahasa Quechua, tiqsi berarti "asal" atau "permulaan", wira berarti lemak, dan qucha berarti danau, laut, atau waduk.
statement.en: In the Quechuan languages, tiqsi means "origin" or "beginning", wira means fat, and qucha means lake, sea or reservoir.

claims.quote: Some people state that Wiraqucha could mean "Fat (or foam) of the sea", etymology that has been discarded for grammatical considerations (constituent order in Quechua) at least since Inca Garcilaso.

statement.id: Sebagian orang menyatakan Wiraqucha dapat berarti "lemak (atau busa) laut", tetapi etimologi ini ditinggalkan karena pertimbangan tata bahasa (urutan unsur dalam bahasa Quechua) setidaknya sejak Inca Garcilaso.
statement.en: Some people state that Wiraqucha could mean "Fat (or foam) of the sea", an etymology discarded for grammatical considerations (constituent order in Quechua) at least since Inca Garcilaso.

claims.quote: Viracocha created the universe, sun, moon, and stars, time (by commanding the sun to move over the sky) and civilization itself. Viracocha was worshipped as god of the sun and of storms.

statement.id: Viracocha menciptakan alam semesta, matahari, bulan, bintang, waktu (dengan memerintahkan matahari bergerak di langit), dan peradaban itu sendiri, serta dipuja sebagai dewa matahari dan badai.
statement.en: Viracocha created the universe, sun, moon and stars, time (by commanding the sun to move over the sky) and civilization itself, and was worshipped as god of the sun and of storms.

claims.quote: Viracocha was the most important deity in the Inca pantheon and seen as the creator of all things, or the substance from which all things are created, and intimately associated with the sea.

statement.id: Viracocha adalah dewa terpenting dalam jajaran dewa Inca, dipandang sebagai pencipta segala sesuatu atau bahan dari mana segala sesuatu diciptakan, dan sangat lekat dengan laut.
statement.en: Viracocha was the most important deity in the Inca pantheon, seen as the creator of all things or the substance from which all things are created, and intimately associated with the sea.

claims.quote: According to a myth recorded by Juan de Betanzos, Viracocha rose from Lake Titicaca (or sometimes the cave of Paqariq Tampu) during the time of darkness to bring forth light.

statement.id: Menurut mitos yang dicatat Juan de Betanzos, Viracocha bangkit dari Danau Titicaca (atau kadang gua Paqariq Tampu) pada masa kegelapan untuk memunculkan cahaya.
statement.en: According to a myth recorded by Juan de Betanzos, Viracocha rose from Lake Titicaca (or sometimes the cave of Paqariq Tampu) during the time of darkness to bring forth light.

claims.quote: He made mankind by breathing into stones, but his first creation were brainless giants that displeased him. So, he destroyed them with a flood and made humans, beings who were better than the giants, from smaller stones.

statement.id: Dalam catatan itu, ia membuat manusia dengan menghembuskan napas ke batu; ciptaan pertamanya adalah raksasa tak berotak yang tidak menyenangkannya, sehingga ia memusnahkan mereka dengan banjir dan membuat manusia yang lebih baik dari batu yang lebih kecil.
statement.en: In that account he made mankind by breathing into stones; his first creation was brainless giants that displeased him, so he destroyed them with a flood and made better humans from smaller stones.

claims.quote: In one legend he had one son, Inti, and two daughters, Mama Killa and Pachamama.

statement.id: Dalam satu legenda, ia memiliki satu putra, Inti, dan dua putri, Mama Killa dan Pachamama.
statement.en: In one legend he had one son, Inti, and two daughters, Mama Killa and Pachamama.

claims.quote: In this legend, he destroyed the people around Lake Titicaca with a Great Flood called Unu Pachakuti, lasting 60 days and 60 nights, saving two to bring civilization to the rest of the world.

statement.id: Dalam legenda itu, ia memusnahkan orang-orang di sekitar Danau Titicaca dengan Banjir Besar bernama Unu Pachakuti selama 60 hari 60 malam, dan menyelamatkan dua orang untuk membawa peradaban ke seluruh dunia.
statement.en: In that legend he destroyed the people around Lake Titicaca with a Great Flood called Unu Pachakuti, lasting 60 days and 60 nights, saving two to bring civilization to the rest of the world.

claims.quote: The whiteness of Viracocha is however not mentioned in the native authentic legends of the Incas and most modern scholars therefore had considered the "white god" story to be a post-conquest Spanish invention.

statement.id: Warna kulit putih Viracocha tidak disebut dalam legenda asli bangsa Inca, sehingga sebagian besar sarjana modern menganggap kisah "dewa putih" sebagai rekaan Spanyol pascapenaklukan.
statement.en: The whiteness of Viracocha is not mentioned in the native authentic legends of the Incas, and most modern scholars therefore considered the "white god" story a post-conquest Spanish invention.

claims.quote: The Colombian myth of Bochica who has a similar role as creator and civilizer as Viracocha

statement.id: Mitos Kolombia tentang Bochica memiliki peran serupa sebagai pencipta dan pembawa peradaban seperti Viracocha.
statement.en: The Colombian myth of Bochica has a similar role as creator and civilizer as Viracocha.

claims.quote: The god's name was also assumed by the king known as Viracocha Inca (died 1438 CE) and this may also be the time when the god was formally added to the family of Inca gods.

statement.id: Nama sang dewa juga dipakai oleh raja yang dikenal sebagai Viracocha Inca (wafat 1438 M), dan mungkin saat itulah sang dewa secara resmi ditambahkan ke keluarga dewa Inca.
statement.en: The god's name was also assumed by the king known as Viracocha Inca (died 1438 CE), and this may also be the time when the god was formally added to the family of Inca gods.

claims.quote: The god was not always well received despite the knowledge he imparted, sometimes even suffering stones thrown at him.

statement.id: Sang dewa tidak selalu disambut baik meskipun pengetahuan yang diberikannya, bahkan kadang dilempari batu.
statement.en: The god was not always well received despite the knowledge he imparted, sometimes even suffering stones thrown at him.

summary.id: Menurut satu sumber, manusia dibuat dari tanah liat setelah raksasa batu dihukum.
summary.en: According to one source, humans were made of clay after the stone giants were punished.

summary.id: Menurut sumber lain yang merujuk mitos catatan Juan de Betanzos, manusia dibuat dari batu yang lebih kecil dengan menghembuskan napas ke batu.
summary.en: According to another source citing the myth recorded by Juan de Betanzos, humans were made from smaller stones by breathing into stones.

summary.id: Menurut satu sumber, dewa terpenting dalam jajaran dewa Inca.
summary.en: According to one source, the most important deity in the Inca pantheon.

summary.id: Menurut sumber lain, terutama dipuja kaum bangsawan karena dewa lain lebih penting bagi kehidupan sehari-hari rakyat.
summary.en: According to another source, principally worshipped by the nobility, as other gods mattered more in daily life.

summary.id: "Lemak (atau busa) laut" — tafsir yang ditinggalkan karena pertimbangan tata bahasa.
summary.en: "Fat (or foam) of the sea" — a reading discarded on grammatical grounds.

summary.id: Unsur tiqsi (asal), wira (lemak), qucha (danau, laut, waduk).
summary.en: Elements tiqsi (origin), wira (fat), qucha (lake, sea, reservoir).

short_description.id: Bull Demon King (Niu Mowang) adalah tokoh iblis dalam novel Journey to the West (Perjalanan ke Barat). Ia suami Princess Iron Fan dan ayah Red Boy, dan menampakkan wujud aslinya sebagai banteng putih raksasa.
short_description.en: Bull Demon King (Niu Mowang) is a demon character in the novel Journey to the West. He is the husband of Princess Iron Fan and the father of Red Boy, and reveals his true form as a giant white bull.

long_description.id: Bull Demon King adalah tokoh sastra, bukan tokoh dari cerita rakyat atau ritual: ia berasal dari novel abad ke-16 Journey to the West (Perjalanan ke Barat) karya Wu Cheng'en. Wikipedia menyebutnya antagonis utama dalam novel itu dan banyak adaptasinya. Selain Bull Demon King, namanya juga diterjemahkan sebagai Ox King, dan ia menyebut dirinya Great Sage Who Pacifies Heaven.
long_description.en: Bull Demon King is a literary character rather than a figure of folk tradition or ritual: he comes from the 16th-century novel Journey to the West by Wu Cheng'en. Wikipedia describes him as a major antagonist in the novel and its many adaptations. His name is also translated as the Ox King, and he styles himself the Great Sage Who Pacifies Heaven.

long_description.id: Dalam novel, Sun Wukong menyebut Bull Demon King sebagai salah satu dari tujuh saudara angkatnya. Istrinya adalah Princess Iron Fan dan putranya adalah Red Boy, yang menurut dewa setempat ia utus menjaga Gunung Hao. Belakangan ia meninggalkan Princess Iron Fan dan tinggal di Gua Moyun di Gunung Jilei bersama Yumian Gongzhu, putri seorang raja rubah yang menawarkan hartanya kepadanya.
long_description.en: In the novel, Sun Wukong names Bull Demon King as one of his seven sworn brothers. His wife is Princess Iron Fan and his son is Red Boy, whom, according to the local deities, he sent to guard Mount Hao. Later he left Princess Iron Fan and lived at Moyun Cave on Jilei Mountain with Yumian Gongzhu, the daughter of a fox king, who had offered him her fortune.

long_description.id: Peran terbesarnya muncul saat Sun Wukong mencari kipas daun pisang (Banana Leaf Fan). Sun Wukong menyamar sebagai dirinya untuk menipu Princess Iron Fan, lalu Bull Demon King menyamar sebagai Zhu Bajie untuk merebut kipas itu kembali. Dalam pertarungan ia menampakkan wujud banteng putih raksasa; kepalanya yang dipenggal Nezha tumbuh lagi, tetapi tanduknya dibakar roda api dan cermin Heavenly King Li menahan wujudnya, sehingga ia menyerah dan istrinya menyerahkan kipas itu.
long_description.en: His largest role comes when Sun Wukong seeks the Banana Leaf Fan. Sun Wukong disguises himself as him to deceive Princess Iron Fan, and Bull Demon King then disguises himself as Zhu Bajie to retrieve the fan. In the fight he reveals the form of a giant white bull; the heads Nezha cuts off grow back, but a fire wheel burns his horns and the mirror of Heavenly King Li fixes his form, so he yields and his wife hands over the fan.

cultural_context.id: Nama Bull Demon King mudah tertukar dengan kuil "Ox King Temples" (牛王庙) di Tiongkok. Menurut Wikipedia, kuil itu secara tradisional dibangun untuk memuja dewa-dewa pertanian dan tidak dimaksudkan bagi tokoh dalam novel ini.
cultural_context.en: The name Bull Demon King is easily confused with the "Ox King Temples" (牛王庙) in China. According to Wikipedia, those temples were traditionally built to worship agricultural deities rather than the character of this novel.

who.id: Tokoh iblis dalam novel Journey to the West.
who.en: A demon character in the novel Journey to the West.

origin.id: Novel abad ke-16 Journey to the West karya Wu Cheng'en.
origin.en: The 16th-century novel Journey to the West by Wu Cheng'en.

role.id: Antagonis yang menyamar sebagai Zhu Bajie untuk merebut kembali kipas dari Sun Wukong.
role.en: An antagonist who disguises himself as Zhu Bajie to take the fan back from Sun Wukong.

famous_for.id: Wujud banteng putih raksasa dan pertarungannya melawan Sun Wukong serta para dewa langit.
famous_for.en: His giant white bull form and his fight against Sun Wukong and the heavenly forces.

did_you_know.id: Wikipedia mencatat bahwa tokoh Bowser dalam seri Mario terinspirasi oleh Ox-King, dan bahwa Shigeru Miyamoto pada awalnya membayangkan Bowser berwujud banteng.
did_you_know.en: Wikipedia records that the villain Bowser of the Mario series was inspired by the Ox-King, and that Shigeru Miyamoto first pictured Bowser as an ox.

description.id: Dalam novel ia berubah menjadi angsa untuk lari, dan menyamar sebagai Zhu Bajie untuk menipu Sun Wukong.
description.en: In the novel he turns into a swan to flee and disguises himself as Zhu Bajie to trick Sun Wukong.

description.id: Saat Nezha memenggal kepalanya, kepala baru tumbuh dari lehernya.
description.en: When Nezha cuts off his head, a new head grows out of his neck.

description.id: Cermin Heavenly King Li menahan wujud aslinya sehingga ia tidak bisa bergerak atau lolos.
description.en: The mirror of Heavenly King Li fixes his true form so that he cannot move or escape.

title.en: The contest over the Banana Leaf Fan

role.id: Lawan Sun Wukong yang merebut kembali kipas dengan penyamaran, lalu dikalahkan para dewa.
role.en: The opponent who retakes the fan by disguise and is then overcome by the gods.

summary.id: Sun Wukong menyamar menjadi Bull Demon King dan membawa kipas dari Princess Iron Fan. Bull Demon King yang asli menyamar sebagai Zhu Bajie dan merebutnya kembali. Pertarungan berakhir ketika Nezha, Heavenly King Li, dan pasukan langit menaklukkannya, dan istrinya menyerahkan kipas itu.
summary.en: Sun Wukong disguises himself as Bull Demon King and takes the fan from Princess Iron Fan. The real Bull Demon King disguises himself as Zhu Bajie and takes it back. The fight ends when Nezha, Heavenly King Li, and the heavenly forces subdue him and his wife hands over the fan.

description.id: Tempat Bull Demon King tinggal setelah meninggalkan Princess Iron Fan, menurut dewa bumi dalam novel.
description.en: Where Bull Demon King lives after leaving Princess Iron Fan, according to the earth deity in the novel.

note.id: Istri pertamanya, yang kemudian ia tinggalkan.
note.en: His first wife, whom he later abandoned.

note.id: Putranya, yang menurut dewa setempat ia utus menjaga Gunung Hao.
note.en: His son, whom, according to the local deities, he sent to guard Mount Hao.

note.id: Menurut Sun Wukong, ia pernah mengikat persaudaraan dengan Bull Demon King sebagai tujuh bersaudara; Wukong kemudian bertarung dengannya dalam kisah kipas. Seorang akademisi menyebut Bull Demon King pasangan simbolis (counterpart) bagi Sun Wukong.
note.en: According to Sun Wukong, he once swore brotherhood with Bull Demon King as seven brothers; Wukong later fights him in the fan episode. One scholar calls Bull Demon King a symbolic counterpart to Sun Wukong.

note.id: Wikipedia menyebut Bull Demon King mungkin dipengaruhi oleh Ox-Head.
note.en: Wikipedia says Bull Demon King was possibly influenced by Ox-Head.

description.id: Bull Demon King, diperankan Aaron Kwok, digambarkan berperang melawan Langit.
description.en: Bull Demon King, played by Aaron Kwok, is shown waging war on Heaven.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa penting membedakan tokoh sastra seperti Bull Demon King dari kuil dan dewa pertanian yang dipuja secara nyata?
learning_questions.en: Why is it important to tell a literary character like Bull Demon King apart from temples and agricultural deities that are actually worshipped?

learning_questions.id: Bagaimana penyamaran dan perubahan wujud dipakai dalam kisah kipas daun pisang?
learning_questions.en: How are disguise and transformation used in the story of the Banana Leaf Fan?

learning_questions.id: Apa yang menunjukkan bahwa Bull Demon King dan Sun Wukong bisa dibandingkan sebagai pasangan?
learning_questions.en: What suggests that Bull Demon King and Sun Wukong can be compared as a pair?

claims.quote: also translated as the Ox King, also-known by his self-proclaimed title the Great Sage Who Pacifies Heaven (Chinese: 平天大聖; pinyin: Píngtiān Dàshèng), and as Dàliwáng (大力王;

statement.id: Bull Demon King juga diterjemahkan sebagai Ox King. Ia menyebut dirinya sendiri Great Sage Who Pacifies Heaven (平天大聖, Píngtiān Dàshèng) dan dikenal juga sebagai Dàliwáng (大力王).
statement.en: Bull Demon King is also translated as the Ox King. He styles himself the Great Sage Who Pacifies Heaven (平天大聖, Píngtiān Dàshèng) and is also known as Dàliwáng (大力王).

claims.quote: is a character and demon from the 16th century novel Journey to the West.

statement.id: Bull Demon King adalah tokoh dan iblis (demon) dari novel abad ke-16 Journey to the West (Perjalanan ke Barat).
statement.en: Bull Demon King is a character and demon from the 16th-century novel Journey to the West.

claims.quote: Bull Demon King (Chinese: 牛魔王; pinyin: Niú Mówáng)

statement.id: Nama Tionghoa tokoh ini adalah 牛魔王, dalam pinyin Niú Mówáng.
statement.en: His Chinese name is 牛魔王, in pinyin Niú Mówáng.

claims.quote: He is the estranged-husband of the Princess Iron Fan and father of Red Boy.

statement.id: Bull Demon King adalah suami yang telah berpisah dari Princess Iron Fan (Putri Kipas Besi) dan ayah Red Boy.
statement.en: Bull Demon King is the estranged husband of Princess Iron Fan and the father of Red Boy.

claims.quote: Bull King is a major antagonist in the novel Journey to the West by Wu Cheng'en and its many adaptations.

statement.id: Bull Demon King adalah antagonis utama dalam novel Journey to the West karya Wu Cheng'en dan banyak adaptasinya.
statement.en: Bull Demon King is a major antagonist in the novel Journey to the West by Wu Cheng'en and in its many adaptations.

claims.quote: 想我老孫五百年前大鬧天宮時，遍遊天下名山，尋訪大地豪傑，那牛魔王曾與老孫結七弟兄。

statement.id: Dalam novel, Sun Wukong berkata bahwa Bull Demon King (牛魔王) dahulu mengikat persaudaraan dengannya sebagai tujuh bersaudara (結七弟兄), pada masa ia mengacau Istana Langit.
statement.en: In the novel, Sun Wukong says that Bull Demon King (牛魔王) once swore brotherhood with him as one of seven brothers (結七弟兄), when Wukong made havoc in Heaven.

claims.quote: 他曾在火燄山修行了三百年，煉成三昧真火，卻也神通廣大，牛魔王使他來鎮守號山。
claims.locator: Bab 40, keterangan dewa setempat tentang Red Boy

statement.id: Dalam novel, dewa setempat menyebut bahwa Bull Demon King (牛魔王) mengutus Red Boy (紅孩兒) untuk menjaga Gunung Hao (號山).
statement.en: In the novel, the local deities report that Bull Demon King (牛魔王) sent Red Boy (紅孩兒) to guard Mount Hao (號山).

claims.quote: 這芭蕉洞雖有，卻無個鐵扇仙，只有個鐵扇公主，又名羅剎女。」行者道：「人言他有一柄芭蕉扇，能熄得火焰山，敢是他麼？」樵子道：「正是，正是。這聖賢有這件寶貝，善能熄火，保護那方人家，故此稱為鐵扇仙。我這裡人家用不著他，只知他叫做羅剎女，乃大力牛魔王妻也。

statement.id: Dalam novel, seorang penebang kayu menyebut Princess Iron Fan (鐵扇公主), yang juga bernama Luocha Nü (羅剎女), sebagai istri Bull Demon King (大力牛魔王).
statement.en: In the novel, a woodcutter says that Princess Iron Fan (鐵扇公主), also called Luocha Nü (羅剎女), is the wife of the mighty Bull Demon King (大力牛魔王).

claims.quote: 大力王乃羅剎女丈夫。他這向撇了羅剎，現在積雷山摩雲洞。有個萬年狐王，那狐王死了，遺下一個女兒，叫做玉面公主。

statement.id: Dalam novel, dewa bumi berkata bahwa Dàliwáng (大力王) adalah suami Luocha Nü (羅剎女), lalu meninggalkannya dan kini berada di Gua Moyun (摩雲洞) di Gunung Jilei (積雷山). Di sana tinggal Yumian Gongzhu (玉面公主), putri seorang raja rubah yang telah wafat.
statement.en: In the novel, the local earth deity says that Dàliwáng (大力王) is the husband of Luocha Nü (羅剎女), has abandoned her, and is now at Moyun Cave (摩雲洞) on Jilei Mountain (積雷山). There lives Yumian Gongzhu (玉面公主), the daughter of a fox king who has died.

claims.quote: 那公主有百萬家私，無人掌管。二年前，訪著牛魔王神通廣大，情願倒陪家私，招贅為夫。

statement.id: Dalam novel, Yumian Gongzhu (玉面公主) memiliki harta keluarga besar tanpa pengelola; dua tahun sebelumnya ia mendengar tentang kesaktian Bull Demon King (牛魔王) dan bersedia menyertakan hartanya untuk mengambilnya sebagai suami.
statement.en: In the novel, Yumian Gongzhu (玉面公主) had a vast family fortune with no one to manage it; two years earlier she learned of the great powers of Bull Demon King (牛魔王) and offered her fortune to take him in as her husband.

claims.quote: 土地說：「大力王即牛魔王也。」行者道：「這山本是牛魔王放的火，假名火焰山？」

statement.id: Dalam novel, dewa bumi menyatakan bahwa Dàliwáng (大力王) adalah Bull Demon King (牛魔王).
statement.en: In the novel, the local earth deity states that Dàliwáng (大力王) is Bull Demon King (牛魔王).

claims.quote: Sun Wukong disguises himself as Bull Demon King to deceive Princess Iron Fan and takes away her Banana Leaf Fan. The real Bull Demon King visits Princess Iron Fan, who then realises she has been tricked. Bull Demon King disguises himself as Zhu Bajie to trick Sun Wukong and retrieve the fan.

statement.id: Menurut ringkasan Wikipedia atas novel, Sun Wukong menyamar menjadi Bull Demon King untuk menipu Princess Iron Fan dan membawa Banana Leaf Fan (kipas daun pisang) miliknya. Bull Demon King yang asli kemudian mendatangi Princess Iron Fan, lalu menyamar sebagai Zhu Bajie untuk menipu Sun Wukong dan merebut kembali kipas itu.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia's summary of the novel, Sun Wukong disguises himself as Bull Demon King to deceive Princess Iron Fan and takes away her Banana Leaf Fan. The real Bull Demon King then visits Princess Iron Fan and disguises himself as Zhu Bajie to trick Sun Wukong and retrieve the fan.

claims.quote: 牛王嘻嘻的笑了一笑，現出原身：一隻大白牛，頭如峻嶺，眼若閃光，兩隻角似兩座鐵塔，牙排利刃，連頭至尾有千餘丈長短，自蹄至背有八百丈高下。

statement.id: Dalam novel, Bull Demon King (牛王) menampakkan wujud aslinya (原身): seekor banteng putih besar (大白牛) dengan kepala bagai gunung terjal, dua tanduk bagai dua menara besi, panjang lebih dari seribu zhang dan tinggi delapan ratus zhang.
statement.en: In the novel, Bull Demon King (牛王) reveals his original form (原身): a great white bull (大白牛) with a head like a steep mountain and two horns like iron towers, more than a thousand zhang long and eight hundred zhang high.

claims.quote: 那牛王腔子裡又鑽出一個頭來，口吐黑氣，眼放金光。被哪吒又砍一劍，頭落處，又鑽出一個頭來。一連砍了十數劍，隨即長出十數個頭。

statement.id: Dalam novel, ketika Nezha (哪吒) memenggal kepala Bull Demon King (牛王), kepala baru tumbuh lagi; setelah belasan tebasan, belasan kepala tumbuh kembali.
statement.en: In the novel, when Nezha (哪吒) cuts off the head of Bull Demon King (牛王), a new head grows out each time; after a dozen or so strokes a dozen or so heads have grown back.

claims.quote: 哪吒取出火輪兒掛在那老牛的角上，便吹真火，焰焰烘烘，把牛王燒得張狂哮吼，搖頭擺尾。才要變化脫身，又被托塔天王將照妖鏡照住本像，騰那不動，無計逃生，只叫：「莫傷我命，情願歸順佛家也。」

statement.id: Dalam novel, Nezha (哪吒) menggantungkan roda api di tanduk Bull Demon King (牛王). Saat ia hendak berubah wujud untuk lolos, Heavenly King Li (托塔天王) menyorotkan cermin 照妖鏡 sehingga wujud aslinya tertahan; ia tidak bisa bergerak dan berseru bahwa ia bersedia tunduk pada ajaran Buddha.
statement.en: In the novel, Nezha (哪吒) hangs a fire wheel on the horns of Bull Demon King (牛王). As he tries to transform to escape, Heavenly King Li (托塔天王) shines the 照妖鏡 mirror on him, fixing his true form; he cannot move and cries out that he is willing to submit to the Buddhist faith.

claims.quote: 那老牛不得進洞，急抽身。又見八戒、行者趕來，慌得卸了盔甲，丟了鐵棍，搖身一變，變做一隻天鵝，望空飛走。

statement.id: Dalam novel, Bull Demon King (老牛) yang terdesak oleh Zhu Bajie (八戒) dan Sun Wukong (行者) melepas zirah dan tongkat besinya, lalu berubah menjadi angsa (天鵝) dan terbang pergi.
statement.en: In the novel, Bull Demon King (老牛), pressed by Zhu Bajie (八戒) and Sun Wukong (行者), drops his armor and iron staff, transforms into a swan (天鵝), and flies away.

claims.quote: 老牛叫道：「夫人，將扇子出來，救我性命。」羅剎聽叫，急卸了釵環，脫了色服，挽青絲如道姑，穿縞素似比丘，雙手捧那柄丈二長短的芭蕉扇子，走出門。

statement.id: Dalam novel, setelah ditawan, Bull Demon King (老牛) memanggil istrinya agar membawa keluar kipas (扇子) demi menyelamatkan nyawanya; Luocha Nü (羅剎) keluar membawa 芭蕉扇 (kipas pisang) yang panjangnya satu zhang dua chi.
statement.en: In the novel, once captured, Bull Demon King (老牛) calls on his wife to bring out the fan (扇子) to save his life; Luocha Nü (羅剎) comes out carrying the 芭蕉扇 (banana-leaf fan), twelve chi long.

claims.quote: In China, historical "Ox King Temples" (牛王庙, Niu Wang Miao) are occasionally mistaken by modern tourists for shrines dedicated to the Bull Demon King due to the similarity in name. However, these temples were traditionally built to worship agricultural deities

statement.id: Di Tiongkok, kuil-kuil "Ox King Temples" (牛王庙, Niu Wang Miao) kadang dikira kuil untuk Bull Demon King karena namanya mirip, padahal kuil itu secara tradisional dibangun untuk memuja dewa-dewa pertanian.
statement.en: In China, historical "Ox King Temples" (牛王庙, Niu Wang Miao) are occasionally mistaken by modern tourists for shrines of Bull Demon King because of the similar name, although they were traditionally built to worship agricultural deities.

claims.quote: Associate Professor Zhao Xu of Shenyang University identifies the Bull Demon King as a symbolic counterpart to Sun Wukong

statement.id: Menurut Associate Professor Zhao Xu dari Shenyang University, Bull Demon King adalah pasangan simbolis (counterpart) bagi Sun Wukong.
statement.en: According to Associate Professor Zhao Xu of Shenyang University, Bull Demon King is a symbolic counterpart to Sun Wukong.

claims.quote: He was possibly influenced by Ox-Head, one of the guardians of hell in Chinese mythology.

statement.id: Wikipedia menyebut bahwa Bull Demon King mungkin dipengaruhi oleh Ox-Head, salah satu penjaga neraka dalam mitologi Tiongkok.
statement.en: Wikipedia says Bull Demon King was possibly influenced by Ox-Head, one of the guardians of hell in Chinese mythology.

claims.quote: In the 2014 film The Monkey King, the Bull Demon King (Aaron Kwok) is waging war on Heaven.

statement.id: Dalam film The Monkey King tahun 2014, Bull Demon King (diperankan Aaron Kwok) digambarkan sedang berperang melawan Langit (Heaven).
statement.en: In the 2014 film The Monkey King, Bull Demon King (played by Aaron Kwok) is shown waging war on Heaven.

claims.quote: Bowser, the main antagonist of the Mario video game franchise, was inspired by the Ox-King. Nintendo designer Shigeru Miyamoto has stated that he first envisioned Bowser as an ox, basing him on the Ox-King from the 1960 anime film Alakazam the Great.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Bowser, antagonis utama waralaba video game Mario, terinspirasi oleh Ox-King. Perancang Nintendo Shigeru Miyamoto menyatakan bahwa ia mula-mula membayangkan Bowser sebagai banteng, berdasarkan Ox-King dalam film anime tahun 1960 Alakazam the Great.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, Bowser, the main antagonist of the Mario video game franchise, was inspired by the Ox-King. Nintendo designer Shigeru Miyamoto has stated that he first envisioned Bowser as an ox, basing him on the Ox-King from the 1960 anime film Alakazam the Great.
