short_description.id: Loki adalah dewa pengacau dalam mitologi Nordik yang dapat berganti wujud dan terlibat dalam kisah kematian Baldr.
short_description.en: Loki is a Norse trickster god who can change shape and plays a role in Baldr's death.

long_description.id: Loki adalah saudara sumpah Odin dan sosok yang kerap memperdaya para dewa, walau terkadang juga membantu mereka. Terjemahan Edda Prosa menyebutnya pencetus tipu daya, berparas rupawan tetapi berwatak jahat dan labil, yang sering menjerumuskan sekaligus menolong para asa. Sumber modern menyatakan tidak ada kultus khusus Loki yang jelas dari zaman Viking, dan Edda Prosa disebut sebagai sumber informasi terkaya tentangnya.
long_description.en: Loki is Odin's sworn brother, a figure who often tricks the gods yet sometimes helps them. A translation of the Prose Edda calls him the originator of deceit, fair of face but evil and fickle in disposition, who often brings the asas into trouble and helps them out again. A modern source reports no clear Viking Age cult devoted to him and names the Prose Edda as the richest source of information about him.

long_description.id: Loki dapat berganti wujud menjadi berbagai hewan dan manusia. Ia disebut anak Fárbauti dan Laufey atau Nál, dan Edda Prosa menyebut Byleist dan Helblinde sebagai saudaranya; Sigyn adalah istrinya. Bersama Angrboda ia menjadi ayah Fenrir, ular Midgard, dan Hel; dalam kisah lain ia berubah menjadi kuda betina dan melahirkan Sleipnir.
long_description.en: Loki can change into animals and people. He is named as the child of Fárbauti and Laufey or Nál, the Prose Edda names Byleist and Helblinde as his brothers, and Sigyn is his wife. With Angrboda he fathers Fenrir, the Midgard Serpent, and Hel; in another story he becomes a mare and gives birth to Sleipnir.

long_description.id: Perannya dalam kematian Baldr dikaitkan dengan Ragnarök. Dalam Edda Prosa, Hoder menembak Balder di bawah arahan Loke. Saat Loki dihukum dengan tetesan bisa, Sigyn menadahnya dalam mangkuk; ia dibawa ke sebuah gua dan terikat sampai Ragnarok. Pada Ragnarok ia datang bersama Hrym dan raksasa es lalu bertarung dengan Heimdal. Kisah Freyja dan Skadi memperlihatkan Loki berubah menjadi lalat dan pinjal untuk mengambil kalung Freyja, serta melakukan kelakar fisik untuk membuat Skadi tertawa.
long_description.en: His part in Baldr's death is linked with Ragnarök. In the Prose Edda, Hoder shoots Balder under Loke's guidance. During his punishment Sigyn catches dripping venom in a bowl; he is brought to a cave and lies bound until Ragnarok. At Ragnarok he arrives with Hrym and the frost-giants and fights Heimdal. Stories about Freyja and Skadi show Loki becoming a fly and flea to take Freyja's necklace and performing a physical prank to make Skadi laugh.

short_description.id: Nymph adalah dewi kecil atau roh perempuan alam dalam mitologi Yunani, terkait mata air, hutan, pegunungan, dan tempat alami lain.
short_description.en: Nymphs are minor female nature deities or spirits in Greek myth, linked to springs, forests, mountains, and other natural places.

long_description.id: Nymph adalah dewi kecil atau roh perempuan alam dalam tradisi Yunani, yang juga dikenal dalam mitologi Romawi. Mereka digambarkan sebagai perempuan muda dengan ciri yang sesuai tempat tinggalnya, dan dikisahkan menjadi pengiring atau perawat para dewa, termasuk Zeus kecil dan Dionysos. Nama Nymph diterjemahkan sebagai "gadis usia menikah".
long_description.en: Nymphs are minor female nature deities or spirits of Greek tradition, also known in Roman mythology. They are depicted as young women with attributes matching their abode, and appear as companions or nurses of gods, including infant Zeus and Dionysos. The word is translated as "girl of marriageable age".

long_description.id: Ragam Nymph mengikuti tempat alaminya: Naiad untuk air tawar, Dryad untuk pepohonan, dan Oread untuk pegunungan. Penulis Yunani kuno memakai penggolongan yang cukup cair. Hamadryad adalah Dryad yang daya hidupnya terikat pada satu pohon, dan nymph pohon dipercaya mati bersama pohonnya. Okeanid disebut sebagai kelompok nymph tertua.
long_description.en: Nymph types follow natural places: Naiads for fresh water, Dryads for trees, and Oreads for mountains. Ancient Greek writers used rather fluid classifications. Hamadryads were Dryads whose life force was bound to one tree, and tree nymphs were believed to die together with their trees. The Okeanides are described as the eldest group of nymphs.

long_description.id: Dalam kepercayaan Yunani, nymph pada mata air tertentu dianggap berdaya ramal dan mampu mengilhami manusia dengan karunia puisi, dan sebagian dianggap mampu memulihkan orang sakit. Nymph hutan dipercaya kadang menampakkan diri dan menakuti pelancong yang sendirian, dan nymph di habitat alaminya dapat membuat manusia gila atau tak sadarkan diri (nympholepsy), terutama pada tengah hari. Nymph juga disebut sebagai ibu para pahlawan, seperti pada Achilles dan Thamyris.
long_description.en: In Greek belief, nymphs of certain springs were thought to have prophetic power and to inspire men with the gift of poetry, and some were regarded as able to restore sick persons to health. Forest nymphs were believed sometimes to appear to and frighten solitary travellers, and nymphs in their natural habitat could drive mortals insane or insensate (nympholepsy), particularly at midday. Nymphs are also described as mothers of heroes, as in the case of Achilles and Thamyris.

long_description.id: Pemujaan Nymph meninggalkan tempat suci di gua-gua wilayah Yunani, dan seni Yunani membayangkan mereka menari melingkar di luar gua. Bukti arkeologi menunjukkan bahwa pada periode arkais pemujaan ini berpusat pada sumber air dan menjadi perhatian utama kaum miskin pedesaan. Persembahan kepada mereka biasanya berupa kambing, domba, susu, dan minyak, tetapi tidak pernah anggur.
long_description.en: Worship of nymphs left shrines in caves in the Greek world, and Greek art imagined them dancing in circles outside caves. Archaeological evidence suggests that in the archaic period the cult centered on water sources and mattered chiefly to the rural poor. Their offerings are described as goats, lambs, milk, and oil, with wine excluded.

cultural_context.id: Bukti arkeologi menunjukkan bahwa pada periode arkais pemujaan nymph menjadi perhatian utama kaum miskin pedesaan dan berpusat pada sumber air. Orang yang melewati kuil mata air lazim meninggalkan persembahan hewan kurban.
cultural_context.en: Archaeological evidence suggests that in the archaic period nymph worship mattered chiefly to the rural poor and centered on water sources. Anyone passing a fountain-shrine customarily left an animal sacrifice as an offering.

statement.id: Nymph adalah dewi kecil atau roh perempuan alam dalam mitologi Yunani.

claims.quote: The nymphs were depicted as beautiful young women with attributes matching their abode.

statement.id: Nymph digambarkan sebagai perempuan muda dengan ciri sesuai tempat tinggalnya.
statement.en: Nymphs are depicted as young women with attributes of their habitats.

claims.quote: Nymphs were also companions of the gods.

statement.id: Nymph dikisahkan sebagai pengiring para dewa.
statement.en: Nymphs were companions of gods.

claims.quote: Others were the nurses of the gods including the Idaian nymphs who nursed the infant Zeus, and the Nysian nymphs who cared for Dionysos.

statement.id: Sejumlah Nymph dikisahkan merawat Zeus kecil dan Dionysos.
statement.en: Some nymphs were said to nurse infant Zeus and Dionysos.

claims.quote: Ancient Greek writers describe many types of nymph but the classifications were rather fluid.

statement.id: Jenis-jenis Nymph dalam sumber Yunani kuno tidak memiliki batas yang kaku.
statement.en: Ancient Greek nymph types were fluid rather than rigid categories.

claims.quote: NAIADES (Naiads) were nymphs of the earthly sources of fresh-water, including springs, rivers, streams, wells and fountains.

statement.id: Naiad adalah Nymph air tawar yang terkait mata air, sungai, dan sumur.
statement.en: Naiads are freshwater nymphs of springs, rivers, streams, wells, and fountains.

claims.quote: DRYADES (Dryads) were the nymphs of the trees, forests and groves.

statement.id: Dryad adalah Nymph pepohonan dan hutan.
statement.en: Dryads are nymphs of trees and forests.

claims.quote: OREIADES (Oreads) were mountain-dwelling nymphs.

statement.id: Oread adalah Nymph yang menghuni pegunungan.
statement.en: Oreads are mountain-dwelling nymphs.

claims.quote: shrines dedicated to nymphs have been found in caves across the Greek world, such as at Vari on Mount Hymettus

statement.id: Tempat pemujaan Nymph ditemukan di gua-gua wilayah Yunani.
statement.en: Shrines to nymphs have been found in caves in the Greek world.

claims.quote: people imagined the Nymphs dancing in circle outside their caves on mount Helicon, in Phocis, in Attica and throughout Greece.

statement.id: Nymph dibayangkan menari melingkar di luar gua dalam seni Yunani.
statement.en: Greek art imagined nymphs dancing in circles outside caves.

claims.quote: A nymph (Greek: νύμφη, nymphē) in Greek and in Roman mythology is a young female deity typically identified with natural features

statement.id: Nymph juga dikenal dalam mitologi Romawi sebagai dewi muda alam.
statement.en: Nymphs also appear in Roman mythology as young nature deities.

claims.quote: HAMADRYADES or HADRYADES (Hamadryads) were Dryad nymphs whose life force was bound to that of a specific tree.

statement.id: Hamadryad adalah Dryad yang daya hidupnya terikat pada satu pohon tertentu.
statement.en: Hamadryads were Dryad nymphs whose life force was bound to a specific tree.

claims.quote: Many of these presided over waters or springs which were believed to inspire those that drank of them, and hence the nymphs themselves were thought to be endowed with prophetic or oracular power, and to inspire men with the same, and to confer upon them the gift of poetry.

statement.id: Nymph yang menjaga mata air tertentu dianggap memiliki daya ramal dan dapat mengilhami manusia dengan daya itu serta karunia puisi.
statement.en: Nymphs of certain springs were thought to have prophetic or oracular power and to inspire men with it and with the gift of poetry.

claims.quote: some were thus regarded as having the power of restoring sick persons to health

statement.id: Sebagian nymph dianggap mampu memulihkan orang sakit.
statement.en: Some nymphs were regarded as able to restore sick persons to health.

claims.quote: Nymphs of forests, groves, and glens, were believed sometimes to appear to and frighten solitary travellers.

statement.id: Nymph hutan, hutan kecil, dan lembah dipercaya kadang menampakkan diri dan menakuti pelancong yang sendirian.
statement.en: Nymphs of forests, groves, and glens were believed sometimes to appear to and frighten solitary travellers.

claims.quote: Nymphs of trees, were believed to die together with the trees which had been their abode, and with which they had come into existence.

statement.id: Nymph pepohonan dipercaya mati bersama pohon yang menjadi tempat tinggal dan tempat mereka lahir.
statement.en: Tree nymphs were believed to die together with the trees that had been their abode and with which they came into existence.

claims.quote: The sacrifices offered to nymphs usually consisted of goats, lambs, milk, and oil, but never of wine.

statement.id: Persembahan kepada nymph biasanya berupa kambing, domba, susu, dan minyak, tetapi tidak pernah anggur.
statement.en: Sacrifices offered to nymphs usually consisted of goats, lambs, milk, and oil, but never of wine.

claims.quote: OKEANIDES (Oceanids) were the eldest of the nymphs, daughters of the great, earth-encircling River Okeanos (Oceanus).

statement.id: Okeanid adalah kelompok nymph tertua, putri Sungai Okeanos yang mengelilingi bumi.
statement.en: The Okeanides (Oceanids) were the eldest of the nymphs, daughters of the earth-encircling River Okeanos (Oceanus).

claims.quote: In modern compilations Okeanides are often mistakenly described as "ocean" nymphs. In Greek mythology, however, their father Okeanos "Ocean" was an earth-encircling, fresh-water stream and not a salt-sea ocean.

statement.id: Okeanid dalam kumpulan modern sering keliru disebut nymph "samudra", padahal dalam mitologi Yunani ayah mereka, Okeanos, adalah aliran air tawar yang mengelilingi bumi dan bukan samudra air asin.
statement.en: In modern compilations the Okeanides are often mistakenly described as "ocean" nymphs, but in Greek mythology their father Okeanos was an earth-encircling fresh-water stream and not a salt-sea ocean.

claims.quote: or as part of the divine retinue of a comparable god such as Apollo, Dionysos or Pan, or goddesses, such as Artemis, who was known as the tutelary deity of all nymphs.

statement.id: Nymph juga menjadi bagian rombongan ilahi para dewa seperti Apollo, Dionysos, dan Pan, atau dewi seperti Artemis, yang dikenal sebagai dewi pelindung semua nymph.
statement.en: Nymphs could also be part of the divine retinue of gods such as Apollo, Dionysos or Pan, or of goddesses such as Artemis, known as the tutelary deity of all nymphs.

claims.quote: Like Pan, nymphs within their natural habitat may drive mortals insane or insensate (known as nympholepsy), particularly at midday.

statement.id: Seperti Pan, nymph di habitat alaminya dapat membuat manusia gila atau tak sadarkan diri (nympholepsy), terutama pada tengah hari.
statement.en: Like Pan, nymphs in their natural habitat may drive mortals insane or insensate (nympholepsy), particularly at midday.

claims.quote: Nymphs are often the mothers of heroes, as was the case for Achilles and Thamyris

statement.id: Nymph sering menjadi ibu para pahlawan, seperti pada Achilles dan Thamyris.
statement.en: Nymphs are often the mothers of heroes, as in the case of Achilles and Thamyris.

claims.quote: Archaeological evidence suggests that the cult of the nymphs in the archaic period was a primary concern of the rural poor, and focused on water sources

statement.id: Bukti arkeologi menunjukkan bahwa pada periode arkais pemujaan nymph menjadi perhatian utama kaum miskin pedesaan dan berpusat pada sumber air.
statement.en: Archaeological evidence suggests that in the archaic period the cult of the nymphs was a primary concern of the rural poor and focused on water sources.

claims.quote: it was customary for anyone passing a fountain-shrine to leave an offering, typically in the form of an animal sacrifice, such as a portion of a boar, goat, or sheep

statement.id: Dalam bentuk pedesaan paling awal, orang yang melewati kuil mata air lazim meninggalkan persembahan, biasanya hewan kurban seperti bagian dari babi hutan, kambing, atau domba.
statement.en: In the earliest rural form, anyone passing a fountain-shrine customarily left an offering, typically an animal sacrifice such as a portion of a boar, goat, or sheep.

claims.quote: Translation Girl of Marriageable Age

statement.id: Nama Yunani nymph diterjemahkan sebagai "gadis usia menikah".
statement.en: The Greek name nymph is translated as "girl of marriageable age".

short_description.id: Pluto adalah dewa dunia bawah Romawi dan padanan Hades dalam mitologi Yunani.
short_description.en: Pluto is the Roman underworld god and counterpart of Greek Hades.

long_description.id: Pluto adalah anak Saturnus dan Ops, serta saudara Jupiter dan Neptunus. Ia berkuasa atas Tartarus dan dunia bawah. Theoi menjelaskan nama Pluto berkaitan dengan gelar Yunani Plouton, "penguasa kekayaan". Dalam uraian Theoi tentang Hades, padanannya dalam mitologi Yunani, ia memimpin upacara pemakaman dan membela hak orang mati atas penguburan yang layak, serta dikenal sebagai dewa kekayaan tersembunyi di dalam bumi.
long_description.en: Pluto is the son of Saturnus and Ops and brother of Jupiter and Neptunus. He rules Tartarus and the underworld. Theoi connects Pluto with the Greek title Plouton, "the Lord of Riches". In Theoi's account of Hades, his Greek counterpart, he oversaw burial ceremonies and championed the entitlement of the dead to proper burial, and he was lord of the concealed riches of the earth.

long_description.id: Proserpina menjadi ratunya setelah diculik Pluto. Sumber berbeda tentang lamanya ia berada di dunia bawah: satu sumber menyebut tiga atau enam bulan tiap tahun, sedangkan versi Ovid menyebut enam bulan bersama ibunya dan enam bulan bersama suaminya. Theoi mencatat bahwa karena telah mencicipi biji delima, ia harus kembali untuk sebagian tiap tahun.
long_description.en: Proserpina becomes his queen after Pluto abducts her. Sources differ over her time in the underworld: one source gives three or six months yearly, while Ovid's version gives six months with her mother and six with her husband. Theoi notes that because she had tasted the pomegranate seed she had to return for a portion of each year.

long_description.id: Pluto dikisahkan mengendarai kereta emas dengan empat kuda hitam serta memiliki helm yang membuat pemakainya tak terlihat. Cerberus menjaga pintu masuk dunia bawah. Theoi menggambarkan Hades sebagai dewa berjanggut gelap dan berwibawa seperti raja, dan mengutip uraian bahwa ia menjaga gerbang dunia bawah tetap tertutup, berwatak garang serta tak kenal ampun, sehingga paling dibenci manusia. Dalam kisah Orpheus, Pluto mengizinkan Eurydice dibawa kembali dengan syarat Orpheus tidak menoleh.
long_description.en: Pluto is said to drive a golden chariot with four black horses and own a helmet that makes its wearer invisible. Cerberus guards the underworld entrance. Theoi describes Hades as a dark-bearded, regal god, and quotes an account that Hades kept the gates of the lower world closed and was fierce and inexorable, so that mortals hated him most of all the gods. In the Orpheus tale, Pluto permits Eurydice's return if Orpheus does not look back.

famous_for.en: Pluto is known for kidnapping Proserpina and making her his queen in the underworld.

role.id: Pluto menculik Proserpina dan menjadikannya ratu dunia bawah.
role.en: Pluto abducts Proserpina and makes her queen of the underworld.

summary.id: Dalam Metamorphoses karya Ovid, anak panah Cupid mengenai dada Pluto, lalu Proserpine dilihat dan dibawa pergi olehnya; bumi yang terhantam membuka jalan menuju Tartarus, dan Proserpine mengunyah tujuh butir yang dipetik dari kulit yang pucat. Menurut satu sumber, ia diculik dan terpaksa menghabiskan tiga (sebagian menyebut enam) bulan tiap tahun di dunia bawah; versi Ovid menyebut enam bulan bersama ibunya dan enam bulan bersama suaminya. Theoi mencatat bahwa karena telah mencicipi biji delima ia harus kembali untuk sebagian tiap tahun.
summary.en: In Ovid's Metamorphoses, Cupid's arrow strikes Pluto in the breast, and Proserpine is then seen and carried off by him; the smitten earth makes way to Tartarus, and Proserpine chews seven grains picked from the pallid rind. One source says she is kidnapped and forced to spend three (some claim six) months a year in the underworld; Ovid's version gives six months with her mother and six with her husband. Theoi notes that because she had tasted the pomegranate seed she had to return for a portion of each year.

role.id: Pluto mengizinkan Eurydice kembali ke bumi dengan syarat.
role.en: Pluto permits Eurydice to return to earth on a condition.

summary.id: Pluto mengizinkan Orpheus membawa kekasihnya kembali ke bumi, dengan peringatan agar ia tidak menoleh untuk melihat Eurydice.
summary.en: Pluto allows Orpheus to take his beloved back to earth, with a warning not to turn around to see Eurydice.

role.id: Plouton mengizinkan Herakles membawa Kerberos jika ia sanggup menaklukkannya tanpa senjata.
role.en: Plouton lets Herakles take Kerberos if he can overpower it without weapons.

summary.id: Herakles meminta Kerberos kepada Plouton, yang menyuruhnya membawa anjing itu jika ia sanggup menaklukkannya tanpa senjata yang ia bawa.
summary.en: Herakles requested Kerberos from Plouton, who answered that he could take the hound provided he subdued it without the weapons he had brought.

description.en: Pluto is the god of the underworld and gained control of Tartarus and the lower world; per Theoi, Hades received the dark dismal underworld as the third portion in the division of the cosmos. Its entrance is guarded by Cerberus.

short_description.id: Tengri adalah sebutan dewa utama dalam tradisi Turk dan Mongol awal.
short_description.en: Tengri names a principal deity in early Turkic and Mongol traditions.

long_description.id: Tengri adalah sebutan dewa utama dalam tradisi Turk dan Mongol awal. Konsep Tengri mencakup langit biru yang jernih dan peran dewa nasib. Dalam mitos penciptaan Mongol, Tengri Khairkhan muncul sebagai pencipta bumi.
long_description.en: Tengri names a principal deity in early Turkic and Mongol traditions. The Tengri concept includes the clear blue sky and a deity of fate. In Mongol creation mythology, Tengri Khairkhan appears as the creator of the earth.

long_description.id: Han shu mencatat bahwa orang Xiongnu menyebut langit 撐犁 dan menamai pemimpin mereka 撐犁孤塗單于. Sebuah artikel rujukan menyebut bentuk tertua nama itu dalam arsip Tiongkok sebagai 撑犁 dan menduganya transkripsi dari Tängri, serta menyatakan bahwa kata tengri umumnya diasumsikan semula berarti "langit".
long_description.en: The Han shu records that the Xiongnu call heaven 撐犁 and named their ruler 撐犁孤塗單于. A reference article gives the oldest form of the name in Chinese annals as 撑犁 and hypothesizes that it transcribes Tängri, and it states that the word tengri is generally assumed to have originally meant "sky".

long_description.id: Menurut artikel yang sama, Tengri adalah dewa nasional bangsa Göktürk dan para khan mereka mendasarkan kekuasaan pada mandat dari Tengri. Prasasti untuk Kul Tigin, dalam terjemahan yang dikutip, menyebut bahwa langit biru di atas dan bumi cokelat di bawah diciptakan, dan di antara keduanya manusia diciptakan. Dalam prasasti Orkhon, Bilge Kagan menyebut dirinya sebagai Turk yang seperti Tengri dan lahir dari Tengri.
long_description.en: According to the same article, Tengri was the national god of the Göktürks and their khans based their power on a mandate from Tengri. The inscription for Kul Tigin, in the translation quoted, says that the blue sky above and the brown earth below were created, and between them a human being was created. In the Orkhon inscriptions, Bilge Kaghan calls himself Tengri-like and Tengri-born.

statement.en: The Han shu (漢書) records that the Xiongnu call heaven 撐犁 (chengli) and a son 孤塗 (gutu); their state called its ruler 撐犁孤塗單于, and the word 單于 is explained as meaning "vast and great", said to express resemblance to heaven.

short_description.id: Tláloc adalah dewa hujan dalam agama Aztec, juga dewa kesuburan tanah dan air, yang dipuja sebagai pemberi kehidupan sekaligus ditakuti karena kuasanya atas hujan es, guntur, dan kilat.
short_description.en: Tláloc is the god of rain in Aztec religion, also a deity of earthly fertility and water, worshipped as a giver of life and feared for his power over hail, thunder and lightning.

long_description.id: Tláloc adalah dewa hujan dalam agama Aztec dan juga dewa kesuburan tanah serta air. Ia dipuja sebagai pemberi kehidupan dan rezeki, dan banyak ritual serta korban dipersembahkan atas namanya. Ia ditakuti karena kuasanya atas hujan es, guntur, kilat, dan hujan, meskipun bukan sosok yang jahat.
long_description.en: Tláloc is the god of rain in Aztec religion and also a deity of earthly fertility and water. He was worshipped as a giver of life and sustenance, and many rituals and sacrifices were held in his name. He was feared for his power over hail, thunder, lightning and rain, although not as a malicious figure.

long_description.id: Sumber lain menggambarkannya sebagai dewa yang berwajah ganda: murah hati ketika memberi hujan, tetapi tak kenal ampun ketika mengirim badai dan kekeringan. Dalam gambaran tentang kendi air, ia menurunkan hujan dari kendi di timur, sedangkan dari kendi lain ia menurunkan kekeringan, penyakit, dan embun beku. Hujan juga dipercaya turun ketika para Tláloc memukul pecah kendi di dalam gunung, dan guntur dianggap bunyi pecahnya kendi itu.
long_description.en: Another source describes him as two-sided: benevolent when giving rain but unforgiving when sending storms and drought. In the imagery of the water jars, he gave out rain from the jar of the East and drought, disease and frost from the other jars. Rain was also thought to come when the Tlálocs smashed the jars inside mountains, and thunder was taken to be the noise of the jars breaking.

long_description.id: Tláloc dikaitkan dengan gua, mata air, dan gunung, terutama gunung suci tempat ia dipercaya bersemayam. Ia juga dianggap penguasa para Tlaloque dan surga Tlalocán, tempat korban banjir, badai, dan penyakit diterima setelah mati. Untuk menenangkannya dipersembahkan korban, termasuk anak-anak yang tangisnya dianggap pertanda baik. Di Tenochtitlán, ia memiliki kuil kembar di Templo Mayor yang kedudukannya setara dengan kuil Huitzilopochtli.
long_description.en: Caves, springs and mountains are linked with Tláloc, above all the sacred mountain believed to be his home. He was also considered ruler of the Tlaloque and of the paradise of Tlalocán, the destination after death of those claimed by floods, storms and disease. To appease him, offerings were made, including child victims whose tears were read as a good sign. At Tenochtitlán he had a twin temple on the Templo Mayor, equal in status to that of Huitzilopochtli.

long_description.id: Dalam seni, Tláloc lazim digambarkan bersama ular, dengan mata bulat besar dan taring besar; sumber lain menyebut taring dan mata bercincin sebagai penandanya. Penggambaran tertuanya berasal dari vas abad ke-1 SM, dan di beberapa budaya Mesoamerika ia muncul dengan nama lain seperti Cocijo bagi Zapotec.
long_description.en: In art, Tláloc is commonly depicted with snakes, goggled eyes and large fangs; another source names fangs and ringed eyes as his identifiers. His earliest depictions are on 1st-century BCE vases, and in several Mesoamerican cultures he appears under other names, such as Cocijo for the Zapotec.

cultural_context.id: Menurut salah satu sumber, Tlaloc penting bagi bangsa Aztec karena hujan yang dikuasainya sangat dibutuhkan untuk pertanian.
cultural_context.en: One source explains that Tlaloc mattered to the Aztecs because the rains he governed were vital for farming.

statement.id: Di ibu kota Aztec, Tenochtitlán, dua kuil kembar didirikan di piramida Templo Mayor: satu untuk Huitzilopochtli (musim kemarau) dan satu untuk Tláloc, yang diberi kedudukan setara.
statement.en: At the Aztec capital Tenochtitlán, two twin temples were set up on the Templo Mayor pyramid, one for Huitzilopochtli (the dry season) and one for Tláloc, who was given equal status.

claims.quote: More sinister offerings to appease the god and win his favour were sacrificial victims, including children, whose tears were seen as a favourable sign and linked to drops of rain from Tláloc himself.

statement.id: Untuk menenangkan dewa ini dipersembahkan korban, termasuk anak-anak, yang tangisnya dianggap pertanda baik dan dikaitkan dengan tetes hujan dari Tláloc sendiri.
statement.en: To appease the god, sacrificial victims were offered, including children, whose tears were seen as a favourable sign and linked to drops of rain from Tláloc himself.

claims.quote: Tláloc was also believed to rule the other-worldly paradise of Tlalocán where victims of floods, storms and diseases such as leprosy were received after death.

statement.id: Tláloc dipercaya menguasai surga Tlalocán, tempat korban banjir, badai, dan penyakit seperti lepra diterima setelah mati.
statement.en: Tláloc was believed to rule the other-worldly paradise of Tlalocán, where victims of floods, storms and diseases such as leprosy were received after death.

claims.quote: In later Postclassical Mexico Tláloc was believed to live in caves which were suitably damp for a rain god but also filled with magnificent treasures.

statement.id: Pada masa Pascaklasik di Meksiko, Tláloc dipercaya tinggal di gua-gua yang lembap dan penuh harta indah.
statement.en: In later Postclassical Mexico, Tláloc was believed to live in caves that were damp and filled with magnificent treasures.

claims.quote: The earliest representations of Tláloc in art belong to 1st century BCE vases from Tlapacoya where the god wields a lightning bolt.

statement.id: Penggambaran tertua Tláloc dalam seni berasal dari vas abad ke-1 SM di Tlapacoya, tempat sang dewa memegang petir.
statement.en: The earliest representations of Tláloc in art belong to 1st-century BCE vases from Tlapacoya, where the god wields a lightning bolt.

claims.quote: Tláloc is commonly depicted in the company of snakes. He most often has goggled eyes and large fangs like a jaguar

statement.id: Tláloc lazim digambarkan bersama ular; ia paling sering bermata bulat besar seperti kacamata renang dan bertaring besar seperti jaguar.
statement.en: Tláloc is commonly depicted in the company of snakes, most often with goggled eyes and large fangs like a jaguar.

claims.quote: In the various Mesoamerican cultures Tláloc appears as Dzahui for the Mixtec, Tajίn for the Totonac, Chupithripeme for the Tarascan and Cocijo for the Zapotec.

statement.id: Dalam berbagai budaya Mesoamerika, Tláloc muncul sebagai Dzahui bagi suku Mixtec, Tajín bagi Totonac, Chupithripeme bagi Tarasca, dan Cocijo bagi Zapotec.
statement.en: In the various Mesoamerican cultures Tláloc appears as Dzahui for the Mixtec, Tajín for the Totonac, Chupithripeme for the Tarascan and Cocijo for the Zapotec.

claims.quote: Tlaloc was important to the Aztecs because he was the god of vital rains needed for agriculture.

statement.id: Tlaloc penting bagi bangsa Aztec karena ia dewa hujan vital yang dibutuhkan untuk pertanian.
statement.en: Tlaloc was important to the Aztecs because he was the god of vital rains needed for agriculture.

claims.quote: Tláloc's two main identifiers are fangs, along with ringed eyes.

statement.id: Dua penanda utama Tláloc adalah taring dan mata bercincin.
statement.en: Tláloc's two main identifiers are fangs and ringed eyes.

claims.quote: In the Aztec Creation myth Tláloc was ruler of the 3rd Sun, he was linked to Mázatl (Deer) the 7th day

statement.id: Dalam mitos penciptaan Aztec, Tláloc adalah penguasa Matahari ke-3 dan dikaitkan dengan Mázatl (Rusa), hari ketujuh.
statement.en: In the Aztec creation myth, Tláloc was ruler of the 3rd Sun and was linked to Mázatl (Deer), the 7th day.

claims.quote: Born during the Creation when Quetzalcoatl and Huitzilpochtli (or in some versions Tezcatlipoca) dismembered the reptilian monster Cipactli

statement.id: Tláloc lahir pada masa penciptaan, ketika Quetzalcoatl dan Huitzilpochtli (atau dalam beberapa versi Tezcatlipoca) mencabik-cabik monster reptil Cipactli.
statement.en: Tláloc was born during the Creation, when Quetzalcoatl and Huitzilpochtli (or in some versions Tezcatlipoca) dismembered the reptilian monster Cipactli.

claims.quote: along with his sister Chalchiúhtlicue (or in some versions his wife or mother), herself a goddess of rivers, oceans and floods.

statement.id: Chalchiúhtlicue, dewi sungai, samudra, dan banjir, disebut sebagai saudari Tláloc atau, dalam beberapa versi, istri atau ibunya.
statement.en: Chalchiúhtlicue, a goddess of rivers, oceans and floods, is called the sister of Tláloc or, in some versions, his wife or mother.

topic.id: Siapa yang mencabik-cabik Cipactli saat Tláloc lahir
topic.en: Who dismembered Cipactli at Tláloc's birth

summary.en: Quetzalcoatl and Huitzilpochtli.

summary.en: In some versions, Quetzalcoatl and Tezcatlipoca.

short_description.id: Vulcan adalah dewa api dan penempaan Romawi, pelindung pandai besi yang dipadankan dengan Hephaestus Yunani.
short_description.en: Vulcan is the Roman god of fire and forge, patron of smiths and counterpart of Greek Hephaestus.

long_description.id: Vulcan atau Volcanus adalah dewa api dan penempaan Romawi, putra Jupiter dan Juno serta pelindung pandai besi dan perajin. Ia dipadankan dengan Hephaestus Yunani, dan sebagai dewa tempa serta api yang menghancurkan, termasuk gunung berapi, ia mungkin termasuk dewa yang paling ditakuti. Sebuah catatan penerjemah mencatat bahwa ada yang menyebutnya putra Juno saja.
long_description.en: Vulcan, or Volcanus, is the Roman god of fire and forge, son of Jupiter and Juno and patron of blacksmiths and artisans. He was identified with Greek Hephaestus, and as god of the forge and of devastating fire, including volcanoes, he was probably among the most dreaded of the gods. A translator's note records that some called him the son of Juno alone.

long_description.id: Festival Vulcanalia dirayakan pada 23 Agustus, dan salah satu kuilnya berdiri di Campus Martius di luar Roma; karena takut api, sebagian besar kuilnya berada di luar kota.
long_description.en: Vulcanalia was celebrated on 23 August, and one of his temples stood on the Campus Martius outside Rome; for fear of fire, most of his temples were located outside a city.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah Romawi, Jupiter melemparkan Vulcan dari surga, dan jatuhnya membuatnya pincang dan cacat; ia lalu mendirikan bengkel besar di Gunung Aetna bersama para Cyclopes. Menurut versi Yunani, justru Hera yang melemparkan Hephaestus yang baru lahir. Ia dinikahkan dengan Venus, yang kemudian meninggalkannya bagi Mars, dan keburukan rupanya disebut menghalangi kebahagiaannya dalam pernikahan.
long_description.en: In the Roman account Jupiter threw Vulcan out of heaven, and the fall left him lame and deformed; he then established a great forge on Mount Aetna with the Cyclopes. In the Greek variation it was Hera who hurled the newborn Hephaestus down. He was married to Venus, who later left him for Mars, and his ugliness is said to have prevented him from finding happiness in marriage.

long_description.id: Vulcan membuat takhta emas berperangkap bagi Juno dan melepaskannya setelah Bacchus membujuknya dengan anggur, lalu membangun istana bagi para dewa. Ia membuka kepala Jupiter dengan kapak sehingga Minerva lahir, dan menempa senjata untuk Aeneas atas permintaan Venus, lalu kembali ke bengkel tempat para Cyclopes mengerjakan petir Jupiter. Ia juga membuat jaring perunggu untuk menjebak Venus dan Mars. Seni Renaisans sering menampilkannya sebagai pandai besi pincang.
long_description.en: Vulcan made a trapped golden throne for Juno and freed her after Bacchus appealed to him with wine, then built palaces for the gods. He opened Jupiter's head with an axe so that Minerva sprang forth, and forged arms for Aeneas at Venus's request, then returned to his forge where the Cyclopes worked on Jupiter's thunderbolts. He also made a bronze net to trap Venus and Mars. Renaissance art often shows him as a lame blacksmith.

cultural_context.id: Karena takut api dan demi keselamatan, sebagian besar kuil Vulcan dibangun di luar kota, dan sebagai pelindung mereka yang bekerja dengan logam cair, ia tentu bermakna khusus bagi perajin perunggu.
cultural_context.en: For fear of fire and for safety, most of Vulcan's temples were located outside a city, and as patron of those who worked with molten metal he must have had a special meaning for the bronze artist.

who.id: Vulcan adalah dewa api dan penempaan Romawi.
who.en: Vulcan is the Roman god of fire and forge.

origin.id: Vulcan berasal dari mitologi Romawi dan dipadankan dengan Hephaestus Yunani.
origin.en: Vulcan comes from Roman mythology and is the equivalent of Greek Hephaestus.

role.id: Vulcan adalah pelindung pandai besi dan perajin.
role.en: Vulcan is the patron of blacksmiths and artisans.

famous_for.id: Vulcan dikenal karena menempa karya agung bagi para dewa dan pahlawan, termasuk senjata Aeneas.
famous_for.en: Vulcan is known for forging masterworks for gods and heroes, including arms for Aeneas.

did_you_know.id: Vulcan tidak memiliki planet yang dinamai dengannya, hanya proses pengerasan karet: vulkanisasi.
did_you_know.en: No planet bears the name of Vulcan; the only thing named after him is vulcanization, the process of hardening rubber.

description.id: Para Cyclopes di bengkel Vulcan mengerjakan petir Jupiter dan kereta Mars, dan Vulcan diminta membuat senjata dan baju zirah untuk Aeneas. Para penyair juga menyebut seekor anjing buatan Vulcan yang ia persembahkan kepada Jupiter, dan sebuah kereta emas disebut hadiah darinya.
description.en: The Cyclopes at Vulcan's forge worked on Jupiter's thunderbolts and Mars' chariot, and Vulcan was asked to make weapons and armor for Aeneas. The poets also say a dog was made by Vulcan and presented to Jupiter, and a golden chariot is called his gift.

description.id: Vulcan membuat takhta emas berperangkap bagi Juno dan jaring tipis dari perunggu untuk menjebak Venus dan Mars.
description.en: Vulcan made a trapped golden throne for Juno and a very thin bronze net to catch Venus and Mars.

description.id: Vulcan membangun istana megah bagi setiap dewa.
description.en: Vulcan built magnificent palaces for each of the gods.

description.id: Jatuh dari surga membuat Vulcan pincang dan cacat, dan keburukan rupanya menghalanginya menemukan kebahagiaan dalam pernikahan.
description.en: The fall from heaven left Vulcan lame and deformed, and his ugliness prevented him from finding happiness in marriage.

description.id: Padanan Yunani Vulcan; banyak kisah Vulcan ditemukan dalam kisah Hephaestus, sehingga sering sulit dibedakan.
description.en: The Greek equivalent of Vulcan; many Vulcan stories are found in the tales of Hephaestus, and it is often difficult to differentiate them.

role.en: Maker of the throne

summary.en: Vulcan fashioned a golden throne with hidden springs for Juno; Bacchus appealed to him with wine until he freed his mother.

summary.en: At Jupiter's appeal Vulcan opened his head with an axe, and Minerva sprang forth fully grown and clad in armor.

summary.en: Venus asked her husband Vulcan to make weapons and armor for Aeneas; Vulcan went back to the forge, where the Cyclopes were busy with Jupiter's thunderbolts and Mars' chariot, and Aeneas' shield portrayed future events of Roman history.

claims.quote: was the first to see the shame of Venus and Mars ... He relates what he had seen to Vulcan. ... Vulcan's mind reeled and the work upon which he was engaged fell from his hands ... The god of the forge fashioned a very thin net of fine links of bronze and spread it over a couch.

statement.id: Setelah diberi tahu tentang aib Venus dan Mars, pikiran Vulcan terguncang dan pekerjaannya jatuh dari tangannya; dewa tempa itu lalu membuat jaring tipis dari mata rantai perunggu dan membentangkannya di atas ranjang.
statement.en: After being told of the shame of Venus and Mars, Vulcan's mind reeled and his work fell from his hands; the god of the forge then fashioned a very thin net of fine bronze links and spread it over a couch.

claims.quote: A variation of this fall comes from Greek mythology. Hera was well aware of Zeus' wandering eye and wanted to give him a child of great strength and power, but at Hephaestus' birth, Hera found him small, swarthy, and ugly. Disgusted, she hurled him down the mountainside, disappearing into the sea.

statement.id: Dalam variasi Yunani, saat Hephaestus lahir, Hera mendapatinya kecil, gelap, dan buruk rupa, lalu dengan jijik melemparkannya menuruni gunung hingga lenyap ke laut.
statement.en: In the Greek variation, at Hephaestus' birth Hera found him small, swarthy, and ugly and, disgusted, hurled him down the mountainside into the sea.

short_description.id: Sekhmet adalah dewi prajurit dan penyembuhan dalam mitologi Mesir.
short_description.en: Sekhmet is an Egyptian warrior and healing goddess.

long_description.id: Sekhmet adalah dewi prajurit dan penyembuhan dalam mitologi Mesir. Sekhmet juga merupakan dewi matahari dengan gelar Mata Ra. Ia sering dikaitkan dengan Hathor dan Bastet.
long_description.en: Sekhmet is an Egyptian warrior and healing goddess. Sekhmet is also a solar deity with the epithet Eye of Ra. She is often associated with Hathor and Bastet.

long_description.id: Sekhmet adalah manifestasi pembalasan Ra yang disebut Mata Ra. Ia dianggap menyebabkan wabah, sekaligus dimohon untuk menyembuhkan. Ra mengirim Hathor dalam bentuk Sekhmet menghukum manusia yang bersekongkol. Para dewa menghentikannya dengan bir merah yang disangka darah. Versi lain mengisahkan Thoth membujuk Sekhmet kembali setelah ia meninggalkan Mesir.
long_description.en: Sekhmet is a vengeful manifestation of Ra called the Eye of Ra. She is believed to cause plagues and is also invoked for healing. Ra sends Hathor as Sekhmet to punish conspiring mortals. The gods stop her with red beer mistaken for blood. Another version tells of Thoth persuading Sekhmet to return after she leaves Egypt.

long_description.id: Ia adalah istri Ptah dan ibu Nefertum. Festival mabuk mengulang minum yang meredakan amarahnya dalam mitos. Namanya diartikan Yang Perkasa. Ia menjadi pelindung militer melalui kekuatan penghancuran dan pembalasan. Salah satu gelarnya adalah Penghantam Orang Nubia. Gelar Nyonya Kehidupan berkaitan dengan kemampuannya menyembuhkan wabah. Budge memakai nama Sekhet untuk pasangan feminin Ptah dalam triad bersama Nefertem.
long_description.en: She is Ptah’s wife and Nefertum’s mother. A festival of intoxication reenacts the drinking that calms her mythical wrath. Her name is interpreted as the Powerful One. She becomes a military patron through destruction and vengeance. One of her titles is Smiter of the Nubians. The Mistress of Life title relates to her ability to cure plague. Budge uses Sekhet for Ptah’s feminine counterpart in a triad with Nefertem.

short_description.id: Ahura Mazda adalah ilahi tertinggi dalam Zoroastrianism, dipandang sebagai pencipta yang bijak dan pemelihara tatanan kebenaran.
short_description.en: Ahura Mazda is the supreme divinity of Zoroastrianism, regarded as a wise creator and sustainer of truth and order.

long_description.id: Ahura Mazda berasal dari agama Old Iranian dan ditempatkan oleh Zoroaster sebagai God. Penafsiran nama Mazdā sebagai 'kebijaksanaan' atau 'bijak' masih diperdebatkan; Ahura berarti tuan. Tradisi Zoroastrianism menghubungkannya dengan aša, tatanan dan kebenaran kosmis, serta keadilan.
long_description.en: Ahura Mazda comes from ancient Iranian religion and was elevated by Zoroaster as God. Scholars debate whether Mazdā means 'wisdom' or 'wise', while Ahura means lord. Sources on Zoroastrianism link him to aša, cosmic truth and order, and to justice.

long_description.id: Dalam uraian Zoroaster yang dibahas Kajian ini, Ahura Mazda tidak diciptakan dan memunculkan enam wujud agung. Manusia diberi pilihan moral; kejahatan berasal dari sumber selain Ahura Mazda. Uraian akademik itu juga mengingatkan bahwa gagasan Zoroaster tentang kuasanya tidak sama dengan konsep kemahakuasaan yang berkembang kemudian.
long_description.en: In the account of Zoroaster discussed by an academic source, Ahura Mazda is uncreated and emanates six great beings. Humans have moral choice, while evil has a source other than Ahura Mazda. Zoroaster did not conceive of Ahura Mazda as omnipotent.

long_description.id: Prasasti Darius menyebut Ahuramazda sebagai pencipta bumi, langit, manusia, dan kebahagiaan, serta sumber legitimasi kerajaan dan perlindungan. Bentuk nama Ahuramazda, Hormazd, dan Ohrmazd berubah menurut periode. Kajian ini menyatakan belum ada penggambaran Ahuramazda yang tercatat dari masa Achaemenid awal.
long_description.en: Darius's inscription calls Ahuramazda creator of earth, sky, people, and happiness, as well as the source of royal legitimacy and protection. The forms Ahuramazda, Hormazd, and Ohrmazd vary by period. An academic source says no depiction of Ahuramazda is recorded for the early Achaemenid period.

short_description.id: Ardhanarisvara adalah bentuk Shiva yang menyatu dengan Parvati.
short_description.en: Ardhanarishvara is a form of Shiva united with Parvati.

long_description.id: Ardhanarisvara adalah bentuk Shiva yang menyatu dengan Parvati. Wujudnya dibagi sama rata menjadi setengah laki-laki dan setengah perempuan.
long_description.en: Ardhanarishvara is a form of Shiva united with Parvati. The form is divided equally into half male and half female.

long_description.id: Ia melambangkan penyatuan energi maskulin dan feminin atau Purusha dan Prakriti. Bagian kanan biasanya Shiva laki-laki. Penggambaran awal berasal dari periode Kushan dan berkembang pada era Gupta. Nama Ardhanarisvara berarti Tuhan yang setengah perempuan. Deskripsi Cleveland tentang Ardhanarisvara memperlihatkan sisi kiri perempuan dan sisi kanan laki-laki.
long_description.en: It symbolizes the union of masculine and feminine energies or Purusha and Prakriti. The right half is usually male Shiva. Early depictions date to the Kushan period and develop in the Gupta era. The name Ardhanarishvara means the Lord who is half woman. Cleveland's description of Ardhanarishvara shows the left side female and the right side male.

short_description.id: Nephthys adalah dewi Mesir anggota Ennead Heliopolis.
short_description.en: Nephthys is an Egyptian goddess belonging to the Heliopolitan Ennead.

long_description.id: Nephthys adalah dewi Mesir anggota Ennead Heliopolis. Ia putri Nut dan Geb. Isis adalah saudarinya dan pasangan dalam ritual pemakaman.
long_description.en: Nephthys is an Egyptian goddess belonging to the Heliopolitan Ennead. She is a daughter of Nut and Geb. Isis is her sister and partner in funerary rites.

long_description.id: Ia disebut saudari sekaligus istri Set. Ia dikaitkan dengan perkabungan, malam, dan perlindungan. Namanya lazim diterjemahkan sebagai Nyonya Rumah atau Nyonya Kuil. Bersama Isis ia melambangkan gerbang pylon kuil. Ia dipandang sebagai dewi pelindung yang melambangkan pengalaman kematian.
long_description.en: She is described as Set’s sister and wife. She is associated with mourning, night and protection. Her name is usually translated as Lady of the House or Lady of the Temple. With Isis she symbolizes a temple’s pylon gateway. She is viewed as a protective goddess symbolizing the death experience.

long_description.id: Sebagian mitos menjadikannya ibu Anubis; kisah lain memberi Anubis ibu berbeda. Ia juga berperan sebagai pengasuh firaun. Ia dikenal sebagai Sahabat Orang Mati. Peratap profesional disebut Layang-Layang Nephthys. Lamentations of Isis and Nephthys dipakai dalam festival, ibadah, dan pemakaman. Dalam teks tersebut ia memanggil jiwa Osiris kembali dari kematian. Budge menyebut tempat Nephthys dalam bahtera matahari saat penciptaan dan kaitannya dengan senja.
long_description.en: Some myths make her Anubis’s mother; others give him a different mother. She also acts as a nurse to the pharaoh. She is known as Friend of the Dead. Professional mourners are called the Kites of Nephthys. The Lamentations of Isis and Nephthys is used at festivals, services and funerals. In that text she calls Osiris’s soul back from death. Budge describes Nephthys’s place in the solar boat at creation and her connection with twilight.

short_description.id: Rhea adalah Titan perempuan dan dewi ibu Yunani, putri Gaia dan Uranus, yang menyelamatkan Zeus bayi dari Cronus.
short_description.en: Rhea is a Greek female Titan and mother goddess, daughter of Gaia and Uranus, who saved infant Zeus from Cronus.

long_description.id: Rhea adalah Titan perempuan dan dewi ibu dalam mitologi Yunani, putri Gaia dan Uranus. Ia ibu Hestia, Demeter, Hera, Hades, Poseidon, serta Zeus. Sumber klasik menyebutnya dewi bumi, dan namanya diterjemahkan sebagai "aliran, kemudahan".
long_description.en: Rhea is a female Titan and mother goddess of Greek myth, daughter of Gaia and Uranus. She is mother of Hestia, Demeter, Hera, Hades, Poseidon, and Zeus. Classical sources describe her as a goddess of the earth, and her name is translated as "flow, ease".

long_description.id: Dalam kisah utamanya, Cronos menelan anak-anaknya; menurut sebuah sumber klasik hal itu karena Bumi dan Langit meramalkan ia akan digulingkan putranya sendiri. Untuk menyelamatkan Zeus, Rhea pergi ke Kreta, melahirkan di sebuah gua di Dicte, menitipkan bayi itu kepada Kouretes serta dua Nymph, dan menyerahkan batu berbalut kain kepada Cronos. Kouretes membenturkan perisai untuk menyembunyikan tangis Zeus. Orang-orang kuno tidak sepakat apakah Zeus dibesarkan di Gunung Ida atau Gunung Dicte.
long_description.en: In her best-known story Cronos swallows his children; in one classical source this is because Earth and Sky foretold that he would be dethroned by his own son. To save Zeus, Rhea goes to Crete, gives birth in a cave of Dicte, entrusts the infant to the Kouretes and two nymphs, and gives Cronos a swaddled stone. The Kouretes clash shields to hide Zeus's cries. The ancients were not agreed whether Zeus was reared on Mount Ida or Mount Dicte.

long_description.id: Rhea dikaitkan dengan Cybele, dewi Frigia, walau keduanya semula tokoh berbeda; Cybele juga tercantum di antara nama-namanya. Ops adalah padanan Rhea di Romawi. Kreta disebut pusat pemujaannya yang paling awal, dan di Olympia ada kuil Metroön untuknya. Di Frigia para Corybantes menjadi imam-imamnya, dan dalam seni ia umumnya digambarkan duduk di singgasana yang diapit singa.
long_description.en: Rhea became associated with Cybele, a Phrygian goddess, although the two began as separate figures; Cybele is also listed among her names. Ops is her Roman counterpart. Crete is called the earliest seat of her worship, and at Olympia there was a Metroön built for her. In Phrygia the Corybantes were her priests, and in art she is generally shown seated on a throne flanked by lions.

long_description.id: Sumber-sumber kuno juga mencatat versi yang berbeda tentang keluarganya, dan sebagian kisah menyebut Rhea bersama Cronos menggantikan Ophion dan Eurynome dalam kekuasaan atas dunia. Pohon ek dan singa dikeramatkan baginya. Homer hanya menyinggung Rhea sekilas, sehingga bagian dalam Hesiod dianggap legenda Yunani tertua tentang Rhea.
long_description.en: Ancient sources also record different versions of her family, and some accounts say Rhea and Cronos succeeded Ophion and Eurynome in sovereignty over the world. The oak and the lion were sacred to her. Homer makes only a passing allusion to Rhea, so the passage of Hesiod is regarded as the most ancient Greek legend about her.

cultural_context.id: Rhea dan Cybele pada mulanya dua tokoh terpisah, tetapi pada dasarnya menjadi dua perwujudan dewi yang sama; pemujaan Rhea tercermin pada kuil Metroön di Olympia yang dibangun untuk menghormatinya sebagai ibu para dewa.
cultural_context.en: Rhea and Cybele began as two separate figures but essentially became two manifestations of the same deity; the cult of Rhea is reflected in the Metroön at Olympia, built to honor her as mother of the gods.

note.en: Hera is among the children of Rhea and Cronos.

note.id: Poseidon termasuk anak Rhea dan Cronos.
note.en: Poseidon is among the children of Rhea and Cronos.

note.id: Hades termasuk anak Rhea dan Cronos.
note.en: Haides is among the children of Rhea and Cronos.

note.id: Rhea dan Cybele pada dasarnya menjadi dua perwujudan dewi yang sama.
note.en: Rhea and Cybele essentially became two manifestations of the same deity.

note.id: Padanan Rhea dalam tradisi Romawi.
note.en: Rhea's Roman counterpart.

note.id: Kouretes menjaga Zeus bayi dan membenturkan perisai agar tangisnya tak terdengar.
note.en: The Kouretes guarded infant Zeus and clashed shields to hide his cries.

claims.quote: Rhea (also spelt Rheia) is a Titan and a mother goddess in Greek mythology.

statement.id: Rhea adalah Titan perempuan dan dewi ibu dalam mitologi Yunani.
statement.en: Rhea is a female Titan and mother goddess in Greek myth.

claims.quote: She is the daughter of Gaia (Earth) and Uranus (Heaven) and the mother of the great deities of Mount Olympus.

statement.id: Rhea adalah putri Gaia dan Uranus serta ibu para dewa Olimpus.
statement.en: Rhea is daughter of Gaia and Uranus and mother of major Olympian deities.

claims.quote: Her Roman counterpart was Ops, a fertility deity and the goddess of the harvest.

statement.id: Padanan Romawi Rhea ialah Ops.
statement.en: Rhea's Roman counterpart was Ops.

claims.quote: Rhea is most well-known as the mother of the Olympian deities, especially Zeus, who she saved from being swallowed by his father, Cronus.

statement.id: Rhea menyelamatkan Zeus agar tidak ditelan ayahnya, Cronus.
statement.en: Rhea saved Zeus from being swallowed by his father Cronus.

claims.quote: Rhea meanwhile gave Kronos a stone wrapped in the swaddling-cloths to swallow in place of his newborn son.

statement.id: Rhea memberi Kronos batu berbalut kain sebagai pengganti Zeus bayi.
statement.en: Rhea gave Kronos a swaddled stone instead of infant Zeus.

claims.quote: She put him in the care of both the Kouretes (Curetes) and the Nymphai (Nymphs) Adrasteia and Ide (Ida)

statement.id: Zeus kecil dipercayakan kepada Kouretes dan dua Nymph bernama Adrasteia dan Ide.
statement.en: Infant Zeus was entrusted to the Kouretes and nymphs Adrasteia and Ide.

claims.quote: They sang and danced and clashed their shields to drown out the cries of the infant Zeus and protect him from his father.

statement.id: Kouretes membenturkan perisai untuk menutupi tangis Zeus dari Cronus.
statement.en: The Kouretes clashed shields to hide infant Zeus's cries from Cronus.

claims.quote: Rhea was closely associated with Cybele, a Phrygian goddess who was worshipped across Greece, Rome and Anatolia.

statement.id: Rhea kemudian dikaitkan dengan dewi Frigia Cybele.
statement.en: Rhea became closely associated with the Phrygian goddess Cybele.

claims.quote: Rhea and Cybele began as two separate identities, but they essentially became two manifestations of the same deity.

statement.id: Rhea dan Cybele mula-mula merupakan identitas terpisah sebelum dipadankan.
statement.en: Rhea and Cybele began as separate figures before being identified.

claims.quote: In Olympia, there was a temple known as the Metroön, which was built for Rhea in honour of her role as mother of the gods.

statement.id: Kuil Metroön di Olympia didedikasikan bagi Rhea sebagai ibu para dewa.
statement.en: The Metroön at Olympia honored Rhea as mother of the gods.

claims.quote: To Kronos (Cronus) and Rhea, we are told, were born Hestia, Demeter, and Hera, and Zeus, Poseidon, and Haides

statement.id: Kisah Diodorus menyebut Hestia, Demeter, Hera, Zeus, Poseidon, dan Hades sebagai anak Rhea.
statement.en: Diodorus names Hestia, Demeter, Hera, Zeus, Poseidon, and Hades as Rhea's children.

claims.quote: but thus much seems undeniable, that Rhea, like Demeter, was a goddess of the earth.

statement.id: Rhea, seperti Demeter, adalah dewi bumi.
statement.en: Rhea, like Demeter, was a goddess of the earth.

claims.quote: Cronos is said to have devoured all his children by Rhea, but when she was on the point of giving birth to Zeus, she, by the advice of her parents, went to Lyctus in Crete.

statement.id: Cronos dikisahkan menelan semua anaknya dari Rhea, tetapi ketika Rhea hampir melahirkan Zeus, atas saran orang tuanya ia pergi ke Lyctus di Kreta.
statement.en: Cronos is said to have devoured all his children by Rhea, but when she was about to give birth to Zeus she went, on her parents' advice, to Lyctus in Crete.

claims.quote: At Delphi there was a stone of not very large dimensions, which was every day anointed with oil, and on solemn occasions was wrapped up in white wool; and this stone was believed to have been the one which Cronos swallowed when he thought he was devouring Zeus

statement.id: Di Delphi ada sebuah batu kecil yang diurapi minyak setiap hari dan dibungkus wol putih pada upacara khidmat; batu itu dipercaya sebagai batu yang ditelan Cronos ketika ia mengira sedang menelan Zeus.
statement.en: At Delphi there was a smallish stone anointed with oil every day and wrapped in white wool on solemn occasions; it was believed to be the stone Cronos swallowed when he thought he was devouring Zeus.

claims.quote: The various names by which we find Rhea designated, are, "the great mother," "the mother of the gods," Cybele, Cybebe, Agdistis, Berecyntia, Brimo, Dindymene, "the great Idaean mother of the gods."

statement.id: Rhea disebut dengan berbagai nama, antara lain "ibu agung", "ibu para dewa", Cybele, Cybebe, Agdistis, Berecyntia, Brimo, dan Dindymene.
statement.en: Rhea is designated by various names, including "the great mother," "the mother of the gods," Cybele, Cybebe, Agdistis, Berecyntia, Brimo, and Dindymene.

claims.quote: The Corybantes were her enthusiastic priests, who with drums, cymbals, horns, and in full armour, performed their orgiastic dances in the forests and on the mountains of Phrygia.

statement.id: Para Corybantes adalah imam-imamnya yang antusias, yang menarikan tarian orgiastik dengan genderang, simbal, dan tanduk serta berbaju zirah lengkap di hutan dan pegunungan Frigia.
statement.en: The Corybantes were her enthusiastic priests, who with drums, cymbals, horns, and in full armour performed orgiastic dances in the forests and on the mountains of Phrygia.

claims.quote: In Greece the oak was sacred to Rhea

statement.id: Di Yunani, pohon ek keramat bagi Rhea.
statement.en: In Greece the oak was sacred to Rhea.

claims.quote: The lion was sacred to the mother of the gods, because she was the divinity of the earth

statement.id: Singa keramat bagi ibu para dewa, karena ia adalah dewata bumi.
statement.en: The lion was sacred to the mother of the gods, because she was the divinity of the earth.

claims.quote: Crete was undoubtedly the earliest seat of the worship of Rhea

statement.id: Kreta tidak diragukan lagi merupakan pusat pemujaan Rhea yang paling awal.
statement.en: Crete was undoubtedly the earliest seat of the worship of Rhea.

claims.quote: According to some accounts Cronos and Rhea were preceded in their sovereignty over the world by Ophion and Eurynome ; but Ophion was overpowered by Cronos, and Rhea cast Eurynome into Tartarus.

statement.id: Menurut sebagian kisah, Cronos dan Rhea didahului dalam kekuasaan atas dunia oleh Ophion dan Eurynome; Ophion dikalahkan Cronos, dan Rhea melempar Eurynome ke Tartarus.
statement.en: According to some accounts Cronos and Rhea were preceded in sovereignty over the world by Ophion and Eurynome; Ophion was overpowered by Cronos, and Rhea cast Eurynome into Tartarus.

claims.quote: she was seldom represented in a standing posture, but generally seated on a throne, adorned with the mural crown, from which a veil hangs down. Lions usually appear crouching on the right and left of her throne

statement.id: Rhea jarang digambarkan berdiri, umumnya duduk di singgasana dengan mahkota tembok dan cadar menjuntai; singa biasanya berjongkok di kanan dan kiri singgasananya.
statement.en: She was seldom represented standing, but generally seated on a throne, wearing the mural crown with a veil hanging down; lions usually appear crouching to the right and left of her throne.

claims.quote: Rhea Translation Flow, Ease (rhea)

statement.id: Nama Rhea diterjemahkan sebagai "aliran, kemudahan".
statement.en: The name Rhea is translated as "flow, ease".

claims.quote: [1.2] AITHER (or OURANOS) & GAIA (Hyginus Pref)

statement.id: Menurut Hyginus (Pref), orang tua Rhea adalah Aither (atau Ouranos) dan Gaia.
statement.en: In Hyginus (Preface), Rhea's parents are Aither (or Ouranos) and Gaia.

claims.quote: [1.2] ZEUS, POSEIDON, HAIDES (by Kronos) (Homer Iliad 15.187)

statement.id: Menurut Homer, Iliad 15.187, anak Rhea dari Kronos adalah Zeus, Poseidon, dan Hades.
statement.en: In Homer, Iliad 15.187, Rhea's children by Kronos are Zeus, Poseidon, and Haides.

claims.quote: [1.3] ZEUS, DEMETER, HAIDES (Homeric Hymn 2.69)

statement.id: Menurut Homeric Hymn 2.69, anak Rhea adalah Zeus, Demeter, dan Hades.
statement.en: In Homeric Hymn 2.69, Rhea's children are Zeus, Demeter, and Haides.

claims.quote: wedded his sister Rhea; and since both Earth and Sky foretold him that he would be dethroned by his own son, he used to swallow his offspring at birth. His firstborn Hestia he swallowed, then Demeter and Hera, and after them Pluto and Poseidon.

statement.id: Dalam sebuah sumber klasik, ia menikahi saudarinya Rhea, dan karena Bumi dan Langit meramalkan ia akan digulingkan putranya sendiri, ia menelan anak-anaknya saat lahir: Hestia, lalu Demeter dan Hera, kemudian Pluto dan Poseidon.
statement.en: In a classical source, he wedded his sister Rhea, and since Earth and Sky foretold he would be dethroned by his own son, he swallowed his offspring at birth: Hestia, then Demeter and Hera, then Pluto and Poseidon.

claims.quote: Rhea repaired to Crete, when she was big with Zeus, and brought him forth in a cave of Dicte.

statement.id: Dalam sebuah sumber klasik, Rhea pergi ke Kreta ketika mengandung Zeus dan melahirkannya di sebuah gua di Dicte.
statement.en: In a classical source, Rhea went to Crete when big with Zeus and brought him forth in a cave of Dicte.

claims.quote: The ancients were not agreed as to whether the infant god had been reared on Mount Ida or Mount Dicte.

statement.id: Orang-orang kuno tidak sepakat apakah dewa bayi itu dibesarkan di Gunung Ida atau Gunung Dicte.
statement.en: The ancients were not agreed whether the infant god had been reared on Mount Ida or Mount Dicte.

claims.quote: Homer (Il. xv. 187) makes only a passing allusion to Rhea, and the passage of Hesiod, which accordingly must be regarded as the most ancient Greek legend about Rhea

statement.id: Homer hanya menyinggung Rhea sekilas, sehingga bagian dalam Hesiod harus dianggap sebagai legenda Yunani tertua tentang Rhea.
statement.en: Homer makes only a passing allusion to Rhea, so the passage of Hesiod must be regarded as the most ancient Greek legend about Rhea.

summary.en: Rhea is daughter of Uranus and Gaia.

summary.en: In Hyginus (Preface), her parents are Aither (or Ouranos) and Gaia.

summary.en: In Homer, Iliad 15.187: Zeus, Poseidon, and Haides.

summary.en: In Homeric Hymn 2.69: Zeus, Demeter, and Haides.

short_description.id: Al-Uzza adalah salah satu dari tiga dewi utama Arab pra-Islam.
short_description.en: Al-Uzza is one of the three principal goddesses of pre-Islamic Arabia.

long_description.id: Al-Uzza adalah salah satu dari tiga dewi utama Arab pra-Islam. Al-Uzza dipuja bersama Al-Lat dan Manat.
long_description.en: Al-Uzza is one of the three principal goddesses of pre-Islamic Arabia. Al-Uzza is worshipped alongside Al-Lat and Manat.

long_description.id: Kubus batu di Nakhlah dekat Mekah dianggap suci dalam pemujaannya. Quraisy memanggil Al-Uzza untuk memohon perlindungan. Sumber menyebut Khalid bin Walid menghancurkan kuil dan arca Al-Uzza pada 630 M. Al-Qur’an 53:19 menyebut Uzza bersama Lat.
long_description.en: A stone cube at Nakhlah near Mecca is held sacred in her worship. The Quraysh invoke Al-Uzza for protection. The source reports Khalid ibn al-Walid destroying Al-Uzza’s temple and statue in 630 CE. Quran 53:19 names Uzza alongside Lat.

short_description.id: Anahita adalah dewi Iran.
short_description.en: Anahita is an Iranian goddess.

long_description.id: Anahita adalah dewi Iran. Anahita dipuji dalam Aban Yasht yang terdapat di Avesta.
long_description.en: Anahita is an Iranian goddess. Anahita is praised in the Aban Yasht of the Avesta.

long_description.id: Bahasa Persia Tengah menyebutnya Ardwisur Anahid. Anahita dihubungkan dengan kesuburan, kelahiran, dan kebijaksanaan. Kuil Anahita dibangun di dekat aliran air. Anahita dihubungkan dengan Mithra; merpati dan merak menjadi hewan sucinya.
long_description.en: Middle Persian renders her name Ardwisur Anahid. Anahita is associated with fertility, procreation, and wisdom. Anahita’s temples are built beside streams and watercourses. Anahita is associated with Mithra, with the dove and peacock identified as her sacred animals.

short_description.id: Anat adalah dewi perang dan perburuan yang dikenal dari teks Ugarit.
short_description.en: Anat is a goddess of warfare and hunting known from Ugaritic texts.

long_description.id: Anat adalah dewi perang dan perburuan yang dikenal dari teks Ugarit. Dalam Siklus Baal ia membantu Baal memperoleh kekuasaan dan membalaskan kematiannya.
long_description.en: Anat is a goddess of warfare and hunting known from Ugaritic texts. In the Baal Cycle she helps Baal obtain kingship and avenges his death.

long_description.id: Anat masuk ke Mesir pada Zaman Perunggu dan penting pada masa Ramses II. Kajian awal menganggapnya dewi kesuburan seksual, tetapi itu bukan lagi konsensus para ahli. Menurut teori Lambert, ia berasal dari tradisi Amori. Satu versi Contendings of Horus and Set menjadikannya pasangan Set atas saran Neith.
long_description.en: Anat enters Egypt in the Bronze Age and is prominent under Ramesses II. Early scholarship considers her a goddess of sexual fertility, but that is no longer scholarly consensus. According to Lambert’s theory, she originates in Amorite tradition. One version of the Contendings of Horus and Set makes her Set’s consort at Neith’s suggestion.

claims.quote: was a goddess associated with warfare and hunting, best known from the Ugaritic texts.

statement.id: Anat adalah dewi perang dan perburuan yang dikenal dari teks Ugarit.

claims.quote: In Ugarit, Anat was one of the main goddesses, and regularly received offerings, as attested in texts written both in the local Ugaritic language and in Hurrian. She also frequently appears in myths, including the Baal Cycle and the Epic of Aqhat.

claims.quote: Anat was characterized as a fertility goddess associated with human sexuality in early scholarship, but despite the occasional modern support, this view is no longer the consensus among experts. short_description.id: Ennead Agung adalah kelompok sembilan dewa Mesir yang dipuja di Heliopolis.
short_description.en: The Great Ennead is a group of nine Egyptian gods worshipped at Heliopolis.

long_description.id: Ennead Agung adalah kelompok sembilan dewa Mesir yang dipuja di Heliopolis. Anggotanya mencakup Atum, Shu, Tefnut, Geb, Nut, Osiris, Isis, Set, dan Nephthys.
long_description.en: The Great Ennead is a group of nine Egyptian gods worshipped at Heliopolis. Its members include Atum, Shu, Tefnut, Geb, Nut, Osiris, Isis, Set and Nephthys.

long_description.id: Ennead Heliopolis merupakan salah satu dari beberapa kelompok sembilan dewa. Kata ennead berasal melalui bahasa Latin dari bahasa Yunani yang berarti sembilan. Teks Piramida menyebut Ennead Agung, Kecil, Ganda, dan Tujuh Ennead. Ennead mengadili sengketa Set dan Horus mengenai takhta.
long_description.en: Heliopolis’s Ennead is one of several groups of nine gods. The word ennead comes through Latin from Greek meaning nine. The Pyramid Texts mention the Great, Lesser, Dual and Seven Enneads. The Ennead judges Set and Horus’s dispute over the throne.

claims.quote: The Ennead or Great Ennead was a group of nine deities in Egyptian mythology worshipped at Heliopolis: the sun god Atum; his children Shu and Tefnut; their children Geb and Nut; and their children Osiris, Isis, Set, and Nephthys. The Ennead sometimes includes Horus the Elder; an ancient form of the falcon god, not the son of Osiris and Isis.

short_description.id: Frigg adalah dewi kesuburan, istri Odin dan ibu Baldr, yang dikenal berkaitan dengan pernikahan serta ramalan.
short_description.en: Frigg is a Norse fertility goddess, Odin's wife and Baldr's mother, associated with marriage and prophecy.

long_description.id: Frigg adalah dewi kesuburan dan istri Odin. Ia dihubungkan dengan pernikahan, keibuan, kecerdikan dan ramalan; Baldr dan Hodr disebut sebagai putranya. Nama Friday berkaitan dengan namanya. Beberapa nama lainnya adalah Frigga, Frea, dan Fria.
long_description.en: Frigg is a fertility goddess and Odin's wife. She is linked to marriage, motherhood, cleverness and prophecy; Baldr and Hodr are named as her sons. English Friday is named for her. Other names include Frigga, Frea and Fria.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah kematian Baldr, Frigg meminta segala sesuatu berjanji tidak melukainya, tetapi melewatkan mistletoe. Loki memanfaatkan kelalaian itu sehingga Hodr melempar tumbuhan tersebut dan Baldr tewas. Frigg juga dikisahkan tinggal di Fensalir, yang letaknya tidak dijelaskan.
long_description.en: In the death of Baldr, Frigg asks all things to promise not to hurt him but overlooks mistletoe. Loki exploits this omission; Hodr throws the plant and Baldr dies. Frigg is also said to dwell in Fensalir, whose location is unspecified.

long_description.id: Sebuah tradisi Lombards menyebutnya Freia, istri Odin yang membantu kemenangan mereka. Hubungan asal-usulnya dengan Freyja tetap diperdebatkan; sebuah ensiklopedia lama bahkan mengingatkan agar keduanya tidak diidentifikasi begitu saja. Sumber modern menegaskan Frigg bukan ibu Thor.
long_description.en: A tradition of the Lombards calls her Freia, Odin's wife who helps the Lombards win. Her possible historical connection to Freyja remains speculative, and an older encyclopedia warns against identifying the two outright. A modern source says she is not Thor's mother.

short_description.id: Hubal adalah dewa Arab pra-Islam yang terutama dipuja Quraisy di Mekah.
short_description.en: Hubal is a pre-Islamic Arabian god particularly worshipped by the Quraysh in Mecca.

long_description.id: Hubal adalah dewa Arab pra-Islam yang terutama dipuja Quraisy di Mekah. Hubal dipuja melalui arca menyerupai manusia di Ka’bah.
long_description.en: Hubal is a pre-Islamic Arabian god particularly worshipped by the Quraysh in Mecca. Hubal is worshipped through a human-shaped statue in the Kaaba.

long_description.id: Ramalan dilakukan menggunakan anak panah di depan arca Hubal. Quraisy mengendalikan akses menuju arca Hubal. Ibn al-Kalbi menggambarkan arca Hubal sebagai sosok manusia dengan tangan kanan yang patah dan diganti emas, dan arca itu disebut terbuat dari akik merah.
long_description.en: Divination uses arrows placed before Hubal's statue. The Quraysh control access to Hubal's statue. Ibn al-Kalbi describes the statue as a human figure whose broken right hand is replaced by gold, and the statue is said to be made of red agate.

long_description.id: Britannica 1911 mencatat bahwa Hobal ditempatkan di dalam Bait di atas lubang yang berisi harta suci, dan fungsi utamanya terkait undian suci. Sumber berbeda tentang siapa yang mendirikan arcanya: Ibn Al-Kalbi menyebut Khuzayma ibn Mudrika, sedangkan tradisi lain menyebut Amr ibn Luhayy. Mircea Eliade dan Charles J. Adams menyebutnya dewa hujan dan dewa perang, sementara dugaan Hugo Winckler bahwa ia dewa bulan ditolak sarjana yang lebih baru. Menurut salah satu sumber, Muhammad menghancurkan arcanya saat menaklukkan Mekah pada 630.
long_description.en: The 1911 Britannica notes that Hobal was set up within the Temple over the pit containing the sacred treasures and that his chief function was connected with the sacred lot. Sources differ on who set up his statue: Ibn Al-Kalbi names Khuzayma ibn Mudrika, while another tradition names Amr ibn Luhayy. Mircea Eliade and Charles J. Adams call him a rain god and a warrior god, while Hugo Winckler's guess that he was a lunar deity has been rejected by more recent scholars. According to one source, Muhammad broke his statue when he conquered Mecca in 630.

description.id: Arca Hubal diyakini mengendalikan ramalan yang dilakukan dengan melemparkan anak panah di hadapannya.
description.en: Hubal's statue was believed to control divination performed by casting arrows before it.

short_description.id: Inari adalah kami Jepang yang berkaitan dengan tanaman padi, biji-bijian, dan kesejahteraan.
short_description.en: Inari is a kami associated with rice, grain, and prosperity in Japan.

long_description.id: Dalam istilah Shinto, Inari disebut pelindung budidaya padi dan lima jenis biji-bijian. Kitab Shinto juga menyebutnya Uka-no-mitama-no-kami. Kuil Fushimi Inari Taisha menjelaskan bahwa lima tempat pemujaan utamanya mewakili berbagai keutamaan Inari Okami.
long_description.en: In Shinto terminology, Inari is a tutelary deity of rice cultivation and five grains. Shinto classics also call Inari Uka-no-mitama-no-kami. Fushimi Inari Taisha explains that five main enshrined deities embody different virtues of Inari Okami.

long_description.id: Tradisi Inari juga berhubungan dengan rubah. Pemuja Inari di berbagai daerah mengaitkannya dengan kesejahteraan perdagangan dan kebutuhan setempat. Kuil Fushimi Inari menjelaskan nama Inari sebagai bentuk pendek ungkapan lama yang berkaitan dengan panen padi.
long_description.en: Inari tradition is also associated with foxes. Worshipers in different regions connect Inari with commercial prosperity and local concerns. Fushimi Inari Shrine explains the name Inari as a shortened older expression relating to rice harvests.

short_description.en: Manat is a pre-Islamic Arabian goddess worshipped on the Arabian Peninsula.

long_description.id: Manat adalah dewi Arab pra-Islam yang dipuja di Jazirah Arab. Manat dihubungkan dengan nasib, keberuntungan, waktu, dan takdir.
long_description.en: Manat is a pre-Islamic Arabian goddess worshipped on the Arabian Peninsula. Manat is associated with fate, fortune, time, and destiny.

long_description.id: Kuil utama Manat yang telah hilang berada di antara Mekah dan Madinah di pesisir Laut Merah. Aws dan Khazraj termasuk suku yang sangat memuja Manat. Para peziarah yang dibahas menganggap perjalanan belum lengkap tanpa mengunjungi arca Manat. Al-Qur’an 53:20 menyebut Manat sebagai dewi ketiga dalam rangkaian tersebut.
long_description.en: Manat’s lost main shrine stood between Mecca and Medina on the Red Sea coast. The Aws and Khazraj are among Manat’s devoted worshippers. The pilgrims described regard visiting Manat’s idol as necessary to complete their pilgrimage. Quran 53:20 mentions Manat as the third deity in that sequence.

short_description.id: Mnemosyne ialah dewi Titan yang mempersonifikasikan ingatan dan menjadi ibu sembilan Muses bersama Zeus.
short_description.en: Mnemosyne is a Titan goddess personifying memory and mother of the nine Muses with Zeus.

long_description.id: Mnemosyne menguasai ingatan dan dikaitkan dengan bahasa, kata, serta pewarisan kisah sebelum tulisan dikenal. Sebagai putri Ouranos, ia termasuk Titan dan juga dikaitkan dengan waktu. Namanya berarti ingatan.
long_description.en: Mnemosyne governs memory and is linked to language, words and the preservation of stories before writing. As Ouranos' daughter she is a Titan also associated with time. Her name means memory.

long_description.id: Bersama Zeus, Mnemosyne menjadi ibu sembilan Muses setelah sembilan malam bersama. Para Muses menaungi seni seperti musik, tari, dan puisi. Sebuah tafsir Hesiod menempatkan kemampuan Muses menghalau kesusahan berpasangan dengan ingatan yang dilambangkan ibu mereka.
long_description.en: With Zeus, Mnemosyne mothers the nine Muses after nine nights together. The Muses patronize arts such as music, dance and poetry. One reading of Hesiod sets the Muses' relief from troubles beside the memory embodied by their mother.

long_description.id: Mnemosyne juga dikaitkan dengan orakel Trophonios di Boiotia, yang memiliki sumur suci dan takhta baginya. Sumber kuno menyebut sebuah patung Mnemosyne di Athens. Dalam satu klasifikasi ia juga dinamai sebagai salah satu Muses yang lebih tua.
long_description.en: Mnemosyne is also linked to the oracle of Trophonios in Boiotia, where she had a sacred well and throne. An ancient source mentions her statue in Athens. One classification also names her among the elder Muses.

long_description.id: Dalam satu puisi, Dumuzid bersaing dengan Enkimdu untuk menikahi Inanna. Tammuz disebut secara langsung dalam Kitab Yehezkiel. Dumuzi menggantikan Inanna di dunia bawah dalam kisah yang diringkas. Dumuzi dan Geshtinanna bergantian tinggal di dunia bawah selama setengah tahun.
long_description.en: In one poem, Dumuzid competes with Enkimdu to marry Inanna. Tammuz is named directly in the Book of Ezekiel. Dumuzi replaces Inanna in the underworld in the summarized account. Dumuzi and Geshtinanna alternate half-year stays in the underworld.
